ACAL-000.remedy: Clear all the errors before executing AccuCal2.

ACAL-001.cause: The robot is not ready. The system cannot issue motion because it is in error state.
ACAL-001.remedy: Clear all faults, then retry the operation.

ACAL-002.cause: AccuCal2 cannot converge within the set threshold.
ACAL-002.remedy: Perform the following: • Increase the number of iterations allowed. • Increase the convergence threshold setting. • Make sure the TCP has not been changed.

ACAL-003.cause: Robot is in contact with the part before starting a search motion.

ACAL-004.cause: No contact is made druing the AccuCal2 motion.
ACAL-004.remedy: Make sure the sensor and software are installed correctly.

ACAL-005.cause: The AccuCal2 program name is not defined.
ACAL-005.remedy: Select a AccuCal2 TP program before pressing EXEC key

ACAL-006.cause: This is an internal teach pendant editor program error.
ACAL-006.remedy: Abort the program and run again. If this doesn't resolve the problem, cycle power and try again. If this doesn't resolve the problem, reinstall the controller software. Refer to the Software Installation Manual for information on installing software.

ACAL-007.cause: This is an AccuCal2 internal error.
ACAL-007.remedy: Turn off the controller, and turn it on again to recover. If the problem persistes, reinstall the controller software. Refer to the Software Installation Manual for more information.

ACAL-008.cause: The output file cannot be opened.
ACAL-008.remedy: Check the path, and file name to be sure they are correct.

ACAL-009.cause: You are trying to execute a CALIB END instruction without a matching CALIB START instruction.
ACAL-009.remedy: Add a CALIB START instruction before the CALIB END.

ACAL-010.cause: The schedule number in CALIB, UTOOL, or UFRAME START is invalid.
ACAL-010.remedy: Provide a correct schedule number in CALIB (or UTOOL or UFRAME) START[] teach pendant instruction.

ACAL-011.cause: The current $MNUFRAMENUM[] is incorrect and cannot be accessed.
ACAL-011.remedy: Go to the USER FRAME menu to select a valid user frame.

ACAL-012.cause: Cannot access $MNUTOOL. The current $MNUTOOLNUM[] is incorrect.
ACAL-012.remedy: Display the FRAME menu to select a valid tool frame.

ACAL-013.cause: Backward execution were ignored. The AccuCal2 instructions can not be executed backward.
ACAL-013.remedy: The backward execution of the AccuCal2 instructions is ignored. Rewrite the instructions if you do not want this to happen.

ACAL-014.cause: System loading error. The AccuCal2 is loaded incorrectly.
ACAL-014.remedy: Reload the controller. Refer to the Software Installation Manual for more information.

ACAL-015.cause: Not enough data to compute the frame offset.
ACAL-015.remedy: Add more Detect instructions in the AccuCal2 program.

ACAL-016.cause: Detect instruction does not allow pre-plan motion.

ACAL-017.cause: An incorrect number of searches was performed.
ACAL-017.remedy: Re-teach the AccuCal2 program with an appropriate number of searches. Refer to the application-specific Setup and Operations Manual for information on the number of searches required for each calibration type.

ACAL-018.cause: The 3 planes method requires three search directions be normal to each other.
ACAL-018.remedy: Re-teach the cell finder program with three search directions that are normal to each other.

ACAL-019.cause: Positions are too close. The taught positions are too close to each other.
ACAL-019.remedy: Re-teach the cell finder program so that the contact positions are at least 10mm apart.

ACAL-020.cause: Current frame number setting is invalid.
ACAL-020.remedy: Please use SETUP/FRAME menu to setup correct frame.

ACAL-021.cause: The computed offset exceeds the pre-set value.
ACAL-021.remedy: Run the calibration program again to make sure the robot makes solid contacts with the part. Change the XYZ and ORNT change value in the schedule if these numbers are very small.

ACAL-022.cause: An AccuCal2 teach pendant program is running without performing mastering it first.
ACAL-022.remedy: Display the AccuCal2 menu, and master the program first.

ACAL-023.message: No EXEC at Single Step Mode.
ACAL-023.cause: The robot cannot execute an AccuCal2 program in Single Step Mode.
ACAL-023.remedy: Turn off Single Step before executing the cell finder program.

ACAL-024.cause: A failure occurred while trying to update the master data in a FIND instruction.
ACAL-024.remedy: Re-master the frame search teach pendant program.

ACAL-025.cause: A very large frame shift has occurred.
ACAL-025.remedy: Check the UTOOL and the fixture to make sure that they are properly installed.

ACAL-026.cause: No CALIB END instruction. AccuCal2 program does not have a FIND END instruction.
ACAL-026.remedy: Add CALIB END instruction at the end of the frame search teach pendant program.

ACAL-027.cause: The number of master data and number of run time data does not match each other.

ACAL-028.cause: No logged frame data exists and the frame cannot be restored.

ACAL-029.cause: No change occurred in the offset frame.
ACAL-029.remedy: Run Cell Finder again to compute a new offset.

ACAL-030.cause: The Frame data log is disabled.

ACAL-031.cause: $USEUFRAME is set to FALSE. AccuCal2 reset it to TRUE.
ACAL-031.remedy: Turn off the controller, the turn it on again to perform a Cold start.

ACAL-032.cause: The motion group number is invalid.
ACAL-032.remedy: Use only one group in the program and make sure the group is available.

ACAL-033.cause: The other program has motion control.

ACAL-034.cause: The motion group number is not right.
ACAL-034.remedy: Use only one group in the program, and make sure group is available.

ACAL-035.cause: The SHIFT key was not pressed.

ACAL-036.cause: The teach pendant program could not be created.
ACAL-036.remedy: Check the following: • Make sure enough memory is available. • Make sure the program is not being edited. • Make sure the program is not write protected.

ACAL-037.cause: The teach pendant position has not been recorded. Make sure the program is not write protected.

ACAL-038.cause: The selected teach pendant program was not found and does not exist.
ACAL-038.remedy: Select an existing teach pendant program.

ACAL-039.cause: The robot could not move to the recorded position.
ACAL-039.remedy: Make sure the position is reachable and that another program does not have motion control.

ACAL-040.cause: The detection teach pendant program is not usable.

ACAL-042.cause: The found orientation is larger than the tolerance allows.
ACAL-042.remedy: Adjust the object so that orientation is smaller. Increase the orientation tolerance.

ACAL-043.cause: The number of search points does not match the selected solution type.
ACAL-043.remedy: Select a different solution type, or adjust number of detect statements.

ACAL-044.cause: An unsupported solution type error was selected.

ACAL-046.cause: The position failed to convert. The internal position was not set.
ACAL-046.remedy: Make sure the points are taught in the proper sequence and are not near limits.

ACAL-047.remedy: Reduce the number of detect points.

ACAL-048.remedy: Make sure the correct number of points are taught in the correct directions and orientation.

ACAL-049.cause: This is a motion limit error. The detect motion failed due to a limit error for the destination position.
ACAL-049.remedy: Move the robot away from the joint limit, or reduce the search distance in the detection schedule.

ACAL-050.remedy: Try to run the TCP Calibration instruction without the TCP Cal software. Perform a Controlled start, and load the TCP Cal software from the option menu.

ACAL-051.remedy: Try to run the Cell Calibration instruction without the Cell Cal software. Perform a Controlled start, and load the Cell Cal software from the option menu.

ACAL-052.cause: Robot Cal is not loaded. The robot tried to run the robot Calibration instruction without the Robot Cal software.
ACAL-052.remedy: Perform a Controlled start, and load the Robot Cal software from the OPTION menu.

ACAL-053.cause: No calibration software. The robot tried to run a detect instruction without Calibration software.
ACAL-053.remedy: Perform a Controlled start, and load one of the Calibration software options from the OPTION menu.

ACAL-054.cause: Invalid Calibration program. The calibration program type does not match the calibration menu.
ACAL-054.remedy: Check the teach pendant program's calibration start instruction so it matches the calibration menu.

ACAL-055.cause: Too Many Parallel Searches have occurred. More than three parallel searches occurred when the total number of searches is less than 7.
ACAL-055.remedy: Teach more searches, or change the excess parallel searches to be in a different direction.

ACAL-056.cause: The robot executed an UPDATE FRAME instruction in a non-Cell calibration program.
ACAL-056.remedy: UPDATE FRAME only works in Cell Calibration programs with Uframe Start instruction. Remove the UPDATE FRAME instruction from the non-CellCal program.

ACAL-057.cause: Residual maximum calibration has exceeded the limit allowed by the specified schedule.
ACAL-057.remedy: Verify solid tooling and good contact is made during all searches. Increase the limit in the schedule.

ACAL-058.cause: The UFRAME was changed during UTOOL calibration and this is not allowed.
ACAL-058.remedy: Use the same UFRAME for all points during the initial UTOOL calib.

ACAL-059.cause: All required positions are not recorded.
ACAL-059.remedy: Record all necessary positions, and retry the operation.

ACAL-060.cause: The accumulated offset exceeds the tolerance specified in the schedule.
ACAL-060.remedy: Repair the tool so that the TCP is closer to the reference TCP, or increase Accumulated Error Threshold in the tool calibration schedule.

ACAL-061.cause: A UFrame mismatch has occurred. The current MNUFRAME number does not match the program's uframe.
ACAL-061.remedy: Change the current user frame number to match the program's user frame number.

ACAL-062.message: Too many moves in a program.
ACAL-062.cause: Too many moves have been attempted in a program. The Calibration porgram has too many motion lines in it.
ACAL-062.remedy: Limit the number of move instructionz in a calibration program to less than 256.

ACAL-063.cause: The master data failed to update. The master count cannot be updated when the robot is in motion.
ACAL-063.remedy: Abort the robot motion and then press the UPDATE soft key again.

ACAL-064.cause: A UTool mismatch has occurred. The current MNUTOOL number does not match the program's utool.
ACAL-064.remedy: Change the current tool number to match the program's utool number.

ACAL-065.remedy: Review previous error to identify the cause

ACAL-066.remedy: Review the previous error to identify the cause.

ACAL-067.remedy: Check for loss fixture or tool or change the fit error tolerance in the detection schedule.

ACAL-068.remedy: Check for loss fixture or tool or change the radius error tolerance in the detection schedule.

ACAL-069.cause: Auto Update is on therefore the frame has been updated automatically.

ACAL-070.cause: No update on record points. The teach pendant program has a different number of DETECT instructions than expected. The positions cannot automatically update in the screen.
ACAL-070.remedy: Manually record positions to create the calibration program.

ACAL-071.cause: The axis number specified in the DETECT Joint instruction is invalid.
ACAL-071.remedy: Change the axis number to a valid one.

ACAL-072.cause: The Detect Joint instruction cannot use TOS WRIST sensor type for contact detection.
ACAL-072.remedy: Change sensor type to either IO or TOS all axes in the detection schedule.

ACAL-073.cause: The Detect Joint instruction is not valid for TCP or CELL calibration.
ACAL-073.remedy: The Detect Joint instruction is for ROBOT calibration only. Change the calibration start instruction to CALIB START or delete the instruction from the program.

ACAL-074.cause: No motion exists before the DETECT instruction. Detect instructions require a motion line preceeding them.
ACAL-074.remedy: Add a MOVE instruction before the DETECT instruction.

ACAL-075.cause: Mixed Detect instructions have occurred. The Detect Joint instruction cannot be used with other Detect instructions within the same Calib Start - Calib End instructions.
ACAL-075.remedy: Delete the other DETECT instrucion from the program.

ACAL-076.cause: More than one Detect Joint instruction exists. Only one Detect Joint instruction is allowed between Calib Start and Calib End instructions.
ACAL-076.remedy: Delete the extra DETECT JOINT instructions.

ACAL-077.message: No Detect Joint in Init. Cal
ACAL-077.cause: No Detect Joint should exist in Initial Calibration. The Detect Joint instruction does not apply to the initial robot calibration.
ACAL-077.remedy: Run the program from the robot master recovery menu.

ACAL-078.cause: Execute the Update Utool instruction in a non-TCPCal program.
ACAL-078.remedy: Update Tool only works in TCP Calibration programs with a UTool Start instruction.

ACAL-079.cause: The search start position's appraoch vector does not align with the plate's normal vector.
ACAL-079.remedy: Touch up the search start position so that the position's approach vector is aligned to the plate's normal vector.

ACAL-080.cause: Failed to update the teach pendant program's search start position.
ACAL-080.remedy: Make sure there is no system fault before pressing UPDATE. If the problem persists, perform a Cold start.

ACAL-081.cause: The recorded position is too close to the joint limit.
ACAL-081.remedy: Re-teach the position away from joint limit.

ACAL-082.message: Tool is 180 degree off in Z
ACAL-082.cause: The Tool approach vector is 180 degrees off in Z from the search direction.
ACAL-082.remedy: Change the system variable $cb_vars.$z_out to FALSE if it is set to TRUE, or vice versa.

ACAL-083.remedy: The teach pendant program memory might be corrupted. Replace the instruction with a new one.

ACAL-084.cause: Failed to access calibration program's KAREL variables.
ACAL-084.remedy: Cold start the controller. If the problem persists, re-install the calibration option again.

ACAL-085.cause: The specified UFrame is zero or small, and Calibrate UFrame is disabled.
ACAL-085.remedy: Set UFrame to be the precision calibration fixture location or enable UFrame calibration in the calibration schedule.

ACAL-086.cause: The specified UTool is zero or small, and the Calibrate UTool is disabled.
ACAL-086.remedy: Set UTool to be the precision calibration fixture location or enable UTool calibration in the calibration schedule.

ACAL-087.cause: The joint angle motion is too small.
ACAL-087.remedy: Modify calibration points to provide more motion on the specified axis. Or, disable calibration of one or more joints.

ACAL-088.cause: Three or more points with same search direction are colinear or nearly colinear
ACAL-088.remedy: Reteach one of the points so the points are not colinear or teach another non-colinear point.

ACAL-089.cause: There must be at least three different search directions that are close to perpendicular to each other. There must be at least three non-colinear points in one search direction and at least two points in another search direction
ACAL-089.remedy: Add more search points or reteach existing points to have sufficient search directions and sufficient number of points in the search directions.

ACAL-090.cause: Calibration joint angle correction exceeds the limit
ACAL-090.remedy: Identify the cause of the large correction. If the robot joint angle is actually off by that large amount, then you can either increase the tolerance in the schedule or manually remaster the robot to reduce the error and touchup the calibration points and rerun the calibration. If the calibration result is incorrect, then check that Calibrate UFrame is TRUE unless you are doing calibration recovery or use a precision fixture. Check that Calibrate UTool is TRUE unless you are doing calibration recovery or use a precision calibration tool. If you are doing recovery then check that the calibration fixture is in the correct location and the UFrame is the same as the original UFrame from when the calibration was run in MASTER mode. If recovering J6, then verify that UTool and the calibration tool are the same as when the calibration was run in MASTER mode

ACAL-091.cause: The UFrame orientation must be zero.
ACAL-091.remedy: Use a UFrame with WPR values where all are set to zero.

ACAL-092.cause: The search destination position is closed to joint limit.
ACAL-092.remedy: Re-teach the position away from joint limits.

ACAL-093.cause: The Coordinate Motion Pair number is invalid.
ACAL-093.remedy: Check the CD pair setup to make sure the CD pair has been setup correctly.

ACAL-094.remedy: Check the Process Sync setup to make sure the Process Sync has been setup correctly.

ACAL-095.cause: CD pair calibration requires Coordinate Motion Software
ACAL-095.remedy: Please load Coordinate Motion software to the controller.

ACAL-096.cause: Robot Link calibration requires Robot Link Software.
ACAL-096.remedy: Please load Robot Link software to the controller.

ACAL-097.cause: The user is trying to run the MultiCal instruction without MultiCal software.
ACAL-097.remedy: Perform a Control start and load the MultiCal software from option menu.

ACAL-098.cause: Calibration Bar is not support in V7.20 MultiCal Release.
ACAL-098.remedy: The calibration bar method will be supported in future release

ACAL-099.cause: Positioner calibration is not supported in V7.20 MultiCal release.
ACAL-099.remedy: The positioner calibration will be supported in future release

ACAL-100.cause: The read in program group does not match the current default motion group.
ACAL-100.remedy: Use Fctn hard-key to change current motion group or select another calibration program.

ACAL-101.cause: The maximum alignment distance was exceeded.
ACAL-101.remedy: Fix the TCP Alignment and run TCPCal again.

ACAL-102.cause: Cannot execute current step without completing previous steps.
ACAL-102.remedy: Complete all steps leading to the current step.

ACAL-104.cause: There is no asscoated Analog data file in FRS: for the specified analog port number
ACAL-104.remedy: Copy the analog data file to the FRS: directory and cold start the controller.

ACAL-105.cause: RobotCal and MultiCal does not support analog sensor.
ACAL-105.remedy: Select a different sensor type in the detection schedule.

ACAL-106.cause: Detect Circle and Detect Joint instruction do not support analog sensor.
ACAL-106.remedy: Select a different sensor type in the detection schedule.

ACAL-107.cause: The AIN port number is not valid.
ACAL-107.remedy: Select a different AIN port number that has its data file in FRS: directory.

ACAL-108.cause: Dynamic Uframe seting require cd pair setting in its schedule.
ACAL-108.remedy: Set the cd pair number in the schedule or change the Frame calibration mode in setup menu

ACAL-109.cause: The schedule used by UFrame has cd_pair set.
ACAL-109.remedy: Select a new schedule or change the cd_pair variable to 0 in the current schedule

ACAL-110.remedy: Press STEP key to disable single step.

ACAL-112.cause: Invalid Position Type. Position register is in JOINT representation.
ACAL-112.remedy: Change the position type to Cartesian for vision position register.

ACAL-115.cause: TP program has position with joint representation. This is is not allowed in High Accuracy Mode
ACAL-115.remedy: 1. Exit High Accuracy Mode 2. Move to the position 3. Enable High Accuracy Mode 4. Change to Cartesian rep.

ACAL-116.cause: Joint motion is not allowed in High Accuracy Mode
ACAL-116.remedy: Change motype to Linear or exit High Accuracy Mode

ACAL-117.cause: UTool change is not allowed in High Accuracy Mode
ACAL-117.remedy: Exit High Accuracy Mode before changing UTool

ACAL-118.cause: WJNT motion is not allowed in High Accuracy Mode
ACAL-118.remedy: Exit High Accuracy Mode before using WJNT motion.

ACAL-120.cause: RTCP motion is not allowed in High Accuracy Mode
ACAL-120.remedy: Exit High Accuracy Mode before using RTCP motion.

ACAL-121.cause: COORD motion is not allowed in High Accuracy Mode
ACAL-121.remedy: Exit High Accuracy Mode before using COORD motion.

ACAL-122.cause: Gravity compensation is not allowed with High Accuracy
ACAL-122.remedy: Disable Gravity Compensation Go through robot library setup at controlled start

ACAL-123.cause: Softfloat is not allowed in High Accuracy Mode
ACAL-123.remedy: Exit High Accuracy Mode before using Softfloat.

ACAL-124.cause: High Accuracy Mode failed to be entered
ACAL-124.remedy: Check alarm history and correct problem

ACAL-125.cause: Secondary encoder mode failed to be entered
ACAL-125.remedy: Check alarm history and correct problem

ACAL-126.cause: Information status. High Accuracy Mode successffully entered

ACAL-127.cause: Information status. High Accuracy Mode successffully exited

ACAL-128.cause: Information status. Already in High Accuracy Mode.

ACAL-129.cause: Information status. Not in High Accuracy Mode.

ACAL-131.remedy: Remove any motion options on the TP motion line

ACAL-132.remedy: TCP and UFrame cannot be both FALSE for UFrame and UTool calibration.

ACAL-133.cause: The measured points does not the command points.

ACAL-134.cause: The DC compensation exceed preset threshold.
ACAL-134.remedy: Change system variable to allow larger correction.

ACAL-135.cause: Maximum residual error of calculation exceed tolerance.
ACAL-135.remedy: 1 Review the calibration procedure. 2 Re-do the calibration.

ACAL-136.cause: Mean residual error of calculation exceed tolerance.
ACAL-136.remedy: 1 Review the calibration procedure. 2 Re-do the calibration.

ACAL-137.cause: Maximum error of validation exceed tolerance.
ACAL-137.remedy: 1 Review the calibration procedure. 2 Re-do the calibration.

ACAL-138.cause: Mean error of validation exceed tolerance.
ACAL-138.remedy: 1 Review the calibration procedure. 2 Re-do the calibration.

ACAL-139.cause: A current robot position that software calculates is abnormal.
ACAL-139.remedy: 1. Mastering data could be incorrect. Confirm whether incorrect backup data is restored or mastering has been executed at the wrong position. In that case, execute mastering. 2. Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC technical representative.

ACAL-140.cause: Not enought calibration points to compute signature parameters.
ACAL-140.remedy: Add more calibration position in the position TP program.

ACAL-141.cause: The robot group has not been calibrated.
ACAL-141.remedy: Please run signature calibration of before running program motions.

ACAL-142.cause: The robot group has not been calibrated.
ACAL-142.remedy: Please run signature calibration of before running program motions.

ACAL-143.cause: Not enough orientation to solve for the TCP
ACAL-143.remedy: Please touch up some positions to include larger orientation of the the TCP.

ACAL-144.cause: iRCaliabration Signature does not support integrated exteded axes.
ACAL-144.remedy: Please setup the extended axes as

ACAL-145.cause: This robot is not supported by iRCaliabration Signature.
ACAL-145.remedy: Please setup the 2nd bit(4) in $CBSG_MENU[g].$CALIB_STAT for test

ACAL-146.cause: Socket Message Task Fails to start.
ACAL-146.remedy: Please check network settings and try again.

ACAL-147.cause: Socket Message Task in receiving state for too long.
ACAL-147.remedy: Please check network settings and try again.

ACAL-148.cause: Socket Message Task in error state.
ACAL-148.remedy: Please check network settings and try again.

APSH-001.cause: A MACRO was called without a parameter that must be entered.
APSH-001.remedy: Check the MACRO call in the TP program.

APSH-002.cause: A MACRO was called with a parameter that is illegal. The parameter has the wrong data type.
APSH-002.remedy: Check the MACRO call in the TP program.

APSH-003.cause: An zone number less that 1 or greater than $IZONEIO.$NO_ZONES was used.
APSH-003.remedy: Use an event number from 1 to $IZONEIO.$NO_ZONES.

APSH-004.cause: The robot has requested an interferance zone, but has not been given permission to enter by the cell controller.
APSH-004.remedy: If the cell controller does not give control of an interferance zone to the robot when it should, check the cell controller's interferance zone programming.

APSH-005.cause: The robot has received permission to enter the interferance zone.
APSH-005.remedy: Used to clear the waiting for interferance zone message only.

APSH-006.cause: This warning indictates that the amount of free memory in the CMOS memory partition has gotten dangerously low. If the PERM memory runs out, you will experience strange MEMO errors and possibly robot lock-ups or register dumps.
APSH-006.remedy: Warning only. Delete any unneeded data. Contact your FANUC representative with this error. You will probably have to adjust the memory configuration in your robot controller.

APSH-007.cause: This warning indicates that the amount of free memory in the TEMP memory partition has gotten dangerously low. If the TEMP memory runs out, you will experience strange MEMO errors and possibly robot lock-ups or register dumps.
APSH-007.remedy: Warning only. Delete any unneeded data. Contact your FANUC representative with this error. You will probably have to adjust the memory configuration in your robot controller.

APSH-008.cause: A fault has ocurred, so the operation requested cannot be performed.
APSH-008.remedy: Clear the source of the fault, and press FAULT RESET.

APSH-009.cause: The shell detected a start signal but a program is already running.
APSH-009.remedy: Re-issue start request when current program is paused or aborted.

APSH-010.cause: A UOP CYCLE START or DI[Initiate Style] was detected when a non-production (i.e. test cycle) program was paused. This paused program was aborted for safety reasons.
APSH-010.remedy: None is required. The next production start signal will start the current style.

APSH-011.remedy: Go to FRAME menu to select a valid user frame.

APSH-012.message: REMOTE switch must be on LOCAL
APSH-012.cause: The robot's REMOTE condition is TRUE, so the remote operating device (PLC) currently has motion control over the robot.
APSH-012.remedy: Disable the REMOTE condition by turning the REMOTE keyswitch on the SOP to LOCAL.

APSH-013.cause: The REMOTE condition is currently false, so the robot is not under the control of the remote operating device (PLC).
APSH-013.remedy: Verify that the following conditions are true in order to put the robot into the REMOTE condition: 1. UOP inputs #1 (IMSTP), #3 (SFTYSPD), and #8 (ENBL) are all HIGH. 2. SOP REMOTE/LOCAL keyswitch is set to REMOTE. 3. Teach pendant is disabled. 4. Robot Auto/Bypass mode input is HIGH (if so assigned). 5. Make sure a user program is not setting $RMT_MASTER = 1

APSH-014.cause: There is an active fault, which prevents the reset request from executing
APSH-014.remedy: Clear the source of the fault (usually en external E-Stop) and press FAULT RESET.

APSH-015.cause: Step mode is enabled, which prevents the run request from executing
APSH-015.remedy: Disable step mode by pressing the STEP hardkey.

APSH-016.message: Robot is not under PLC control
APSH-016.cause: The UOP is not the master device, which prevents the run request from executing
APSH-016.remedy: Turn SOP REMOTE/LOCAL keyswitch to REMOTE. Make sure all UOP signals are correct for execution. Set $RMT_MASTER to 0.

APSH-017.cause: This is a warning to notify the user that a production job is running with the sealant disabled.

APSH-018.cause: This is a warning to notify the user that a production job is running with machine lock on.

APSH-019.cause: The job queue cannot accept the next job because it is full.
APSH-019.remedy: Manually edit the job queue to delete any unneeded jobs or increase queue size.

APSH-020.cause: A request to run the next job in the queue came in, but the queue is empty.
APSH-020.remedy: Check the external device to make sure that a job number was correctly sent to the controller, or manually edit the job queue to CREATE a job.

APSH-021.cause: Robot motion and/or program execution cannot occur unless UOP input 8 is ON.
APSH-021.remedy: Check UOP I/O setup. UOP input 8 (ENBL) must be ON.

APSH-022.cause: The safety fence input is LOW.
APSH-022.remedy: The safety fence input must be ON to resume normal robot operation. Raise the safety fence input.

APSH-023.message: No EXEC at Single Step Mode.
APSH-023.cause: Cannot execute AccuCal2 program in Single Step Mode.
APSH-023.remedy: Please Turn off Single Step before executing iRCal Frame program.

APSH-024.cause: The program name that the shell was requested to run is not loaded on the controller.
APSH-024.remedy: Check PLC->Robot style communication. Verify that specified JOB name was requested by PLC. Load or create the specified JOB program.

APSH-025.cause: This is a warning to notify the user that a production job is running at less than 100% speed. override.
APSH-025.remedy: None needed. Dispensetool can increase the override speed to 100% if you require it. Go to the Cell Setup menu to access this option.

APSH-026.cause: AccuCal2 program does not have a FIND END instruction.
APSH-026.remedy: Add CALIB END instruction at the end of the frame search TPE program.

APSH-027.cause: In order to resume normal production operation, Dispensetool requires that you perform this action.
APSH-027.remedy: Perform the action stated in the error message when you are ready to resume normal operation.

APSH-028.cause: This is a warning to notify the user that Dispensetool in increasing the genoverride (speed override) to 100%.
APSH-028.remedy: None needed. To disable this feature, you may change this option on the Cell Setup menu.

APSH-029.cause: The robot must be at the HOME position in order to perform the requested operation. This error is usually posted when the PLC sends a cycle start and the robot is not at home.
APSH-029.remedy: Move the robot to the home position.

APSH-030.cause: The GIN[style_in] is set to an invalid number.
APSH-030.remedy: Check the GIN[style_in] value as well as the Group input configuration.

APSH-031.cause: Place holder error, used to keep documentaion for errors from Drastically changing.
APSH-031.remedy: Check the GIN[style_in] value as well as the Group input configuration.

APSH-032.cause: Dispensetool has detected that the robot servos have been disabled manually.
APSH-032.remedy: This is a status message to make sure the user is aware that the robot cannot move. The servos must be re-enabled to resume normal production operations.

APSH-033.cause: A communication sequence took too long to complete.
APSH-033.remedy: Increase communication timeout value in PNS Cell Communication setup menu or disable communication timeout checking.

APSH-034.cause: The User Operator Panel output group has not been defined.
APSH-034.remedy: Set up the UOP Outputs in the UOP I/O menu and restart the robot controller.

APSH-035.cause: The MODE input is low, forcing the robot into BYPASS mode. The robot will now ignore all PLC style initiation.
APSH-035.remedy: Set the MODE switch to ON. The robot will then re-enter AUTOMATIC mode and again accept PLC signals.

APSH-036.cause: The current JOB has been paused. This often happens if the HOLD input is turned ON or the UOP ENBL signal is set to OFF.
APSH-036.remedy: If the REMOTE condition is TRUE, the fault recovery menu will appear and give the user the appropriate recovery options. If the REMOTE condition is not TRUE, recovery is up to the user. If all else fails, select FCTN (Function hardkey) then ABORT ALL.

APSH-037.cause: The User Operator Panel input group has not been defined.
APSH-037.remedy: Set up the UOP Inputs in the UOP I/O menu.

APSH-038.cause: The group which carry the style code in to the controller has not been defined.
APSH-038.remedy: Set up a STYLE SELECT group in the Cell I/O and GROUP I/O input menus and restart the robot.

APSH-039.cause: The style acknowlege strobe, which is needed with the current communication configuration, has not been defined.
APSH-039.remedy: Set up a Style Ack Strobe in the Cell Output I/O menu and restart the robot.

APSH-040.cause: The backup input group, which is needed with the current communication configuration, has not been defined.
APSH-040.remedy: Set up a Backup Style Select group in the Cell output I/O and GROUP I/O menus and restart the robot.

APSH-041.cause: The style strobe, which is needed with the current communication configuration (queue enabled), has not been defined.
APSH-041.remedy: Set up a PNS Strobe in the Cell Input I/O menu and restart the robot.

APSH-042.cause: Place holder error, used to keep documentaion for errors from Drastically changing.
APSH-042.remedy: Set up a PNS Strobe in the Cell Input I/O menu and restart the robot.

APSH-043.cause: The style acknowlege group, which is needed with the current communication configuration, has not been defined.
APSH-043.remedy: Set up a Style Ack Group in the Cell output I/O and GROUP I/O menus and restart the robot.

APSH-044.cause: The current job has been held by pressing the HOLD button or setting the UOP HOLD input LOW.
APSH-044.remedy: Release the HOLD button and raise the UOP HOLD input.

APSH-045.cause: No program number has been set up for this RSR input.
APSH-045.remedy: Enter a program number for this RSR input in the RSR Cell Setup menu.

APSH-046.cause: This is a notice that the robot is leaving BYPASS mode and entering AUTOMATIC mode, where it can respond to PLC inputs

APSH-047.message: Shell will not run without UOPs
APSH-047.cause: This is a warning, telling the user that the UOPs have not yet been set up, so the shell will wait for the UOPs to be defined before resuming.
APSH-047.remedy: The shell requires the UOPs to run. Once the UOPs have been set up, the shell will continue its initialization sequence.

APSH-048.cause: The backup style group is not the 1's complement (inverse) of the style input group.
APSH-048.remedy: Verify that the PLC is sending the correct invert style to the correct group. Disable invert checking in the PNS Cell Setup menu.

APSH-049.cause: Place holder error, used to keep documentaion for errors from Drastically changing.
APSH-049.remedy: Verify that the PLC is sending the correct invert style to the correct group. Disable invert checking in the PNS Cell Setup menu.

APSH-050.cause: Signals which are required for this cell IO configuration have not been configured.
APSH-050.remedy: Check the messages posted previous to the in the error log for the names of the incorrect signals. Fix the IO setup of these signals and cold start the controller.

APSH-051.cause: The robot cannot move while the UOP inputs are in this state.
APSH-051.remedy: You must either wire UOP inputs #1, #2, #3, and #8 high or deassign the UOP inputs and restart the controller.

APSH-052.cause: UOP inputs #1 (IMSTP), #2 (HOLD), #3(SFTYFNC), #8 (ENBL) are all LOW. These must all be HIGH for normal production operation.
APSH-052.remedy: See remedy for APSH-051, Connect or deassign UOP inputs.

APSH-053.cause: Try to run detect instruction without Calibration software.
APSH-053.remedy: Do Control start and load one of the Calibration software from the option menu.

APSH-054.cause: In order to resume normal production operation, Dispensetool requires that you perform this action.
APSH-054.remedy: Perform the action stated in the error message when you are ready to resume normal operation.

APSH-055.remedy: Perform the action stated in the error message when you are ready to resume normal operation.

APSH-058.cause: This error is posted to simulate a PAUSE error.
APSH-058.remedy: This error is posted by Dispensetool during normal operation, but should not be visible to the user. If you see this error, report it to you FANUC representative.

APSH-059.cause: This error is posted to simulate a ABORT error.
APSH-059.remedy: This error is posted by Dispensetool during normal operation, but should not be visible to the user. If you see this error, report it to you FANUC representative.

APSH-060.cause: This is not a fault. This error is posted when the robot is sent a cycle start from the cell controller, but the robot is either in BYPASS mode (set from Soft Panel menu) or in MANUAL mode, but no manual cycle start has been initiated. Is is also possible that the robot is in the MANUAL mode and a MANUAL CYCLE was requested, but the style sent by the PLC does not match the one specified on the SOFT PANEL.
APSH-060.remedy: In most cases, this fault can be ignored. This fault was put in to assist in debugging problems with the soft panel in Dispensetool. If you are trying to initiate a MANUAL CYCLE, make sure the MANUAL CYCLE STYLE inputted into the Soft Panel menu is the same as what the PLC is sending.

APSH-061.cause: Place holder error, used to keep documentaion for errors from Drastically changing.
APSH-061.remedy: In most cases, this fault can be ignored. This fault was put in to assist in debugging problems with the soft panel in Dispensetool. If you are trying to initiate a MANUAL CYCLE, make sure the MANUAL CYCLE STYLE inputted into the Soft Panel menu is the same as what the PLC is sending.

APSH-063.cause: The current job has been paused by pressing the HOLD button or setting the UOP HOLD input LOW.
APSH-063.remedy: Release the HOLD button and raise the UOP HOLD input.

APSH-067.remedy: Check for loss fixture or tool or change the fit error tolerance in the detection schedule.

APSH-068.remedy: Check for loss fixture or tool or change the radius error tolerance in the detection schedule.

APSH-069.cause: Auto Update is on. The frame has been updated automatically

APSH-070.cause: The error handler was unable to continue the task named when the user requested that all tasks be continued This is probably due to one of the E-Stops or HOLD buttons being active.
APSH-070.remedy: Disable all E-Stops and release HOLD buttons. If it is not desired that the task named be continued, abort it.

APSH-071.cause: A Karel PAUSE_TASK() command failed to pause a task which the error handler believes should be paused.
APSH-071.remedy: The task which the error handler tried to pause was probably a system utility, and is not allowed to be paused. You can probably ignore this fault without any problems.

APSH-072.remedy: Cold start the robot controller, then manually restore production status.

APSH-074.cause: In order to resume normal production operation, Dispensetool requires that you perform this action.
APSH-074.remedy: Perform the action stated in the error message when you are ready to resume normal operation.

APSH-075.cause: The following error occured when a the data associated with a TPE program was accessed.
APSH-075.remedy: Verify that this TPE program exists. Go into the DETAIL pages under the SELECT menu and hit NEXT key until robot allows this mode to END.

APSH-076.cause: The shell tried to execute a program, but was stopped by the operating system.
APSH-076.remedy: Make sure the program exists and it is not already running or paused. Use the PROGRAM STATUS display to make sure you have not exceeded the maximum number of tasks. Abort all programs which do not need to be running.

APSH-077.cause: This TPE did not contain a position to represent HOME, SERVICE, or PURGE.
APSH-077.remedy: If you need to use the AT PERCH, AT PURGE, or AT SERVICE outputs, teach the positons you need in the appropriate TPEs. If you do not need these outputs to be updated ignore this warning.

APSH-078.cause: The shell tried to execute a program, but was stopped by the operating system.
APSH-078.remedy: Make sure the program exists and it is not already running or paused. Use the PROGRAM STATUS display to make sure you have not exceeded the maximum number of tasks. Abort all programs which do not need to be running.

APSH-079.cause: No Auto/Bypass input has been defined, but one was expected.
APSH-079.remedy: Set a Auto/Bypass input in the Cell I/O Input menu and restart the robot.

APSH-080.cause: The robot is currently waiting for Cancel or continue (Wet or Dry) or a HOME input from the PLC.
APSH-080.remedy: This is a warning to inform the person at the teach pendant that the PLC has been given exclusive control over how the robot will recover from the current error.

APSH-081.cause: The robot is currently waiting for a cancel input from the PLC. The current JOB has had a fault so severe that it cannt recover and must be aborted or recieve the HOME UOP input
APSH-081.remedy: This is a warning to inform the person at the teach pendant that the PLC has been given exclusive control over how the robot will recover from the current error.

APSH-082.cause: No $ERROR_PROG has been defined for this JOB. This fault will only appear if the Karel variable [SLERROR]POST_NO_ERRP is set to TRUE (deault = FALSE).
APSH-082.remedy: Use the TPE ERROR_PROG command, under Program Control, to set up a Error Program for this JOB. This will allow the robot to move out of the work area when an error occurs.

APSH-083.cause: No $RESUME_PROG has been defined for this JOB.
APSH-083.remedy: Use the TPE RESUME_PROG command, under Program Control, to set up a Resume Program for this JOB. This will allow the JOB to resume the interrupted program.

APSH-084.cause: The robot is running a style program with one or more I/O ports simulated. Unexpected motions and actions may occur.
APSH-084.remedy: Verify that all simulated I/O points should be simulated. Un-simulate all I/O ports which should not be simulated.

APSH-085.cause: Specified UFrame is zero or small and Calibrate UFrame is disabled.
APSH-085.remedy: Set UFrame to be the precision calibration fixture location or enable UFrame calibration in the calibration schedule

APSH-086.cause: Specified UTool is zero or small and Calibrate UTool is disabled.
APSH-086.remedy: Set UTool to be the precision calibration fixture location or enable UTool calibration in the calibration schedule

APSH-087.cause: Joint angle motion is too small
APSH-087.remedy: Modify calibration points to provide more motion on the specified axis. Or disable calibration of one or more joints

APSH-088.cause: Three or more points with same search direction are colinear or nearly colinear
APSH-088.remedy: Reteach one of the points so the points are not colinear or teach another non-colinear point.

APSH-089.cause: There must be at least three different search directions that are close to perpendicular to each other. There must be at least three non-colinear points in one search direction and at least two points in another search direction
APSH-089.remedy: Add more search points or reteach existing points to have sufficient search directions and sufficient number of points in the search directions.

APSH-090.cause: Place holder error, used to keep documentation for errors from drastically changing.
APSH-090.remedy: Verify that all simulated I/O points should be simulated. Un-simulate all I/O ports which should not be simulated.

APSH-091.cause: Place holder error, used to keep documentation for errors from drastically changing.
APSH-091.remedy: Verify that all simulated I/O points should be simulated. Un-simulate all I/O ports which should not be simulated.
