ATZN-001.cause: AutoZone internal error. AutoZone internal error.
ATZN-001.remedy: Power off to recover. If problem persistes, please reload the controller.

ATZN-002.message: Name not found in HDR Table
ATZN-002.cause: Name not found in HDR Table Program name not found in AutoZone internal program header table.
ATZN-002.remedy: Internal error. Please call customer service.

ATZN-003.message: Name not found in PRG Table
ATZN-003.cause: Name not found in PRG Table Program name not found in AutoZone internal program voxel table.
ATZN-003.remedy: Internal error. Please call customer service.

ATZN-004.message: Name not found in REC Table
ATZN-004.cause: Name not found in REC Table Program name not found in AutoZone internal zone recording table.
ATZN-004.remedy: Internal error. Please call customer service.

ATZN-005.message: Name not found in REQ Table
ATZN-005.cause: Name not found in REQ Table Program name not found in AutoZone internal zone request table.
ATZN-005.remedy: Internal error. Please call customer service.

ATZN-006.cause: AZ HDR Table is full Internal AutoZone header table is full.
ATZN-006.remedy: Internal error. Please call customer service.

ATZN-007.cause: AZ PRG Table is full Internal AutoZone program table is full.
ATZN-007.remedy: Internal error. Please call customer service.

ATZN-008.cause: AZ REC Table is full Internal AutoZone recording table is full.
ATZN-008.remedy: Internal error. Please call customer service.

ATZN-009.cause: AZ REQ Table is full Internal AutoZone request table is full.
ATZN-009.remedy: Internal error. Please call customer service.

ATZN-010.cause: Master flags not in sync Master flags in main and sub program header are not synchronized.
ATZN-010.remedy: Check master flag in both main and sub program header, ensure that master flags are synchronized. For example, both flags are enabled, or both flags are disabled.

ATZN-011.cause: % start mastering Program start mastering process.
ATZN-011.remedy: This is a warning message to indicate that mastering process has started.

ATZN-012.cause: % end mastering Program end mastering process.
ATZN-012.remedy: This is a warning message to indicate that mastering process has ended.

ATZN-013.cause: Not calibrated w.r.t. ZMGR Robot is not calibrated w.r.t. zone manager.
ATZN-013.remedy: Calibrate the robot w.r.t. zone manager in AutoZone manager setup menu.

ATZN-014.message: G:%d AZ Jog close to target
ATZN-014.cause: G:%d AZ Jog close to target Robot is close to target during Jogging.
ATZN-014.remedy: This alarm will stop the Jogging motion.

ATZN-015.cause: Resend G:%d AZ Jog request AutoZone jog request has not received a response for a period of time. AutoZone jog request will be resent.
ATZN-015.remedy: This is a warning message to indicate that the AutoZone jog request will be resent.

ATZN-016.cause: Prg needs re-master(mdf tim) Program modification time retrieved is different between program mastering and run-time program execution.
ATZN-016.remedy: Re-master the program will synchronize the program modification time saved in the program matering data.

ATZN-017.cause: %s Append Mode enabled Append mode has been enabled. The new mastering data file will be merged into the existing data file.
ATZN-017.remedy: This is a warning message to indicate that the append mode is enabled during program mastering process.

ATZN-018.cause: Space setup not initialized Space has not been configured and enabled in AutoZone space setup menu.
ATZN-018.remedy: Configure the space and enable it in AutoZone space setup menu.

ATZN-019.cause: No AutoZone CD Jogging AutoZone does not support coordinated jogging.
ATZN-019.remedy: Disable AutoZone jogging from AutoZone test-run setup menu during coordinated jogging.

ATZN-020.cause: Constant Path not enabled Constant Path is not enabled.
ATZN-020.remedy: Enable Constant Path and Cold Start to take effect.

ATZN-021.cause: Exceed maximum Deadlock Prevention zone per DP combination analysis.
ATZN-021.remedy: Re-teach TP programs to reduce number of Deadlock Prevention zones. Internal error. Please call customer service.

ATZN-022.cause: Exceed maximum Deadlock Prevention total zones.
ATZN-022.remedy: Re-teach TP programs to reduce number of Deadlock Prevention zones. Internal error. Please call customer service.

ATZN-023.cause: Minimum of 2 TP programs required for Deadlock Prevention analysis.
ATZN-023.remedy: Modify setup of Deadlock Prevention schedule.

ATZN-024.cause: Exceed maximum Deadlock Prevention total spaces.
ATZN-024.remedy: Internal error. Please call customer service.

ATZN-025.cause: Program space data is not available for the request.
ATZN-025.remedy: Complete the Deadlock Prevention analysis prior to program space data request. Internal error. Please call customer service.

ATZN-026.cause: Overlap space data is not available for the request.
ATZN-026.remedy: Complete the Deadlock Prevention analysis prior to overlap space data request. Internal error. Please call customer service.

ATZN-027.cause: Robot space data is not available for the request.
ATZN-027.remedy: Complete the Deadlock Prevention analysis prior to robot space data request. Internal error. Please call customer service.

ATZN-028.cause: Invalid Voxel Id during individual voxel query.
ATZN-028.remedy: Internal error. Please call customer service.

ATZN-029.cause: Duplicated host name and program name in specified Deadlock Prevnetion schedule.
ATZN-029.remedy: Use a unique host name and program name in specified

ATZN-030.cause: Same motion group number found in specified TP programs.
ATZN-030.remedy: Same motion group number can not be shared by two TP programs with same host name in the Deadlock Prevnetion schedule.

ATZN-031.cause: The first motion point of the TP program is inside the Deadlock Prevention zone.
ATZN-031.remedy: Re-teach the TP program, enable the Deadlock Prevention analysis, and then verify that the first motion point is outside the Dealock Prevention zone.

ATZN-032.cause: The last motion point of the TP program is inside the Deadlock Prevention zone.
ATZN-032.remedy: Re-teach the TP program, enable the Deadlock Prevention analysis, and then verify that the last motion point is outside the Dealock Prevention zone.

ATZN-033.cause: The hostname and the group number is not found in MASH main setup menu.
ATZN-033.remedy: Configure the hostname and the corresponding group number

BBOX-020.cause: There are no application process instructions in the program. Automatic detection of Bump schedule Lines cannot be done.
BBOX-020.remedy: Manually insert Bump schedule Line numbers in the schedule.

BBOX-021.message: Cannot bump from TP when I/O enabled
BBOX-021.cause: TP is enabled when Bump DI is input.
BBOX-021.remedy: 1. Select a Bump schedule, go to the DETAIL screen, scroll to the bump offset and use BUMP_UP or BUMP_DN. 2. Turn TP off to use Bump DI input.

BBOX-022.cause: Bump Group input value is out of range.
BBOX-022.remedy: Change the value of the Group input to select a defined schedule.

BBOX-023.cause: Bump schedule Group input is not configured correctly.
BBOX-023.remedy: Configure the Bump Schedule Group input to valid digital inputs.

BBOX-024.cause: Bump inputs are not configured correctly.
BBOX-024.remedy: Configure the Bump inputto valid digital inputs.

BBOX-025.cause: Bump Acknowledge offset output is not configured correctly.
BBOX-025.remedy: Configure the Bump Acknowledge offset output to a valid digital output.

BBOX-026.cause: Bump Limit error output is not configured correctly.
BBOX-026.remedy: Configure the Bump Error output to a valid digital output.

BBOX-027.cause: Bump schedule Lines in the are not correct.
BBOX-027.remedy: Set valid Line numbers in the Bump schedule.

BBOX-028.cause: Bump offset limit has been reached.
BBOX-028.remedy: 1. Review part placement or part specification. 2. Change the Bump limit to a higher value.

BBOX-029.cause: Two sequential points are too close.
BBOX-029.remedy: 1. Reteach one or more of the positions.

BBOX-030.cause: Bump schedule Program name does not exist.
BBOX-030.remedy: Use a correct Porgram name in the Bump schedule.

BBOX-031.cause: The Bump schedule Program has only 1 point.
BBOX-031.remedy: 1. This program cannot use Bumpbox. 2. Add another position to program.

BBOX-032.cause: Bump schedule Program has the write protect attribute ON.
BBOX-032.remedy: Edit the Bump schedule Program header to disable write protect.

BBOX-033.cause: The selected Bump schedule has no Program name assigned.
BBOX-033.remedy: 1. Use a valid Bump schedule. 2. Insert a Program name in the Bump schedule being used.

BBOX-034.cause: The Bump schedule Group number is not correct.
BBOX-034.remedy: Set the Bump schedule Group number to a valid group for your system.

BBOX-035.cause: The Bump schedule Group number is not a Robot group.
BBOX-035.remedy: Change the Bump schedule Group number to a Robot group.

BBOX-036.message: Group is not in group mask
BBOX-036.cause: The Bump schedule Group number does not exist in the Bump program.
BBOX-036.remedy: Set the Bump schedule Group number to a valid group for your program.

BBOX-037.cause: The Bump schedule Progeam has coordinated motion.

BBOX-038.cause: There is no CD_PAIR that matches the Bump Program group mask.
BBOX-038.remedy: 1. Define a CD_PAIR that includes the leader and follower in the program. 2. Review the Bump schedule Group number.

BBOX-039.message: CD leader and follower are robots
BBOX-039.cause: The leader group and the follower are robots.
BBOX-039.remedy: Bump operation is not permitted for robot to robot Coord Motion.

BBOX-040.message: CD leader grp change in bump path
BBOX-040.cause: The leader group in a coordinated motion program is changed.
BBOX-040.remedy: Change the Bump schedule lines to exclude the changed leader lines.

BBOX-042.message: Bump start line is circle VIA
BBOX-042.cause: Bump lines do not include circle START point
BBOX-042.remedy: Set the schedule 'Lines' to include the START point

BBOX-043.cause: CD and NON-CD positions are used to calculate unit vector
BBOX-043.remedy: Edit program so the first 2 positions are both CD or NON-CD moves.

BBOX-044.remedy: Train the position, or insert a number value in the instruction

BBOX-045.remedy: See cause alarm for more information

BBOX-046.message: Position regester will not be bumped
BBOX-046.cause: Position regester will not be bumped
BBOX-046.remedy: Replace position register with position if this point must be offset

BBOX-047.message: Too many positions in Bump Lines
BBOX-047.cause: Bump positions in this schedule exceed maximum.
BBOX-047.remedy: Reduce the Line parameter to include fewer positions.

BBOX-048.cause: The group in COORD[ldr] or COORD[R[#] is not correct.
BBOX-048.remedy: Change the value to a valid coordinated leader group.

BRCH-001.remedy: It is no need to remedy.

BRCH-002.cause: Abnormal brake was detected by brake check

BRCH-003.cause: The last brake check was failed, because the power was turned OFF during check.
BRCH-003.remedy: Please reset this alarm and re-execute brake check again.

BRCH-004.cause: An attempt was made to set a reference point for quick mastering, but calibration has not yet been completed.
BRCH-004.remedy: Perform calibration by following the procedure below. 1. Turn on the power. 2. Execute [CALIBRATION] from the calibration screen [6 SYSTEM Master/Cal].

BRCH-005.cause: Robot motion was detected after brake check got start,
BRCH-005.remedy: Please re-execute brake check again after the robot stops completely.

BRCH-006.remedy: Please crear away the cause of servo OFF, and reset to turn ON servo.

BRCH-007.cause: Update of the servo parameter is not finished yet.

BRCH-008.cause: Dual motor was being adjusted when brake check started.
BRCH-008.remedy: Please re-execute brake check after adjusting dual motor is finished.

BRCH-009.cause: $SCR_GRP[G].$FLEXTOOLTYP was not zero when brake check started.
BRCH-009.remedy: Please set $SCR_GRP[G].$FLEXTOOLTYP=0, and re-execute brake check.

BRCH-011.remedy: Please disable TP during brake check.

BRCH-012.remedy: Please set servo parameter No.152 with correct value.

BRCH-013.remedy: Please set $PARAM_GROUP[G].$MAX_AMP_CUR[A] with correct value, and cycle power.

BRCH-014.remedy: Please set $PARAM_GROUP[G].$STOPERLIM[A] with correct value, and cycle power.

BRCH-015.cause: The gravity torque is too large.
BRCH-015.remedy: Please move robot to posture that the gravity is not large.

BRCH-016.remedy: Please don't change $MRR_GRP[G].$SV_OFF_ENB[A] during brake check.

BRCH-017.cause: The torque limit was changed during brake check.
BRCH-017.remedy: Please don't change torque limit during brake check.

BRCH-018.cause: Arm bending control was enabled during brake check.
BRCH-018.remedy: Please don't enable arm bending control during brake check.

BRCH-019.cause: Brake check torque was limited by OVC level.
BRCH-019.remedy: This is just warning, so you can continue this check. But it is suggested to move robot to a posture in which the gravity is small.

BRCH-020.cause: 1.$BCCFG.$BCK_START was set to FALSE during brake check. 2.$BCCFG.$CHK_MODE was changed during brake check.
BRCH-020.remedy: 1.Please not to change $BCCFG.$BCK_START during brake check. This variable return to FALSE automatically after brake check finishes. 2.Please not to change $BCCFG.$CHK_MODE.

BRCH-021.remedy: Please don't change $MRR_GRP[G].$INPOS_TIME[A] during brake check.

BRCH-022.cause: The current position is near by the stroke limit.
BRCH-022.remedy: Please move away from the stroke limit and restart brake check.

CALM-000.cause: The TCP Mate motion was aborted because of an unexpected change of menu, or it was aborted by the user.

CALM-001.cause: A Form Operation Error occurred because the dictionary was not found.
CALM-001.remedy: Turn off the controller and turn it on again. If the error still exists, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CALM-002.cause: The system is not fully initalized.
CALM-002.remedy: Use the SETUP menu to set up all required variables.

CALM-003.cause: The TCP Mate motion cannot be started.
CALM-003.remedy: Clear all the errors before running TCP Mate motion.

CALM-004.cause: Not all positions in the reference menu are recorded.
CALM-004.remedy: Verify that all the positions in the menu have been recorded, and try the operation again.

CALM-005.cause: TCPMate cannot be executed without mastering the TCP first.
CALM-005.remedy: Display the reference menu, and press MASTER to run the reference motion first. Then try the operation again.

CALM-006.remedy: Record positions in the reference menu first. Then, try the operation again.

CALM-007.cause: The position cannot be recorded since the robot is not calibrated.
CALM-007.remedy: Calibrate the robot. Then, try the operation again.

CALM-008.cause: The home position must be recorded before recording other positions.
CALM-008.remedy: Record the home position. Then, try the operation again.

CALM-009.message: Keep same WPR as home pos.
CALM-009.cause: These positions require to have the same WPR as the home position.
CALM-009.remedy: Keep the same orientation (WPR) when recording these positions.

CALM-010.cause: The SHIFT key was not pressed.

CALM-011.cause: The destination position is not reachable.

CALM-012.cause: The robot cannot compute the circle due to a singularity.
CALM-012.remedy: Check and correct robot's mastering, and check the hardware. Try reteaching the position.

CALM-013.cause: The robot cannot converage to a solution.
CALM-013.remedy: Check and correct the robot's mastering. Check hardware. Try to reteach the position.

CALM-014.cause: The recorded positions are too close to each other.
CALM-014.remedy: Points should be at least 10 mm apart. Reteach the positions.

CALM-015.cause: The robot was in contact with the part before starting a search motion.
CALM-015.remedy: Reteach the starting position so that the robot is not in contact with the part before starting the search motion.

CALM-016.cause: No contact was made during the TCPMate motion.
CALM-016.remedy: Make sure the sensor and software are installed correctly.

CALM-017.cause: The enter/exit program names are not defined.
CALM-017.remedy: Display the SETUP menu to select teach pendant programs.

CALM-018.cause: An internal teach pendant program error has occurred.
CALM-018.remedy: Turn off the controller and turn it on again. If the error still exists, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CALM-019.cause: The circle fitting error is greater than expected.
CALM-019.remedy: Check hareware/tooling or increase the fit tolerance.

CALM-020.cause: The search motion can not be executed withtout TOS sensor.
CALM-020.remedy: Display the SETUP menu and select TOS in the Sensor Type.

CALM-021.cause: The robot cannot continue the paused motion.
CALM-021.remedy: Abort the paused motion and re-run TCPMate again.

CALM-022.cause: A CalMate internal error has occurred.
CALM-022.remedy: Turn off the controller and turn it on again. If the error still exists, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CALM-023.cause: The dictionary file is not loaded.
CALM-023.remedy: Turn off the controller and turn it on again. If the error still exists, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CALM-024.cause: No saved reference data exists for the current tool.
CALM-024.remedy: Set the reference motion for the current tool.

CALM-025.cause: The output file cannot be opened.
CALM-025.remedy: Check the path and file name of the output file.

CALM-026.cause: No recorded utool exists to save.

CALM-027.cause: The teach pendant program does not have enough stack size to run TCPMate automatically.
CALM-027.remedy: Display the TCPMATE main menu. TCPMate will update your teach pendant program stack size after you have displayed this menu. Leave the menu, and re-run the teach pendant program again.

CALM-028.cause: TCPMate cannot complete its operation successfully.
CALM-028.remedy: Check for a severely bent tool, or for loose hardware.

CALM-029.cause: Not all positions in the SETUP menu are recorded.
CALM-029.remedy: All positions in the menu must be recorded. Check the recorded positions and try the operation again.

CALM-030.cause: The center position is not within CalMate joint limits.
CALM-030.remedy: Re-teach a new center position with all joints atleast 45 degrees away from the limits.

CALM-031.cause: The new tcp mode has not been performed.
CALM-031.remedy: Set the adjust mode to the new tcp and run it once before running Mastering recovery mode.

CALM-032.remedy: Check for a severely bent tool or loose hardware.

CALM-033.cause: The Fit error is greater than expected.
CALM-033.remedy: Check for a severely loose tool or for loose hardware.

CALM-034.cause: The number of positions measured is less than required.
CALM-034.remedy: Record positions away from joint limits and sigularity positions in the Touch Plate menu.

CALM-035.cause: The move distance is set to less than 10 mm.
CALM-035.remedy: Enter a value greater than 10mm for the move distance.

CALM-036.cause: There is no data to restore.
CALM-036.remedy: Move the cursor to a valid data line, and press the F3 function key.

CALM-037.cause: The orientation point was not measured correctly and orientation will not be calculated.
CALM-037.remedy: Check and repair any loose server tools or loose hardware.

CD-001.cause: Coordinated Motion global variables are not loaded.
CD-001.remedy: Perform a controlled start and initialize motion softparts.

CD-002.cause: A failure occurred while allocating memory.
CD-002.remedy: Check amount of memory being used by the system.

CD-003.cause: Leader segment MMR number does not match that of the follower

CD-004.cause: Illegal Leader Interpolated Point Data is detected when trying to convert it to a transform

CD-005.cause: Coordinated Motion is used for a group which has not been SETUP for coordinated motion.
CD-005.remedy: Check motion statement. Perform Coordinated Motion SETUP and perform a COLD START.

CD-006.cause: JOINT MOTYPE was used for a follower during coordinated motion.
CD-006.remedy: Use LINEAR or CIRCULAR MOTYPE instead

CD-008.cause: There is no leader in the coordinated motion
CD-008.remedy: Check motion statement. Perform Coordinated Motion SETUP and then perform a COLD START.

CD-009.cause: There is more than one leader in the coordinated motion
CD-009.remedy: Check motion statement. Perform Coordinated Motion SETUP and then perform a COLD START.

CD-010.cause: Invalid Angle detected in Point Data
CD-010.remedy: Internal Error, call FANUC America Corporation.

CD-012.cause: Leader single group motion after coordinated motion not allowed
CD-012.remedy: Issue non-coordinated motion involving the follower group

CD-013.message: Jog group is not a leader
CD-013.cause: Attempt to perform coordinated jog with a non-leader group
CD-013.remedy: Select leader group for coordinated jog

CD-014.cause: Attempt to perform coordinated jog with a leader group which has multiple followers

CD-015.cause: WRIST JOINT Motion is not supported with coordinated motion

CD-016.cause: INCREMENTAL motion is not supported with coordinated motion

CD-017.cause: Independent motion is not supported with coordinated motion
CD-017.remedy: Change Independent motion to Simultaneous motion

CD-018.cause: Calibration for coordinated motion is not done
CD-018.remedy: Execute calibration of coordinated motion in SETUP screen

CD-019.cause: Number of follower is zero or two or greater on this motion
CD-019.remedy: Set number of follower correctly or set group mask correctly

CD-020.cause: Follower can not reach relative speed in program
CD-020.remedy: Teach follower and leader position again to reach relative speed

CD-021.cause: Attempt to perform coordinated motion with non-kinematics robot

CD-022.message: Prev term type is not FINE
CD-022.cause: Term type before coordinated motion is not Fine or CNT0
CD-022.remedy: Change term type before coordinated motion to FINE or CNT0 or JOINT motion

CD-023.cause: Setting of coordinated motion is not correct
CD-023.remedy: Check setting of coordinated motion in SETUP screen And set correctly

CD-024.cause: Teaching points is incorrect or Leader's mechanics is inaccurate
CD-024.remedy: Check the mechanics and reteach the points

CD-026.remedy: Add or remove motion option COORD.

CD-027.cause: Transition from one CD pair to another happens. But same follower group is used in both CD pair.
CD-027.remedy: Insert non coordinated motion between coordinated motion of different pair.

CD-028.cause: The speed of the TCP or Face Plate exceeded the T1 speed limit.
CD-028.remedy: Specify a slower speed or change to AUTO mode.

CD-029.cause: Cannot switch leader group while in coordinated motion.
CD-029.remedy: Use the same leader group number. Change the leader only when preceeded by a non-coordinated motion.

CD-034.cause: Cannot update CD_XF while robot is moving
CD-034.remedy: Let robot comes to stop first before trying to update CD_XF

CD-035.cause: Not a problem. Information only. CD_PAIR CD_XF is dynamically updated by CD_PAIR_C copy n of CD_XF

CD-039.cause: CD_XF of CD PAIR m Copy n successfully updated

CD-040.cause: The leader position type is not a legal type

CMND-001.cause: The specified directory can not be found.
CMND-001.remedy: Check the device and path that you entered. If none entered, check the system default device from the FILE Menu or from the KCL command, CHDIR.

CMND-002.cause: The specified file could not be found.
CMND-002.remedy: Check to make sure the file has been spelled correctly and that it exists. Also verify the device and path name are correct.

CMND-003.cause: The file already exists and could not be overwritten.
CMND-003.remedy: Make sure the overwrite option has been specified.

CMND-006.cause: A file cannot be copied to itself.
CMND-006.remedy: Change the name of the destination file so it is different from the source file.

CMND-010.cause: The source variable was not a position type when converting between a Cartesian and joint position.
CMND-010.remedy: The valid postion types are POSITION, JOINTPOS, XYZWPR, and XYZWPREXT.

CMND-011.cause: The destination variable was not a position type when converting between a Cartesian and joint position.
CMND-011.remedy: The valid postion types are POSITION, JOINTPOS, XYZWPR, and XYZWPREXT.

CMND-012.cause: The requested type code doesn't match the passed variable type.
CMND-012.remedy: Internal error. Insure that the type code matches the variable type.

CMND-013.cause: An attempt was made to compare two positions that are not the same type.
CMND-013.remedy: Both positions must be the same type. Convert one before comparing.

CMND-014.cause: Two positions were compared and found not to be equal.
CMND-014.remedy: The two positions were not equal within the specified tolerance. This could be a normal occurence. This warning is the logical opposite of SUCCESS.

CMND-015.cause: Both arguments to ATAN2 were zero or an internal error occurred when attempting to convert a POSITION to XYZWPR.
CMND-015.remedy: If calling ATAN2, insure that both arguments are not zero. If converting a POSITION, then it is not converable to an XYZWPR.

CMND-016.cause: An attempt was made to divide by zero.
CMND-016.remedy: This is an internal error. Insure that the divisor is not equal or close to zero.

CMND-017.cause: The rotational angle is to great.
CMND-017.remedy: Make sure that the rotational angle is no greater than 100 times PI, or about 314.15926...

CMND-018.cause: An invalid device or path has been specified.
CMND-018.remedy: Check the device and path that you entered. If none entered, check the system default device from the FILE Menu or from the KCL command, CHDIR.

CMND-019.cause: The operation was cancelled because CTRL-C or CTRL-Y was pressed.

CMND-020.remedy: This is a notification. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.

CMND-021.cause: The destination file name contained both alphanumeric characters and the global character '*'.
CMND-021.remedy: Use only alphanumeric characters or a single global character when renaming a file.

CMND-022.cause: A time-based motion was specified along with distance before.
CMND-022.remedy: Do not use these options in combination.

CMND-023.cause: No device or path has been specified for the destination.
CMND-023.remedy: Check the device and path that was provided. If none, provide a destination device or path

CMND-024.cause: The indicated system variable has invalid information. See the cause code regarding the cause.
CMND-024.remedy: Change the system variable entry, or provide a valid directory or device.

CMND-025.cause: This system has programs of FILE storage type. FILE programs are not part of the standard backup
CMND-025.remedy: Please back up these files via another mechanism

CMND-026.message: Addtion of file to ZIP file failed
CMND-026.cause: Addtion of file to was requested. But error happend in addition process
CMND-026.remedy: Confirm file to be added can be read successfully. Lack ot temporary memory

CMND-027.cause: ZIP file could not be closed successfully.
CMND-027.remedy: Lack of temporary memory can cause this error. Reduce usage of temporary memory If ZIP file is very large or include many files, create another ZIP file and try to add files to the file.

CMND-028.cause: Data cannot be read or extracted from ZIP file properly.
CMND-028.remedy: Confirm specified ZIP file exist. Confirm if the ZIP file is valid

CMND-029.message: Creation or update of ZIP file failed.
CMND-029.cause: ZIP file processing failed and creation or update of ZIP file failed.
CMND-029.remedy: Please check file device is available. If output file already exist, it should not be write protected.

CMND-030.remedy: Please check file device is available. Please check ZIP file is valid. It may be broken. If output file already exist, it should not be write protected.

CMND-031.cause: Specified file was not found in ZIP file.
CMND-031.remedy: Please check string to specify file(s) to be extracted is corrrect. Please check ZIP file is the ZIP file you want to decompress.

CNTR-001.cause: Continuous Turn global variables are not loaded.
CNTR-001.remedy: Perform a controlled start and initialize motion softparts.

CNTR-002.cause: This is an internal system error.
CNTR-002.remedy: Perform a cold start on the controller.

CNTR-003.cause: This is an internal system error.
CNTR-003.remedy: Perform a cold start on the controller.

CNTR-004.cause: This is an internal system error.
CNTR-004.remedy: Perform a controlled start and initialize the motion softparts.

CNTR-005.cause: The continuous turn axis that was selected is not a valid cont. turn axis, or cn_gear_n1 or cn_gear_n2 have a zero value
CNTR-005.remedy: Check Continuous turn axis, cn_gear_n1, and cn_gear_n2 Select different continuous turn axis and/or set correct gear ratio for continuous turn axis.

CNTR-006.cause: A failure occured while allocating memory.
CNTR-006.remedy: Check amount of memory being used by the system.

CNTR-007.remedy: Record error and report to hotline

CNTR-008.cause: Invalid destination angle during linear motion. Incompatibility with Continuous Turn and other options.
CNTR-008.remedy: Check compatibility of motion options. Remove other options.

CNTR-009.cause: Continuous turn axis velocity is too high. cn_turn_no will not be valid because of high rotational speed.
CNTR-009.remedy: Lower contaxisvel. This warning may be ignored if cn_turn_no is not used.

CNTR-010.cause: Continuous turn is not compatible with independent extended axes The Ind.EV motion option is not allowed.
CNTR-010.remedy: Remove Ind.EV option or disable continuous turn on the group

CNTR-011.cause: Programmed motion exceeds the speed limits on the continuous turn axis. Speed limit is 180 degrees per ITP time
CNTR-011.remedy: Lower the speed either through KAREL or Teach Pendant

CNTR-012.message: Ending Cont Rot on Rel Motion
CNTR-012.cause: Attempted to end Continuous Rotation with a Relative Motion
CNTR-012.remedy: Continuous Rotation must be ended with an absolution motion Use an absolution motion to end continuous rotation

CNTR-013.cause: The program robot group number does not match the robot group number in the frame setup.

CNTR-014.remedy: Please check CTS frame number in the CTS group's $CN_CTS_GRP system variable.

CNTR-015.cause: The CTS frame is not been calibrated.
CNTR-015.remedy: Please go to continuous turn setup menu to calibrated the CTS frame.

CNTR-016.cause: The TP program's continuous turn axis group number does match with the frame setup data.
CNTR-016.remedy: Please check the CTS frame setup to match the continuous axis group number with the TP program's group number.

CNTR-017.cause: This is an internal system error.
CNTR-017.remedy: Perform a cold start on the controller.

CNTR-018.remedy: The allowed pitch distance is from 0.5 mm to 500 mm

CNTR-019.cause: CTS option requires mutliple groups in a controller with at least one group has a continuous turn axis.

CNTR-020.cause: Invalid welding speed. Speed range is from 0.5 mm/sec to 500 mm/sec.

CNTR-021.cause: CTS does not allows deg/sec or time based speed unit.
CNTR-021.remedy: Please change the speed unit on the CTV motion line.

CNTR-022.cause: Position recording requires hold down the shift key.
CNTR-022.remedy: Please hold SHIFT key and press F3 to record position

CNTR-023.cause: Positions are recorded too close to each other.

CNTR-024.cause: Do not have enought recorded positions to establish a frame

CNTR-025.cause: Cannot compute a circle using the taught positions.

CNTR-026.cause: The continuous turn axis has not been setup yet.
CNTR-026.remedy: Pleae setup continuous turn axis first.

CNTR-027.cause: Please set CTV0 to use CTS speed control function.

CNTR-028.cause: Continuous turn axis can not be specified as an argument of calibnbt.
CNTR-028.remedy: Please check the setting of the countinuous turn axis

COND-001.remedy: Check for condition statements to verify if the specified condition has really been created or not.

COND-002.cause: The specified condition number already exists in the system, and has been superseded by the new condition.
COND-002.remedy: This is just a notification, and you do not have to do anything for this warning message.

COND-003.cause: The specified condition is already enabled. No change has been made.
COND-003.remedy: This is just a notification, and you do not have to do anything for this warning message.

COND-004.cause: The specified condition is already disabled. No change has been made.
COND-004.remedy: This is just a notification, and you do not have to do anything for this warning message.

COND-005.cause: No more conditions are defined for the specified task.

COND-010.cause: Specified condition already exists. Condition was not superseded. May indicate two condition handlers for the same task with the same condition handler.
COND-010.remedy: Either renumber the condition handler or avoid re-defining the same condition handler.

COND-011.cause: There are too many conditions defined. It took too long to scan them all.

COPT-001.cause: The system was not able to setup the message packet to send to the PC.
COPT-001.remedy: System probably out of memory. Cold start.

COPT-002.message: Add PC Uninit prog or var name
COPT-002.cause: An ADD PC buffer built-in was called with a parameter that is uninitialized.
COPT-002.remedy: All parameters must have a value when calling the create a data buffer to PC built-ins.

COPT-003.cause: The variable requested in the ADD Byname or Send SysVar routines does not exist.
COPT-003.remedy: Check program and variable name spellings. Check variable data type. Only integer, real and string data is supported.

COPT-004.message: Add PC Var type not supported
COPT-004.cause: The variable requested in the ADD Byname or Send SysVar routines is of a data type that is not supported.
COPT-004.remedy: Check variable data type. Only integer, real and string data is supported. Check program and variable name spellings.

COPT-005.message: Add PC illegal index into buffer
COPT-005.cause: An ADD PC buffer built-in was called with the index parameter set too big or too small.
COPT-005.remedy: Set the index parameter correctly. Make sure the data buffer is big enough for your data.

COPT-006.cause: The data could not be copied to the data buffer because the buffer is too small.
COPT-006.remedy: Make sure the data buffer is big enough for your data. If there is too much data to send, you might have to use more than one event to send the data.

COPT-007.cause: An ADD PC buffer built-in was called with a parameter that is uninitialized.
COPT-007.remedy: All parameters must have a value when calling the create a data buffer to PC built-ins.

COPT-008.cause: A Send PC built-in was called with a parameter that is uninitialized.
COPT-008.remedy: All parameters must have a value when calling the send PC built-ins.

COPT-009.cause: An event number less that 0 or greater than 255 was used.
COPT-009.remedy: Use an event number from 0 to 255.

COPT-010.cause: Only wait flags of 0 or 1 are allowed.

COPT-011.message: Send_PC Buffer too big for packet
COPT-011.cause: The maximum data buffer size supported is 244 bytes.
COPT-011.remedy: Use a legal data buffer size.

COPT-020.cause: A system error occurred when trying to send the data buffer to the PC.
COPT-020.remedy: Check other alarms in alarm log for details.

COPT-021.cause: A Send to PC MACRO was called with a parameter that is illegal. The parameter is uninitialized or the wrong data type.
COPT-021.remedy: Check the MACRO call in the TP program.

COPT-022.cause: Status message only. A controller task is waiting for an event flag back from the PC.

COPT-023.cause: A controller task waited too long for an event flag from the PC. The controller task was aborted.

COPT-024.cause: Status message only. A controller task was waiting for an event flag back from the PC. The PC is taking too long. The controller task has continued without receiving the event flag.

COPT-025.cause: Status message only. The PC set the event flag and the controller task is contining.

COPT-026.cause: A system timer cannot be created or set for this controller task.

COPT-027.remedy: Check if the register is defined and if it has the right value. Must ABORT ALL and retry

COPT-028.cause: This is just a debug message

COPT-029.message: Macro Table too small for send option
COPT-029.cause: The MACRO table must have at least 60 elements for the SEND PC MACRO option to be installed properly.

COPT-030.remedy: Check other alarm log errors for more details.

COPT-031.message: Send Macro - no data to send
COPT-031.cause: The Send Data PC MACRO was not given any data to send.

COPT-032.cause: The wait action parameter must be 0 through 3.

COPT-033.cause: A send PC MACRO was called with a parameter that is uninitialized.
COPT-033.remedy: All parameters must have a value.

COPT-034.cause: A MACRO was called without a parameter that must be entered.
COPT-034.remedy: Check the MACRO call in the TP program.

COPT-035.cause: An error occurred in the TP program.

COPT-036.cause: A MACRO was called with a parameter that is illegal. The parameter has the wrong data type.
COPT-036.remedy: Check the MACRO call in the TP program.

COPT-040.message: PR[%s] Invalid posn for limit set
COPT-040.cause: Limit set did not use this PR[] to calculate limits. Refer to cause code for more information.

COPT-041.cause: Limit set found this PR[] used in the program.

CPMO-001.cause: An internal error occurred in the Constant Path PLAN module. This class of error should not be encountered during normal operation.
CPMO-001.remedy: The system might have been corrupted. This might have been caused by any of a number of reasons including: Incorrect loading and setup, loading incompatible options, mixing software version when adding options and other memory corruption problems. The following is a list of possible remedies: 1. Perform a Cold start. 2. Perform an init start and set up the robot again 3. Confirm that any options or additional software not on the original software distribution media is the same version number. If the main system software was supplied on several disks or memory cards, make sure that you are using a matched set. Also make sure that the installation manual being used is for this version of software. If any of the software versions are not matched, a complete re-load with the correct software will be necessary. 4. Confirm that no incompatible or mutually exclusive options has been loaded. 5. Perform a full software reload. 6. If the error is not cleared, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CPMO-065.cause: Internal Error: At resume stoppos mis-synch among groups

CPMO-095.remedy: Increase $cp_paramgrp[].$jnt_vel_lim[], $cp_paramgrp[].$jnt_acc_lim[], or $cp_paramgrp[].$jnt_jrk_lim[] for the affected group and axis. Abort the program and trythe operation again. CPMO-096.remedy: Abort the program and try the operation again. Document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CPMO-100.cause: CP does not support forward resume offset.

CPMO-101.cause: Could not reach the desired resume offset because the distance exceeded the available time buffer.
CPMO-101.remedy: Try the following: • Reduce resume offset. • Increase move speed. • Increase the JBF size.

CPMO-102.cause: Could not reach desired resume offset because the distance exceeded the buffer limit.
CPMO-102.remedy: 1. Increase $CPCFG.$RSM_OFST_ITP. 2. Reduce resume offset. 3. Increase the move speed.

CPMO-103.cause: Could not reach the desired resume offset because the offset was limited by another group.
CPMO-103.remedy: Try the following: • Remove the limitation on the other group. • Reduce the resume offset. • Increase the move speed. • Increase te JBF size.

CPMO-104.cause: A prior resume offset position was reused because a second hold occurred before the prior stop position was reached. This occurred during the resume motion.
CPMO-104.remedy: None. This prevents indefinite resume offsets with repeated hold/resume.

CPMO-105.message: Rsm Ofst Coord Sync Fail G: %d^2
CPMO-105.cause: The coordinated groups for resume offset could not be synchronized. The path might deviate from the taught positions.

CPMO-130.cause: T1 speed exceeds 250 mm/sec for this group.
CPMO-130.remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CPMO-135.message: NO CR allowed in this region
CPMO-135.cause: Corner Region is not allowed in this block.
CPMO-135.remedy: Remove Corner Region and use CNT.

CPMO-136.message: NO PSPD allowed in this region
CPMO-136.cause: Process Speed is not allowed in this application block.

CPMO-137.message: NO mspd allowed in this region
CPMO-137.cause: max_speed is not allowed in this application block.

CPMO-138.message: NO LD allowed in this region
CPMO-138.cause: AP_LD and RT_LD are not allowed in this application block.
CPMO-138.remedy: Remove the AP_LD or RT_LD option.

CPMO-139.cause: The specified CR value was too big to achieve since the actual CR value is limited by either CNT100 corner path or half-distance of involved segments. This is only a warning message.
CPMO-139.remedy: Use a higher programmed speed, or use ACCxx, xx<100.

CPMO-140.message: NO CD allowed in this region
CPMO-140.cause: Corner Distance is not allowed in this block.

CPMO-160.cause: Constant Path resume is not possible due to deceleration past cursor line. This is a limitation of spec behavior to prevent slowdown in normal program execution, and is expected.

CPMO-161.cause: Unexpected failure of Start4. Please log debug data and report the issue
CPMO-161.remedy: Reset and resume again. Resume will not be on constant path.

CPMO-199.cause: CP does NOT support Simultaneous GP or Independent GP motions.

If the error still occurs, document the events that led to the error and contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CVIS-004.remedy: Change the file name or, if using removable media such as a memory card, change the media.

CVIS-005.remedy: Make sure you are attempting to access the correct file. If the file is on media which has a read/write lock, and you are attempting to write or modify the file, make sure the lock is off.

CVIS-006.cause: Not enough space exists on the media.
CVIS-006.remedy: Free up space on the existing media by deleting unused files, or switch to a larger or emptier media.

CVIS-030.message: The model pattern is not trained.
CVIS-030.cause: The model pattern is not trained.
CVIS-030.remedy: Train the model pattern, and retry the operation.

CVIS-031.message: There are not enough features in the training window.
CVIS-031.cause: There are not enough features in the image to train the model pattern.
CVIS-031.remedy: Use another part of the image as the model. Or, teach a model using another image by taking it after adjusting the exposure time so that the contrast becomes high.

CVIS-032.remedy: Document the events that led to the error and contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CVIS-033.cause: The system could not find the object within the time limit.
CVIS-033.remedy: In the Geometric Pattern Match (GPM) Tool Setup screen, check if you have the Orientation, Scale, or Aspect Ratio degrees of freedom enabled. If so, reduce the maximums and/or increase the minimums and try to find again. If it still fails, disable one or more degrees of freedom. Increase the allowable processing time. Alternatively, make one of the following adjustments so as to decrease the required processing time. • Use a complex geometry as the model. • Uncheck the orientation, scale, and aspect ratio check boxes whichever are unnecessary. • Specify a larger score threshold. • Specify a larger contrast threshold. • Narrow the orientation, scale, and aspect ratio search ranges. • Reduce the size of the search window.

CVIS-034.message: The emphasis area is not trained.
CVIS-034.cause: The emphasis area is not trained.
CVIS-034.remedy: Train the emphasis area, or configure the tool not to use emphasis area.

CVIS-035.message: The emphasis area is too large.
CVIS-035.cause: The emphasis area is too large to train.
CVIS-035.remedy: Train a smaller area as the emphasis area.

CVIS-036.message: The emphasis area is too small.
CVIS-036.cause: The emphasis area is too small and does not contain enough features to train.
CVIS-036.remedy: Train a larger area as the emphasis area.

CVIS-037.message: The model pattern is not symmetrical.
CVIS-037.cause: For a non-rotatable model, an attempt was made to have the model origin automatically set by clicking the Center Origin button.
CVIS-037.remedy: The model origin of a non-rotatable model cannot be set automatically by clicking the Center Origin button. Use the Set Origin button to set the model origin.

CVIS-038.cause: There is not enough memory to perform the detection with the specified condition. The image has too many candidate patterns to find.
CVIS-038.remedy: In the Geometric Pattern Match (GPM) Tool SETUP screen, check if you have the Orientation, Scale, or Aspect Ratio degrees of freedom enabled. If so, reduce the maximums and/or increase the minimums and try to find again. If it still fails, disable one or more degrees of freedom. Make the following adjustments to reduce the search candidates: • Use a complex geometry as the model. • Of Orientation, Scale, and Aspect Ratio, uncheck the unnecessary items. • Specify a larger score threshold. • Specify a larger contrast threshold. • Narrow the search ranges for Orientation, Scale, and Aspect Ratio. • Reduce the size of the search window.

CVIS-039.message: The mask doesn't fit the model pattern.
CVIS-039.remedy: Document the events that led to the error and contact your FANUC technical representative.

CVIS-040.message: The mask doesn't fit the search window.
CVIS-040.remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

CVIS-041.cause: The version of the file is too new to load.

CVIS-042.cause: The GPM tool data in the file is corrupted.

CVIS-043.message: The search window is too small.

CVIS-044.cause: Allocated time filter size is too small.
CVIS-044.remedy: Reboot controller for larger time filter size

CVIS-045.cause: The difference between channel previous input and current input is not eligible under local hold

CVIS-046.remedy: Report the problem and then reset

CVIS-050.cause: The exposure time is out of range.
CVIS-050.remedy: Set it in the range from 0.04 ms to 250 ms.

CVIS-051.cause: No laser measurement area has been set up or a set laser measurement area is too small.
CVIS-051.remedy: Re-teach a measurement area. The minimum allowable laser measurement area is 8 pixels in both height and width. If it is necessary to measure laser beams in a smaller area, increase the size of the measurement area and then limit it by setting up a mask.

CVIS-052.remedy: Make sure that 3D laser sensor calibration data has been selected.

CVIS-053.cause: Measured laser spots did not converge at one point.
CVIS-053.remedy: The probable causes are that the calibration data is incorrect, or within the measurement range the height of a workpiece differs largely from that of another workpiece.

CVIS-054.cause: No straight line was found from a string of laser spots.
CVIS-054.remedy: First, adjust the setting of exposure so that an appropriate laser image can be obtained. Next, make sure that the laser measurement area was taught properly. If the pattern match model origin is changed after the laser measurement area has been taught, it is likely that the laser measurement area might move to an unintended position during execution. If you changed the model origin, re-set the laser measurement area. If these methods cannot solve the problem, adjust the detection parameter for the string of laser spots.

CVIS-055.message: Not enough laser points for calculation.
CVIS-055.cause: The number of found laser spots is not larger than the threshold.
CVIS-055.remedy: First, adjust the setting of exposure so that an appropriate laser image can be obtained. Next, make sure that the laser measurement area was taught properly. If the pattern match model origin is changed after the laser measurement area has been taught, it is likely that the laser measurement area may move to an unintended position during execution. If you changed the model origin, re-set the laser measurement area. If these methods cannot solve the problem, adjust the detection parameter for the string of laser spots. Alternatively, enabling the [Search narrow area] function can increase the number of laser spots even if the measurement area remains the same.

CVIS-056.cause: No plane was found during laser measurement.
CVIS-056.remedy: First, adjust the setting of exposure so that an appropriate laser image can be obtained. Next, make sure that the laser measurement area was taught properly. If the pattern match model origin is changed after the laser measurement area has been taught, it is likely that the laser measurement area may move to an unintended position during execution. If you changed the model origin, re-set the laser measurement area. If these methods cannot solve the problem, adjust the detection parameter for the string of laser spots.

CVIS-057.message: Zero vector is used in calculation.

CVIS-059.remedy: If this tilting of the workpiece is permissible, increase the setting. Otherwise, eject the workpiece. Alternatively, make adjustments so that the tilting of the workpiece will fall within the setting.

CVIS-060.cause: No features are found in the image.
