CVIS-163.remedy: Set the reference position for the tool offset.

CVIS-164.message: No robot position for robot mounted camera
CVIS-164.cause: In the case of robot a mounted camera, the robot position is needed to compute the part position. However, the robot position is not set. Maybe the image is loaded from a file.
CVIS-164.remedy: Snap the image from a camera.

CVIS-165.message: No robot position for tool offset
CVIS-165.cause: In case of tool offset, the robot position is needed to compute the part position. However, the robot position is not set. Maybe the image is loaded from a file.
CVIS-165.remedy: Snap the image from a camera.

CVIS-166.cause: The 60-day use period of the iRVision demo version has expired.
CVIS-166.remedy: In order to continue using iRVision, you must restart the controller in Controlled Start mode, enter the Option menu, and enter the necessary PAC code(s) for the iRVision option(s) you require. NOTE: You MUST also enter a PAC code for the iRVision Demo option. To purchase PAC codes for iRVision options, including the iRVision Demo option, contact FANUC America Corporation Spare Parts. For further instructions on authorizing options using PAC codes, please refer to the Software Installation Manual.

CVIS-167.message: Target Controller is too old to communicate
CVIS-167.cause: The target controller is too old to communicate.
CVIS-167.remedy: Update the software of the target controller.

CVIS-168.remedy: Check the target controller power and networks.

CVIS-169.message: Object is not found in some camera view(s).
CVIS-169.cause: The offset cannot be computed because the object is not found in some camera views.
CVIS-169.remedy: Modify parameters to find the object properly, then click Snap+Find to find the object.

CVIS-170.cause: Calculating a compensation value resulted in the misalignment becoming equal to or greater than the permissible value.
CVIS-170.remedy: Check the found result of each camera view and make sure that no mal-detection occurred. If no mal-detection occurred, make adjustments, using the program's combined error limit.

CVIS-172.message: Robot Pos(Z) is different from Calib Pos.
CVIS-172.cause: The robot position(Z) is different from the position to calibrate the camera.
CVIS-172.remedy: The robot position(Z) must be the same as the position to calibrate the camera.

CVIS-173.message: Robot Pos(WP) is different from Calib Pos.
CVIS-173.cause: The robot position(WP) is different from the position to calibrate the camera.
CVIS-173.remedy: The robot position(WP) must be the same as the position to calibrate the camera.

CVIS-174.message: Robot Pos(Z) is different from Reference Pos.
CVIS-174.cause: The robot position(Z) is different from the position to set the reference data.
CVIS-174.remedy: The robot position(Z) must be the same as the position to set the reference data.

CVIS-175.message: Robot Pos(WP) is different from Reference Pos.
CVIS-175.cause: The robot position(WP) is different from the position to set the reference data.
CVIS-175.remedy: The robot position(WP) must be same as the position to set the reference data.

CVIS-176.message: Application-Z has been changed after SetRef.
CVIS-176.cause: Application-Z has been changed after setting the reference data.

CVIS-177.cause: An error occurred in this camera view.
CVIS-177.remedy: Check another error posted at the same time, and correct the setting of the camera view.

CVIS-178.cause: No application data has been selected.

CVIS-179.cause: The specified application data was not found.
CVIS-179.remedy: Check whether the specified application data exists and enter the correct data.

CVIS-180.message: No images found for image playback.
CVIS-180.cause: No images were found for image playback for the selected date. If you have selected to use only images for the current vision process, there might be images for the selected date that were logged for other processes.
CVIS-180.remedy: Verify that the log folder corresponding to the selected date contains the images you are expecting. If so, select to use all images for the selected date.

CVIS-181.cause: Image Playback has reached the end date/time limit. This is an internal error.
CVIS-181.remedy: Document the events that led to the error and contact your FANUC technical representative.

CVIS-182.remedy: Change the VOFFSET type. Verify if your teach pendant program or KAREL program unexpectedly changed the offset type in the vision register.

CVIS-183.cause: The Vision Board does not exist.

CVIS-184.cause: GET_OFFSET command is conflicted. This is an internal error.
CVIS-184.remedy: Check the teach pendant program logic. Document the events that led to the error and contact your FANUC technical representative.

CVIS-185.cause: No visual tracking option is ordered.

CVIS-186.cause: No line tracking option is ordered.

CVIS-187.remedy: Check the index value and offset type of VR.[]

CVIS-188.remedy: Check index value and offset type of VR[].

CVIS-189.cause: Vision register is also locked by LOCK PREG command.
CVIS-189.remedy: Unlock vision register to use UNLOCK PREG command.

CVIS-190.message: Only 1 vision tool (GPM, Histogram, etc.) allowed at this level. Delete the existing tool before adding a new one.
CVIS-190.cause: The error proofing vision process accepts only one command tool to be inserted.
CVIS-190.remedy: Delete the existing tool before adding a new one.

CVIS-191.message: The comment string has been truncated to '%s'.
CVIS-191.cause: The specified comment string was too long, and has automatically been truncated.
CVIS-191.remedy: Review the truncated comment string and edit, if necessary.

CVIS-192.message: The system is low on temporary memory and cannot open the vision process setup page.
CVIS-192.cause: The amount of temporary memory available on the robot is currently low, so the specified vision setup page was not opened.
CVIS-192.remedy: Please contact FANUC America Corporation if you receive this error. Notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation mode, etc.) during which the error occurred.

CVIS-193.message: The maximum number of setup pages are already open. A vision process setup page must be closed before another can be opened.
CVIS-193.cause: You have opened the maximum allowed number of vision setup pages.
CVIS-193.remedy: Close any vision setup pages that do not need to remain open.

CVIS-194.message: The sorting parameters are not completely defined. Please select all sorting parameters.
CVIS-194.cause: The sorting parameters have not been completely defined for the vision process.
CVIS-194.remedy: Select and specify all of the available sorting parameters.

CVIS-195.message: The sorting parameters are now invalid.\n They have been reset to the default values.

CVIS-196.message: Another setup page '%s' is already in live mode.\n Exit live mode in the other setup page first.
CVIS-196.cause: You have tried to enable live mode in a setup page when another setup page was already in live mode. Live mode is only supported in one setup page at a time.
CVIS-196.remedy: Stop live mode in the other setup page first.

CVIS-197.cause: The vision tool with the specified name does not exist.
CVIS-197.remedy: Check if the specified vision tool exists, and select the correct name.

CVIS-198.cause: The calculated layer value exceeded threshold limit.

CVIS-199.message: Layer output number is used elsewhere
CVIS-199.cause: Layer output number is used by measurement output.

CVIS-200.message: The camera calibration tool is not trained.
CVIS-200.cause: The camera calibration has not been trained.

CVIS-201.message: The camera calibration tool is corrupted.
CVIS-201.cause: The calibration data might be corrupted.

CVIS-202.message: The camera calibration tool is corrupted.
CVIS-202.cause: No calibration points have been found on one or more calibration planes.

CVIS-203.cause: An invalid calibration plane number is passed to the CAMERA_CALIB command.
CVIS-203.remedy: Enter the correct plane number to the CAMERA_CALIB command.

CVIS-204.message: Either camera or fixture needs to be mounted on a robot.
CVIS-204.cause: Either the camera or fixture needs to be mounted on a robot for 2-plane calibration.
CVIS-204.remedy: Mount either the camera or fixture on a robot, and retry the operation.

CVIS-205.message: Both camera and fixture should not be mounted on a robot.
CVIS-205.cause: Both the camera and fixture should not be mounted on robots.
CVIS-205.remedy: Fix either the camera or fixture on a table or other sturdy surface.

CVIS-206.message: No robot position for robot mounted camera.
CVIS-206.cause: The position of the robot holding the camera is unknown.
CVIS-206.remedy: You need to snap an image from the camera instead of loading an image file.

CVIS-207.message: No robot position for robot mounted fixture.
CVIS-207.cause: The position of the robot holding fixture is unknown.
CVIS-207.remedy: You need to snap an image from the camera instead of loading an image from a file.

CVIS-208.message: No robot position for robot mounted fixture.
CVIS-208.cause: The index of the calibration point is out of range.
CVIS-208.remedy: Type a correct index of the calibration point.

CVIS-209.message: The calibration points are too close to each other.
CVIS-209.cause: Simple 2-D calibration error. Calibration data cannot be calculated because the two calibration points are too close to each other.
CVIS-209.remedy: Teach two points that are farther apart.

CVIS-210.message: The calibration points are too close to each other.
CVIS-210.cause: The robot position is needed when the fixture is mounted on a robot. However, the robot position is not set. This alarm might occur when you are using an image loaded from a file.
CVIS-210.remedy: Snap the image from a camera to use a real-world image.

CVIS-211.message: The calibration points are too close to each other.
CVIS-211.cause: The plane specified in the CAMERA_CALIB is disabled.
CVIS-211.remedy: Enable the calibration plane, or pass another index to the CAMERA_CALIB.

CVIS-212.message: No robot position for robot mounted camera.
CVIS-212.cause: The robot position at calibration is needed for the robot-mounted camera.
CVIS-212.remedy: You cannot use an image file for calibration of robot-mounted camera. Snap a new image from a camera instead of loading image file.

CVIS-213.message: Robot positions for two points must be the same.
CVIS-213.cause: The calibration points must be set with the same camera position.
CVIS-213.remedy: Do not move the robot holding the camera during the calibration.

CVIS-214.cause: No calibration data was calculated for the 3D laser sensor.

CVIS-215.cause: No calibration data was calculated for the 3D laser sensor.

CVIS-216.cause: No laser measurement area has been set up.

CVIS-217.remedy: Snap an image using the Snap button.

CVIS-218.message: No found pose of parent locator tool.
CVIS-218.cause: The parent tool of the associate tool has not been found.
CVIS-218.remedy: Check whether the target is within the camera view. Adjust the parent tool parameters and model so that the parent tool can be found normally.

CVIS-219.cause: There is a histogram tool yet to be taught.
CVIS-219.remedy: Teach all histogram tools or delete the unnecessary tool yet to be taught.

CVIS-220.message: Histogram tool: Fail to get reference position.
CVIS-220.cause: An internal histogram tool error has occurred.
CVIS-220.remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CVIS-221.message: Histogram tool: Fail to set reference position.
CVIS-221.cause: An internal histogram error has occurred.
CVIS-221.remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CVIS-222.cause: A child tool is not trained.
CVIS-222.remedy: Train all of the child tools.

CVIS-223.message: Conditional Execution: Fail to set measurement.
CVIS-223.cause: An internal histogram tool error has occurred.
CVIS-223.remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CVIS-224.message: Camera is not parallel to Z axis of UF.
CVIS-224.cause: The camera is not parallel to the Z axis of the User Frame.

CVIS-225.cause: The conditional execution tool is not trained.

CVIS-226.message: Conditional Execution: Fail to get value.
CVIS-226.cause: Measurements are not set, or an invalid measurement is set.
CVIS-226.remedy: Train measurements on the Conditional Execution SETUP screen.

CVIS-227.message: No found pose of parent locator tool.
CVIS-227.cause: A condition judgment tool error has occurred.
CVIS-227.remedy: An attempt to find a parent tool failed. Adjust the exposure setting so that an appropriate image can be taken and the parent tool can be found, or adjust the detection parameter.

CVIS-228.message: The calibration planes are too close.
CVIS-228.cause: The calibration planes are too close.
CVIS-228.remedy: The calibration planes must be apart from each other.

CVIS-229.cause: The Model ID of a found part is different from the one of the selected reference data.
CVIS-229.remedy: Place a part for the model ID in view of the camera.

CVIS-230.remedy: Set the reference scales in advance.

CVIS-231.message: Identical reference values exist for different Z.
CVIS-231.cause: Two reference scales must be different for different application Z values.
CVIS-231.remedy: Set reference scales with the different application Z values.

CVIS-232.message: No robot position for reference scale is set.
CVIS-232.cause: No robot position is set for the reference scale. The current reference scale would be set with the camera on the robot disabled.
CVIS-232.remedy: Set reference scale with the camera on the robot enabled.

CVIS-233.message: Robot pose must not be changed.
CVIS-233.cause: The robot position must be the same as the one when you set the reference scales.
CVIS-233.remedy: Run the vision process with the same robot position.

CVIS-234.cause: A Robot-mounted camera is not supported in visual tracking.
CVIS-234.remedy: Change the camera setup to use a fixed camera.

CVIS-235.message: Encoder count is not consistent with the current image.
CVIS-235.cause: The encoder count is not consistent with the current image.

CVIS-236.message: Encoder count of this robot is different from that of another robot.
CVIS-236.cause: The encoder count of this robot is different from one of the other robots.
CVIS-236.remedy: Turn all of the robots off and then on again.

CVIS-237.message: The points are too close together to calculate the frame.
CVIS-237.cause: The points are too close together to calculate the frame.
CVIS-237.remedy: Touch points that are farther apart.

CVIS-238.cause: GET_QUEUE is executed twice in the programs.
CVIS-238.remedy: Modify your teach pendant programs not to call GET_QUEUE twice.

CVIS-239.message: Invalid timing mode for visual tracking.
CVIS-239.cause: The specified timing mode is incorrect.
CVIS-239.remedy: Check that the correct timing mode was specified in the visual tracking environment setting.

CVIS-240.cause: The vision location was not completed before the conveyor moved through the specified distance.
CVIS-240.remedy: Make the conveyor slower or the conveyor travel distance longer in the visual tracking environment setting.

CVIS-241.message: No found pose of parent locator tool.
CVIS-241.cause: The parent location tool for an associate tool has not been found.
CVIS-241.remedy: Adjust the parameter and model so that the parent location tool can be found.

CVIS-242.cause: There is a length measurement tool yet to be taught.

CVIS-243.message: Caliper tool: Fail to get reference position.
CVIS-243.remedy: Document the events that led to the error and contact your FANUC technical representative.

CVIS-244.message: Caliper tool: Fail to set reference position.
CVIS-244.remedy: Document the events that led to the error and contact your FANUC technical representative.

CVIS-245.message: Blob Locator tool: Fail to get reference position.
CVIS-245.remedy: Document the events that led to the error and contact your FANUC technical representative.

CVIS-246.message: No found pose of parent locator tool.
CVIS-246.cause: The parent location tool failed to find the part.
CVIS-246.remedy: Modify parameters of the parent location tool before training the child tool.

CVIS-247.message: There are not any blobs in the training window.
CVIS-247.cause: There are not any blobs in the training window.
CVIS-247.remedy: Train another part of the image, or use another image.

CVIS-248.cause: The register number is not specified so the software cannot get the application Z value.
CVIS-248.remedy: Set the register number in which the application Z value is set.

CVIS-250.message: This robot received packet from robot with the different software series
CVIS-250.cause: This robot received a packet from a robot with a different software series.
CVIS-250.remedy: Use the same software series for all robots.

CVIS-251.message: The distance between reference positions is too small
CVIS-251.cause: The distance between reference positions is too small.
CVIS-251.remedy: Change the Minimum distance between reference positions.

CVIS-252.message: The range maximum value must be greater than or equal to the minimum.
CVIS-252.cause: You have entered a maximum value for the range that is less than the minimum value.
CVIS-252.remedy: Enter a maximum value that is greater than the minimum value.

CVIS-253.message: The range minimum value must be less than or equal to the maximum.
CVIS-253.cause: You have entered a minimum value for the range that is greater than the maximum value.
CVIS-253.remedy: Enter a minimum value that is less than the maximum value.

CVIS-254.message: AckQueue with invalid vision register number
CVIS-254.cause: The returned part is different from the part which was in the queue previously.
CVIS-254.remedy: The last part retrieved by the GET_QUEUE instruction can be returned to the queue.

CVIS-255.message: No found pose of parent locator tool.
CVIS-255.cause: No found position of the parent tool.
CVIS-255.remedy: Adjust parameters of the parent tool.

CVIS-256.message: GPM Locator tool: Fail to get reference position.
CVIS-256.cause: A failure to get the reference position has occurred.
CVIS-256.remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CVIS-257.message: The camera %s must be a robot-mounted camera.
CVIS-257.cause: The Floating Frame vision process is referencing a camera setup whose camera is not robot-mounted.
CVIS-257.remedy: Open the camera setup in the iRVision Setup and mark the camera as robot mounted.

CVIS-258.cause: The conditional execution tool is not trained.

CVIS-259.message: Measurement Output: Fail to get value.
CVIS-259.cause: iRVision Measurement Output: Fail to get value.
CVIS-259.remedy: The parent tool or another child tool could not find the part. Check that the parent tool and the other child tools can run normally.

CVIS-260.message: Measurement Output: No found pose of parent locator tool.
CVIS-260.cause: iRVision Measurement Output: No found pose of parent location tool.
CVIS-260.remedy: Parent location tool could not find any part. Please tune some parameters, if necessary.

CVIS-261.cause: An invalid register number was set for the gripper index.

CVIS-262.cause: An invalid gripper index was set.

CVIS-263.cause: The register number for the gripper index is not set.
CVIS-263.remedy: Set the register number for the gripper index correctly.

CVIS-264.cause: The gripper index is not initialized.

CVIS-265.message: This model ID is already used
CVIS-265.cause: This model ID has already been used.

CVIS-266.message: There is a robot which uses a different allocation mode
CVIS-266.cause: A robot is using a different allocation mode.
CVIS-266.remedy: Use the same allocation mode for each robot.

CVIS-267.message: Part with invalid model ID is pushed into queue
CVIS-267.cause: The number of robots which have the same model id is invalid.
CVIS-267.remedy: Input the correct number of the robots which has the same model id.

CVIS-269.cause: The application UF is not set.

CVIS-270.message: The calibration grid frame is not selected
CVIS-270.cause: The frame indicating the position of the calibration grid fixture is not set.
CVIS-270.remedy: Set the frame indicating the position of the calibration grid fixture.

CVIS-271.message: User tool number is not selected
CVIS-271.cause: The utool frame in which you perform the tool offset is not set.
CVIS-271.remedy: Set the utool frame that you perform the tool offset.

CVIS-272.message: The parent location tool failed to find anything.
CVIS-272.cause: The parent location tool of the multi-locator tool failed to find anything.
CVIS-272.remedy: Adjust the parameters of the parent location tool.

CVIS-273.message: The multi-locator tool is not trained.
CVIS-273.cause: The multi-locator tool has not been trained.
CVIS-273.remedy: Add and train one or more child location tools and set the location tool index register.

CVIS-274.message: The location tool index register index is invalid.
CVIS-274.cause: The location tool index register index is invalid.
CVIS-274.remedy: Select a valid index for the location tool index register.

CVIS-275.message: The location tool index register value is invalid.
CVIS-275.cause: The location tool index register value is invalid.
CVIS-275.remedy: Set the location tool index register to a value between 1 and the number of child location tools.

CVIS-276.message: A child location tool of the multi-locator tool is not trained.
CVIS-276.cause: A child location tool of the multi-locator tool is not trained.
CVIS-276.remedy: Train all of the child location tools.

CVIS-277.message: The parent location tool failed to find anything.
CVIS-277.cause: The parent location tool of the multi-window tool failed to find anything.
CVIS-277.remedy: Adjust the parameters of the parent location tool.

CVIS-278.message: The multi-window tool is not trained.
CVIS-278.cause: The multi-window tool is not trained.
CVIS-278.remedy: Add and train a child location tool and set the window index register.

CVIS-279.message: The window index register index is invalid.
CVIS-279.cause: The window index register index is invalid.
CVIS-279.remedy: Select a valid index for the window index register.

CVIS-280.message: The window index register value is invalid.
CVIS-280.cause: The window index register value is invalid.
CVIS-280.remedy: Set the window index register to a value between 1 and the number of windows.

CVIS-281.message: The child location tool of the multi-window tool is not trained.
CVIS-281.cause: The child location tool of the multi-window tool has not been trained.

CVIS-282.message: Blob locator:The search window is too small.
CVIS-282.cause: The specified search window is too small to process.

CVIS-283.message: The sum of sorting priority weights is zero.
CVIS-283.cause: The sum of sorting priority weights is zero.
CVIS-283.remedy: Enable some of the sorting priority weights and set plus values to them.

CVIS-284.message: The vision process is not trained.
CVIS-284.cause: The Error Proofing vision process has not been fully trained.
CVIS-284.remedy: Check the measurements configuration to make sure that no invalid measurements have been enabled. Check also to make sure that all child tools have been trained.

CVIS-285.message: To overwrite position and angle, two or more child location tools must be set.
CVIS-285.cause: To overwrite postion and angle, two or more child location tools must be set.
CVIS-285.remedy: Set two or more child location tools.

CVIS-286.message: Any child location tools are not set on the setup page.
CVIS-286.cause: No child location tools have been set on the setup screen.
CVIS-286.remedy: Set some location tools on the setup screen.

CVIS-287.message: No found pose of parent locator tool.
CVIS-287.cause: No found position of the parent tool.
CVIS-287.remedy: Adjust parameters of the parent tool.

CVIS-288.message: A child location tool fails to find anything.
CVIS-288.cause: A child lcation tool failed to find anything.
CVIS-288.remedy: Adjust parameters of the child location tool.

CVIS-289.message: Position Adjust tool is not trained.
CVIS-289.cause: The Position Adjust tool has not been set.
CVIS-289.remedy: Set some child location tools and set a reference position.

CVIS-290.remedy: Modify the call to AcqQueue in your program to pass a correct ACK status.

CVIS-291.cause: AckQueue is called before a part is allocated in GetQueue.
CVIS-291.remedy: Modify your teach pendant program to call AckQueue after a part is allocated by GetQueue.

CVIS-292.cause: AcqQueue is not called before the next GetQueue.
CVIS-292.remedy: Modify your teach pendant program to call AckQueue after GetQueue.

CVIS-293.cause: The GetQueue request is canceled because the work area is disabled.
CVIS-293.remedy: Do not call GetQueue until the work area is re-enabled.

CVIS-294.message: The DVM snap interval is too short.
CVIS-294.cause: The exposure time plus typical system overhead to snap a picture exceeds the interval time specified in the schedule.
CVIS-294.remedy: Increase the interval or reduce the exposure time.

CVIS-295.message: The DVM log path is invalid.
CVIS-295.cause: DVM could not access the log path specified.
CVIS-295.remedy: Verify that the specified log media exists and is not full.

CVIS-296.cause: A system error is inhibiting Diagnostic Video Monitoring (DVM) from enabling a schedule.
CVIS-296.remedy: Document the events that led to the error and contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CVIS-297.message: %s specified for DVM event %d cannot be accessed.
CVIS-297.cause: Diagnostic Video Monitoring (DVM) cannot read the specified I/O signal.

CVIS-298.message: There is not TEMP memory to run DVM at this time.
CVIS-298.cause: Diagnostic Video Monitoring (DVM) needs more TEMP memory than is currently available.
CVIS-298.remedy: Reduce the number of pictures in the video loop. If the state of the schedule becomes POWER UP, try cycling power on the robot. This might free up some memory.

CVIS-299.cause: An error occured while acquiring an image from the camera.
CVIS-299.remedy: Verify that there is acamera connected to the port. If the connection looks OK, call the FANUC Hot-line and tell then the code number that is at the end.

CVIS-300.message: The value of Light Output Signal Number %s is out of range. The valid range is %s to %s.
CVIS-300.cause: The specified value of Light Output Signal Number is out of range.
CVIS-300.remedy: Specify a value of Light Output Signal Number within the range.

CVIS-301.message: Edge pair is not selected. Select found item from results table.
CVIS-301.cause: The edge pair is not selected.
CVIS-301.remedy: Select one edge pair from a list view in the result page.

CVIS-302.message: Part is not selected. Select found item from results table.
CVIS-302.remedy: Select one part from a list view in the result page.

CVIS-303.cause: This function is obsolete and not available on your controller.
CVIS-303.remedy: Document the events that led to the error and contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CVIS-304.message: No work area in the line.
CVIS-304.cause: No work area is added in the line, so the required operation cannot be performed.
CVIS-304.remedy: Add one or more work areas in the line.

CVIS-305.message: No more line can be created.
CVIS-305.cause: No more lines can be created.
CVIS-305.remedy: Delete unused lines before creating a new one.

CVIS-306.message: No more area can be created.
CVIS-306.cause: No more work areas can be created.
CVIS-306.remedy: Delete unused work areas before creating a new one.

CVIS-307.message: No more tray pattern can be created.
CVIS-307.cause: No more tray patterns can be created.
CVIS-307.remedy: Delete any unused tray patterns before creating a new one.

CVIS-308.message: No more cell can be added to the tray.
CVIS-308.cause: No more tray patterns can be created.
CVIS-308.remedy: Delete any unused tray patterns before creating a new one.

CVIS-309.remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CVIS-310.cause: The specified name is too long, or an unacceptable character was used.
CVIS-310.remedy: Correct the name and try the operation again.

CVIS-311.message: Specified name is already in use.
CVIS-311.cause: The specified name was already used.
CVIS-311.remedy: Enter another name and try the operation again.

CVIS-312.cause: The specified data cannot be deleted or renamed, because it is in edit.
CVIS-312.remedy: Close the setup window of the data before trying to delete or rename the data.

CVIS-313.cause: Another controller on the network has custodianship for that operation.
CVIS-313.remedy: Close the setup window on the controller that has the custodianship.

CVIS-314.message: Parameters for scale conversion are not set.
CVIS-314.cause: Some parameters for scale conversion are not set.
CVIS-314.remedy: Set all parameters for the scale conversion.

CVIS-315.cause: Incorrectly measured data has been selected.
CVIS-315.remedy: Select non-zero length data in a list view.

CVIS-317.cause: An invalid trigger type has occurred.

CVIS-318.cause: Visual tracking configuration of the offline controllers are inconsistent.
CVIS-318.remedy: Use the SYNC button on the visual tracking main setup menu to synchronize after turning on those controllers.

CVIS-319.message: The IP address of could not be set on this camera.
CVIS-319.cause: The iRVision software could not set the IP address of the selected GiGe Camera.
CVIS-319.remedy: Use the vendor utility to set up the IP address for this camera.

CVIS-320.message: The IP address is in use by another device.
CVIS-320.cause: The IP address is assigned to another computer or other device on the network.
CVIS-320.remedy: Use a different IP address for this camera.

CVIS-321.message: Any locator tools are not set.

CVIS-322.message: Any child locator tools are not set.
CVIS-322.cause: Any child locator tool is not set.

CVIS-323.message: The model pattern is not trained.
CVIS-323.cause: The model pattern is not trained.
CVIS-323.remedy: Train the model pattern, and retry the operation.

CVIS-324.cause: The system could not find the object within the time limit.
CVIS-324.remedy: In the Curved Surface Match (CSM) Tool Setup screen, check if you have the Orientation or Scale degrees of freedom enabled. If so, reduce the maximums and/or increase the minimums and try to find it again. If it still fails, disable one or more degrees of freedom. Increase the allowable processing time. Alternatively, make one of the following adjustments so as to decrease the required processing time. Uncheck the orientation and scale ratio check boxes whichever are unnecessary. Specify a larger score threshold. Specify a larger contrast threshold. Narrow the orientation and scale search ranges. Reduce the size of the search window.

CVIS-325.message: There are not enough features in the training window.
CVIS-325.cause: There are not enough features in the image to train the model pattern.
CVIS-325.remedy: Use another part of the image as the model or teach a model using another image by taking it after adjusting the exposure time or the contrast threshold so that a sufficient amount of the features are received.

CVIS-326.message: Saved laser image and laser number are not consistent. Change laser number in setup page.
CVIS-326.cause: The saved laser image and laser number are not consistent.
CVIS-326.remedy: Change the laser number in the setup page.

CVIS-327.message: CSM Locator: No found pose of parent locator tool.
CVIS-327.cause: No pose (position) of the parent tool was found.
CVIS-327.remedy: Adjust the parameters of the parent tool.

CVIS-328.message: CSM Locator: Fail to get reference position.
CVIS-328.cause: Failed to get the reference pose (position).
CVIS-328.remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

CVIS-329.message: CSM Locator: The search window is too small.
CVIS-329.cause: The specified search window is too small to process.

CVIS-330.message: CSM Locator: A child tool is not trained.
CVIS-330.cause: A child tool is not trained.
CVIS-330.remedy: Train all of the child tools.

CVIS-331.message: The search window is too small or set to the outside of the image.
CVIS-331.cause: The specified search window is too small or set to the outside of the image.
CVIS-331.remedy: When the search window is too small, set the search area larger. When the search window is set to the outside of the image, confirm that parent locator tool finds the model correctly and change the search window if necessary.

CVIS-332.remedy: Please check the multiplexer type, the cable connections and the DO settings.

CVIS-333.message: The found positions are too close to each other.
CVIS-333.cause: The found positions are too close to each other.
CVIS-333.remedy: Train fundamental data again so that fundamental data won't be too close.

CVIS-334.message: All found positions are on a same line.
CVIS-334.cause: All found positions are on a same line.
CVIS-334.remedy: Train fundamental data again so that fundamental data won't be on a same line.

CVIS-335.message: The fundamental data are too close to each other.
CVIS-335.cause: The fundamental data are too close to each other.
CVIS-335.remedy: Train fundamental data again so that fundamental data won't be too close.

CVIS-336.message: All fundamental data are on a same line.
CVIS-336.cause: All fundamental data are on a same line.
CVIS-336.remedy: Train fundamental data again so that fundamental data won't be on a same line.

CVIS-337.message: The fundamental data have not been set.
CVIS-337.cause: The fundamental data have not been set.
CVIS-337.remedy: Set the fundamental data in camera view set-up page.

CVIS-338.message: The application user frames in calibration data are not same.
CVIS-338.cause: The numbers of application user frames in calibration data of each camera view are not same.
CVIS-338.remedy: Set the same application frame number to the calibration data of each camera view.

CVIS-339.message: The distance between camera and target has not been set.
CVIS-339.cause: The distance between camera and target has not been set.
CVIS-339.remedy: Select the calibration data that is trained and perspective.

CVIS-340.cause: No cylinder was found during laser measurement.
CVIS-340.remedy: First, adjust the setting of exposure so that an appropriate laser image can be obtained. Next, make sure that the laser measurement area was taught properly. If the pattern match model origin is changed after the laser measurement area has been taught, it is likely that the laser measurement area may move to an unintended position during execution. If you changed the model origin, re-set the laser measurement area. If these methods cannot solve the problem, adjust the detection parameter for the string of laser spots.

CVIS-341.remedy: Train the laser window, the cylinder direction or the cylinder diameter. And retry the operation.

CVIS-342.remedy: Make 2D measurement successful. If no 2D measurement is trained, train it.

CVIS-343.message: Fail to initialize the cylinder calculation.
CVIS-343.cause: There are too few laser slit points or too many noisy points.
CVIS-343.remedy: First, adjust the setting of exposure or min laser contrast so that an appropriate laser image can be obtained. Second, adjust the laser measurement area properly. Last, adjust the setting of max fit error.

CVIS-344.message: The cylinder calculation did not converge.
CVIS-344.cause: The max fit error is too small. Or there are too few laser slit points or too many noisy points.
CVIS-344.remedy: First, adjust the setting of max fit error. Second, adjust the setting of exposure or min laser contrast so that an appropriate laser image can be obtained. Last, adjust the laser measurement area properly.

CVIS-345.message: There are too few calibration points.
CVIS-345.cause: There are too few calibration points.

CVIS-347.message: This configuration between camera and target is not supported.
CVIS-347.cause: This camera-target configuration is not supported.

CVIS-348.message: The camera that is connected to other controller is not supported.
CVIS-348.cause: The camera that is connected to other controller is not supported.

CVIS-350.message: Initial measurement position is not set.
CVIS-350.cause: Initial measurement position is not set.
CVIS-350.remedy: Set an initial measrement position into the data of Robot-Generated Grid Calibration Tool.

CVIS-351.remedy: Set a valid number as motion group.

CVIS-352.message: The two found positions are too close.
CVIS-352.cause: The two found positions are too close.
CVIS-352.remedy: Please set trigger offset 1 and trigger offset 2 correctly.

CVIS-353.message: Window shift tool does not exist, or failed to find.
CVIS-353.cause: Window shift tool does not exist or failed to find, so some command tools could not shift their search window dynamically.
CVIS-353.remedy: Insert a window shift tool, or train its child locator tool.

CVIS-354.message: Window shift tool is not trained.
CVIS-354.cause: Window shift tool is not trained.
CVIS-354.remedy: Insert a locator tool under the window shift tool, and teach it.

CVIS-355.message: No vision logs exist in the specified directory.
CVIS-355.cause: No vision logs exist in the directory specified by $VISION_CFG$LOG_PATH or $VISION_CFG$LOG_PATH_V.

CVIS-357.remedy: Remove read-only attribute from a log file.

CVIS-358.message: Vision override is not trained properly.
CVIS-358.cause: The vision override is not trained properly.
CVIS-358.remedy: Verify if the vision override is trained properly.

CVIS-360.message: Arithmetic calculation tool is not trained.
CVIS-360.cause: Arithmetic Calculation Tool is not trained.

CVIS-361.message: Geometric calculation tool is not trained.
CVIS-361.cause: Geometric Calculation Tool is not trained.

CVIS-362.message: Statistic calculation tool is not trained.
CVIS-362.cause: Statitic Calculation Tool is not trained.

CVIS-364.message: Edge histogram tool is not trained.
CVIS-364.cause: There is a edge histogram tool yet to be taught.
CVIS-364.remedy: Teach all edge histogram tools or delete the unnecessary tool yet to be taught.

CVIS-365.message: Edge histogram: Fail to get reference position
CVIS-365.cause: Fail to get the reference pose.
CVIS-365.remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions in which the error occurred.

CVIS-366.message: Edge histogram: Fail to set reference position.
CVIS-366.cause: Internal error of a edge histogram tool.
CVIS-366.remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

CVIS-367.message: Found result is not set to the specified vision register
CVIS-367.cause: Found result is not set to the specidied vision register.
CVIS-367.remedy: Please set found result to the spedified vision register.

CVIS-368.message: Position data is not set to the specified position register.
CVIS-368.cause: Position data is not set to the specifid position register.
CVIS-368.remedy: Please set position data to the spedified position register.

CVIS-369.message: Type of the specified position register is not supported.
CVIS-369.cause: Type of the specified position register is not supported.
CVIS-369.remedy: Type of the specified position register must be XYZWPR format or MATRIX format.

CVIS-370.remedy: Place a grid pattern plate in the camera field of view and teach the scale factor or, check use grid calibration checkbox and choose a grid-pattern calibration data.

CVIS-371.remedy: Create a new evaluation tool under the vision process.

CVIS-372.remedy: Add evaluation conditions in the evaluation tool.

CVIS-374.message: The 3-D fit error exceeds the limit.
CVIS-374.cause: The GET_OFFSET command failed because the 3-D fit error was too high.
CVIS-374.remedy: Check the vision log to investigate whether the part was wrong or damaged. If the part should have been found, retrain it, execute the "tweak" function, or increase the fit error limit.

CVIS-375.message: Not enough targets were found to compute the 3-D offset.
CVIS-375.cause: The GET_OFFSET command failed because not enough targets were found during the RUN_FIND commands.
CVIS-375.remedy: Check the vision log to investigate whether the part was wrong or damaged. If the part should have been found, retrain it, retrain the targets that were not found.

CVIS-376.message: One of the targets was discarded.
CVIS-376.cause: A target was discarded to lower the fit error. The 3-D offset was recomputed without that target, and is still valid.
CVIS-376.remedy: Check the vision log to investigate whether the discarded target has a problem. Retrain the discarded target if necessary.

CVIS-377.message: No more targets can be added.
CVIS-377.cause: The maximum allowed number of targets has already been added to the vision process.
CVIS-377.remedy: To add a new target, you must delete another one first.

CVIS-378.remedy: Create image register by changing system variable $VISIMREGNUM.

CVIS-380.message: The image register is too small.
CVIS-380.cause: The image register is too small.
CVIS-380.remedy: Increase the size of image register by changing system variable $VISIMREGSIZ.

CVIS-381.message: The image register has no data.
CVIS-381.cause: The image register has no data.
CVIS-381.remedy: Store the data to the image register by snapping the image by IRVSNAP before the execution of IRVFIND.

CVIS-382.message: The user frame is different from that of the image register.
CVIS-382.cause: The user frame is different from that of the image register.
CVIS-382.remedy: The user frame must be same as that of the image register.

CVIS-383.message: The tool frame is different from that of the image regsiter.
CVIS-383.cause: The tool frame is different from that of the image register.
CVIS-383.remedy: The tool frame must be same as that of the image register.

CVIS-384.message: The robot is different from that of the image register.
CVIS-384.cause: The robot is different from that of the image register.
CVIS-384.remedy: The robot must be same as that of the image register.

CVIS-385.message: The condition of detection is different from that of the image register.
CVIS-385.cause: The condition of detection is different from that of the image register.
CVIS-385.remedy: The condition of detection must be same as that of the image register. Check the offset mode, whether the laser is used or not, and so on.

CVIS-386.message: Image register index is out of range
CVIS-386.cause: The image register index specified in the IRVSNAP or IRVFIND command is out of range.
CVIS-386.remedy: Enter the correct image register index.

CVIS-387.message: The camera is different from that of the image register.
CVIS-387.cause: The camera is different from that of the image register.
CVIS-387.remedy: The camera must be same as that of the image register.

CVIS-388.message: There is no part with the specified work_id in queue.
CVIS-388.cause: There is no part with the specified work_id in queue.

CVIS-389.remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

CVIS-390.message: No more position to avoid the interference.
CVIS-390.cause: No more position to avoid the interference.

CVIS-391.remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

CVIS-392.cause: Specified data cannot be deleted or renamed, because it is in edit.
CVIS-392.remedy: Close the setup window of the data before delete or rename.

CVIS-393.message: No more interference setup data(system) can be created.
CVIS-393.cause: No more interference setup data(system) can be created.
CVIS-393.remedy: Delete unused interference setup data(system) before created a new one.

CVIS-394.message: No more interference setup data(robot) can be created.
CVIS-394.cause: No more interference setup data(robot) can be created.
CVIS-394.remedy: Delete unused interference setup data(robot) before created a new one.

CVIS-395.message: No more interference setup data(condition) can be created.
CVIS-395.cause: No more interference setup data(condition) can be created.
CVIS-395.remedy: Delete unused interference setup data(condition) before created a new one.

CVIS-396.message: No more object can be created.
CVIS-396.cause: No more object can be created.
CVIS-396.remedy: Delete unused object before created a new one.

CVIS-397.cause: Specified name is too long, or un-acceptable character is used.

CVIS-398.message: Specified name is already in use.

CVIS-399.remedy: Change the object size or positions.

CVIS-400.cause: A zero vector has been used in calculation.

CVIS-403.cause: A segment edge index is invalid.

CVIS-404.cause: A half line edge index is invalid.

CVIS-405.cause: The number of edges is invalid.

CVIS-406.cause: The sequence of vertices on polygon is illfitted.

CVIS-407.cause: The sequence of vertices on surface is illfitted.

CVIS-412.message: The computed offset failed a limit check.
CVIS-412.cause: The GET OFFSET operation has found an offset that fails the configured limit check operation.
CVIS-412.remedy: If no limit check operation should be executed, deselect the configured Limit Check Tool in the vision process. If the limit check operation failed correctly, adjust the parameters in the Limit Check Tool or the part location.

CVIS-413.cause: The Limit Check failed, causing the offset to be skipped. (For internal use.)

CVIS-414.message: Limit Check Tool is not trained.
CVIS-414.cause: The Limit Check Tool is not trained.
CVIS-414.remedy: Train the Limit Check Tool first by enabling at least one condition.

CVIS-415.message: The selected Limit Check Tool no longer exists.
CVIS-415.cause: The Limit Check Tool that was previously selected has been removed from the system.
CVIS-415.remedy: Select a new Limit Check Tool or select 'None selected' to disable limit checking.

CVIS-416.cause: The setting of opening CONS was disabled. Or, it was failed to open CONS.
CVIS-416.remedy: Make it enabled to open CONS. And, select 'Maintenance Cons' for PORT setting.

CVIS-417.message: There are too many divided points of measurement.
CVIS-417.cause: There were too many divided points of the measurement.
CVIS-417.remedy: Reduce the divide number for the measurement.

CVIS-418.cause: The setting values of the camera position was not correct.
CVIS-418.remedy: Input the correct values of the camera position.

CVIS-420.cause: The setting values is not correct.

CVIS-421.cause: The setting value is not correct.

CVIS-422.cause: The barcode library has not been initialized.
CVIS-422.remedy: Attempt the operation again. If the error occurs again, you may need to restart the controller.

CVIS-423.cause: The barcode library has already been initialized.
CVIS-423.remedy: This message is for informational purposes only.

CVIS-424.cause: The barcode library was unable to allocate required memory.
CVIS-424.remedy: Attempt the operation again. If the error occurs again, you may need to restart the controller.

CVIS-425.message: Barcode lib: parameter out of range.
CVIS-425.cause: A parameter is out of range.
CVIS-425.remedy: This message is for internal use only.

CVIS-426.remedy: This message is for internal use only.

CVIS-427.cause: An invalid image is being used.
CVIS-427.remedy: This message is for internal use only.

CVIS-428.cause: An invalid data buffer has been detected.
CVIS-428.remedy: This message is for internal use only.

CVIS-429.cause: An invalid grayscale variable is being used.
CVIS-429.remedy: This message is for internal use only.

CVIS-430.remedy: This message is for internal use only.

CVIS-431.remedy: This message is for internal use only.

CVIS-432.cause: The specified number of calculation lines is invalid.
CVIS-432.remedy: This message is for internal use only.

CVIS-433.remedy: This message is for internal use only.

CVIS-434.cause: The barcode was not found in the image.
CVIS-434.remedy: Reposition the part and try again. If the barcode still cannot be found, check your lighting conditions and specified parameters.

CVIS-435.cause: There was an error calculating the barcode orientation.
CVIS-435.remedy: Reposition the part and try again. If the barcode still cannot be found, check your lighting conditions and specified parameters.

CVIS-436.cause: There was an error calculating the barcode location.
CVIS-436.remedy: Reposition the part and try again. If the barcode still cannot be found, check your lighting conditions and specified parameters.

CVIS-437.cause: Unknown error returned from barcode library.
CVIS-437.remedy: This message is for internal use only.

CVIS-441.message: Sequence error in remote vision call.
CVIS-441.cause: The function wait_svr_dn called when the vision offset server was in the SVR_IDLE, or SVR_RESERVED states.
CVIS-441.remedy: This message is for internal use only.

CVIS-447.message: Relative limit check is not supported for this process.
CVIS-447.cause: This vision process does not support relative limit checks, because there is no defined reference position.
CVIS-447.remedy: Change the limit check type to absolute, or select a new limit check tool for this vision process.

CVIS-449.message: Override value is out of range.
CVIS-449.cause: Override value is out of range.

CVIS-450.message: No more big dot can be deleted.
CVIS-450.cause: When the number of found big dots is less than four, the big dots can't be deleted.
CVIS-450.remedy: When the number of correctly found big dots is less than three, please retry the grid pattern detection.

CVIS-452.remedy: Please contact FANUC America Corporation if you receive this error. Notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation mode, etc.) during which the error occurred.

CVIS-453.cause: The camera setup is not trained.

CVIS-455.message: Comm port for camera is not initialized.
CVIS-455.cause: The communication port for the camera is not initialized.
CVIS-455.remedy: Initialize the communication port for the camera.

CVIS-457.message: A Matrix Code could not be found in the image.
CVIS-457.cause: A Matrix Code could not be found in the image.
CVIS-457.remedy: View the binary image on the setup page to verify that the threshold is correct. Check the search window on the setup page to verify that the matrix code is within the window.

CVIS-458.message: The Matrix Code geometry is bad.
CVIS-458.cause: The Matrix Code geometry is bad.
CVIS-458.remedy: View the binary image on the setup page to verify that the threshold is correct. Check the search window on the setup page to verify that the matrix code is within the window. Verify that the Matrix Code has an even number of rows and columns. Verify that the Matrix Code is not damaged.

CVIS-459.message: The Matrix Code is too damaged to read.
CVIS-459.cause: The Matrix Code is too damaged to read.
CVIS-459.remedy: View the binary image on the setup page to verify that the threshold is correct. Check the search window on the setup page to verify that the matrix code is within the window. Verify that the Matrix Code is not damaged.

CVIS-460.message: Matrix Code reader internal software error.
CVIS-460.cause: An internal software error occurred in the Matrix Code reader.
CVIS-460.remedy: None. Please save the image and the vision process that caused this error and send it to FANUC America Corporation America.

CVIS-461.message: Illegal character found in Matrix Code.
CVIS-461.cause: An illegal text character was found in the Matrix Code.
CVIS-461.remedy: Verify that the Matrix Code is not damaged.

CVIS-462.message: The Matrix Code reader does not support Base 256 encoding.
CVIS-462.cause: The Matrix Code contains an unsupported feature.

CVIS-463.message: The Matrix Code reader does not support FNC1 alternate data types.
CVIS-463.cause: The Matrix Code contains an unsupported feature.

CVIS-464.message: The Matrix Code reader does not support Structured Append sequences.
CVIS-464.cause: The Matrix Code contains an unsupported feature.

CVIS-465.message: The Matrix Code reader does not support Reader Programming.
CVIS-465.cause: The Matrix Code contains an unsupported feature.

CVIS-466.message: The Matrix Code reader does not support Upper Shift to Extended ASCII characters.
CVIS-466.cause: The Matrix Code contains an unsupported feature.

CVIS-467.message: The Matrix Code reader does not support 05 Macros.
CVIS-467.cause: The Matrix Code contains an unsupported feature.

CVIS-468.message: The Matrix Code reader does not support 06 Macros.
CVIS-468.cause: The Matrix Code contains an unsupported feature.

CVIS-469.message: The Matrix Code reader does not support ANSI X12 encoding.
CVIS-469.cause: The Matrix Code contains an unsupported feature.

CVIS-470.message: The Matrix Code reader does not support EDIFACT encoding.
CVIS-470.cause: The Matrix Code contains an unsupported feature.

CVIS-471.message: The Matrix Code reader does not support Extended Channel Interpretation (ECI).
CVIS-471.cause: The Matrix Code contains an unsupported feature.

CVIS-472.message: The String Output Tool is not trained.
CVIS-472.cause: The String Output Tool has not been properly configured.
CVIS-472.remedy: Open the setup page for the String Output Tool. Select a valid tool name and string measurement name.

CVIS-473.remedy: Specify the model ID for that you want to change a load balance.

CVIS-474.message: Specified load balance is over range.
CVIS-474.cause: Specified load balance is over range.

CVIS-476.remedy: Look at previous CVIS error for remedy

CVIS-477.message: Invalid Number of tools for Gun
CVIS-477.remedy: Use SETUP>GUN to reset number of tools.

CVIS-478.cause: GET OFFSET Not all model IDs found at View 1 for 1st wire
CVIS-478.remedy: Make sure that the vision process edge point tool's search window includes only the wire. There may not be enough points on the wire.

CVIS-479.message: GET OFFSET VP 2 Wire 1:Not all model IDs found
CVIS-479.cause: GET OFFSET Not all model IDs found at View 2 for 1st wire.
CVIS-479.remedy: Make sure the Search window includes the wire and only the wire in the window. At least ten points on the wire must be found.

CVIS-480.message: GET OFFSET VP 1 Wire 2:Not all model IDs found
CVIS-480.cause: The second wire was not found by vision at the first view position.
CVIS-480.remedy: Make sure both wires are in the search window and that at least ten points are found on each wire.

CVIS-481.message: GET OFFSET VP 2 Wire 2:Not all model IDs found
CVIS-481.cause: The 2nd wire was not found in the second view.
CVIS-481.remedy: Make sure the VP search window encloses both wires and only the wires. There must be at least ten points on each wire.

CVIS-482.message: GET OFFSET Invalid Number of tools
CVIS-482.cause: The number of tools per gun must be one or two.
CVIS-482.remedy: Uee SETUP>Guns to set the number of tools to one or two.

CVIS-483.cause: The Two view positions are the same.
CVIS-483.remedy: Make sure that view 1 and view 2 differ in yaw, normally it is a 90 degree difference in yaw. This error can be caused by using the same position for view 1 and view 2. This is respect to the application frame. Note a change in application frame yaw is seen as a change in roll with respect to the UTOOL.

CVIS-484.cause: The two robot views are nearly the same position.
CVIS-484.remedy: Adjust one of the view positions by rotating the tool. View 2 should be rotated about 90 degrees from view 1.

CVIS-485.message: Tool Z End or Base cannot be 0
CVIS-485.cause: The Z axis is defined to be dominant. Therefore the base and end model IDs must both be non zero
CVIS-485.remedy: Use SETUP>TOOLS to define the base Z and end Z to be non zero. MOst weld guns can be easily defined by selecting the Single or Dual choice using the SET TOOL function key.

CVIS-486.message: Tool X End or Base cannot be 0
CVIS-486.cause: The X axis is the dominant axis. The Base X and End X model IDs cannot be zero.
CVIS-486.remedy: Use SETUP>TOOL to define the Base X and End X model IDs. The standard tool definitions can be reset using the SET TOOL function key and selecting Single or Dual.

CVIS-487.cause: Multiple consecutive warnings on automatic retry have occurred without success. Once the retry threshold has been exceeded, an error is posted
CVIS-487.remedy: Determine what is causing the previous alarm log warnings and fix the problem. Chose RETRY to repeat the retry. Choose Continue to ignore the error. The UTOOL is not updated when this error is posted.

CVIS-488.cause: The element (X, Y, Z, W, P, or R) has exceeded the error threshold for change in the UTOOL.
CVIS-488.remedy: The tool or the wire has deviated more than the allowable error threshold values. This is a safety check to make sure the calculated UTOOL is reasonable or to find a badly mangle tool. The user should straighten the torch or wire and repeat the test.

CVIS-489.cause: The irtUtiltiy program for getting the focal point has failed. The same error can occur using the FLAG screen to get the focal point position.
CVIS-489.remedy: The usual cause is an invalid vision process name or an invalid camera calibration name in the vision process. Also verify that the camera calibration is a fixed camera calibration.

CVIS-490.cause: The top of the wire #1 and the bottom of wire #1 are too close (same point).
CVIS-490.remedy: This is probably cause by not enough wire in the search window. Change the search window so that it includes more wire. The other possibility is that the wire is too short. The wire must have at least 1.0 mm in the search window.

CVIS-491.cause: Wire 2 top and bottom point are the same point or within 1.0 mm.
CVIS-491.remedy: The vision process search window may be too small and chopping off part of the wire. The wire may be too short. At least 1.0 mm must be in the vision process search window.

CVIS-492.cause: The call to irtmain requires a sixth parameter for this function. The parameter is a gun number.
CVIS-492.remedy: Change or add a sixth parameter. The gun number should be 1, 2, 3, or 4.

CVIS-674.message: Chromatic color pixels are too little
