CVIS-674.remedy: Depending on the causes, adjust or re-teach the following items. 1. Adjust exposure time. 2. Adjust achromatic level. 3. Use the white light source and illuminate the workpiece uniformly.

CVIS-675.message: Multi colors are included in the trained area.
CVIS-675.cause: Multi colors are included in the trained area
CVIS-675.remedy: Train the area where the single color is included.

CVIS-676.cause: Acquired image is too dark or too bright.
CVIS-676.remedy: Adjust exposure time to acquire more colorful image.

CVIS-677.message: The index of found part is out of range.
CVIS-677.cause: The index of found part is out of range.
CVIS-677.remedy: Enter the correct index within the range.

CVIS-678.message: The vision process specified in %s and the executed VP do not match.
CVIS-678.cause: The vision process specified in Vision Override and the executed VP do not match.
CVIS-678.remedy: Check the followings: 1. Whether the vision process name passed to RUN_FIND command is correct. 2. Whether the vision process name specified in Vision Override is correct.

CVIS-679.message: The vision tool specified in Vision Override does not exist in the executed VP.
CVIS-679.cause: The vision tool specified in Vision Override does not exist in the executed VP.
CVIS-679.remedy: Check the followings: 1. Whether the vision process name passed to RUN_FIND command is correct. 2. Whether the vision process name passed to IRVOVRDANYVP is correct. 3. Whether the vision tool name specified in Vision Override is correct.

CVIS-680.message: The property specified in Vision Override does not exist in the exexcuted VP.
CVIS-680.cause: The property specified in Vision Override does not exist in the exexcuted VP.
CVIS-680.remedy: Check the followings: 1. Whether the vision process name passed to RUN_FIND command is correct. 2. Whether the vision process name passed to IRVOVRDANYVP is correct. 3. Whether the property specified in Vision Override is correct.

CVIS-681.cause: The target for learning cannot be changed.
CVIS-681.remedy: Clear the learning data, or use the same target for learning.

CVIS-682.cause: The selected offset type does not match with the trained data.
CVIS-682.remedy: Clear the trained data by selecting another camera data, or select an appropriate camera data.

CVIS-683.cause: The number of learned parts has reached its maximum, or a UF is used to calculate the offset plane.
CVIS-683.remedy: Clear the learning data, or uncheck the 'Fixed Plane' checkbox.

CVIS-684.message: The relation between the robot and the offset frame is not set
CVIS-684.cause: The robot position is not set.

CVIS-685.cause: The two input images for the Image Arithmetic tool are not the same size.
CVIS-685.remedy: Choose images that are the same size and try again.

CVIS-686.cause: The camera image size is different from the trained dark field or flat field image sizes in the Flat Field tool.
CVIS-686.remedy: Retrain the dark field and flat field images with the new camera.

CVIS-687.message: This function requires iRConnect or ZDT.
CVIS-687.cause: The requested function requires either iRConnect or ZDT to be loaded.
CVIS-687.remedy: Order and load either the iRConnect or ZDT options.

CVIS-688.cause: This is an alarm of Vision Learning Function. Learning Index file is broken.
CVIS-688.remedy: Remove the Learning Index file from the device specifiled as Log Path.

CVIS-689.message: Learning Index file is too old to load.
CVIS-689.cause: This is an alarm of Vision Learning Function. The format of the Learning Index file is too old, and the controller cannot load it.
CVIS-689.remedy: Remove the Learning Index file from the device specifiled as Log Path.

CVIS-690.message: Learning Index file is too new to load.
CVIS-690.cause: This is an alarm of Vision Learning Function. The format of the Learning Index file is too new, and the controller cannot load it.
CVIS-690.remedy: Remove the Learning Index file from the device specifiled as Log Path.

CVIS-691.cause: This is an alarm of Vision Learning Function. Learning Data file is broken.
CVIS-691.remedy: Remove the Learning Data file from the device specifiled as Log Path.

CVIS-692.message: Learning Data file is too old to load.
CVIS-692.cause: This is an alarm of Vision Learning Function. The format of the Learning Data file is too old, and the controller cannot load it.
CVIS-692.remedy: Remove the Learning Data file from the device specifiled as Log Path.

CVIS-693.message: Learning Data file is too new to load.
CVIS-693.cause: This is an alarm of Vision Learning Function. The format of the Learning Data file is too new, and the controller cannot load it.
CVIS-693.remedy: Remove the Learning Data file from the device specifiled as Log Path.

CVIS-694.message: Value in learning data is too big.
CVIS-694.cause: This is an alarm of Vision Learning Function. The value in the Learning Data file is too big, and the controller cannot load it.
CVIS-694.remedy: Remove the Learning Data file from the device specifiled as Log Path.

CVIS-695.cause: This is an alarm of Vision Learning Function. Model Learning failed.
CVIS-695.remedy: Verify images and detections in Learning Data are correct.

CVIS-696.message: Learning Index file does not exist.
CVIS-696.cause: This is an alarm of Vision Learning Function. The Learning Index file does not exist.

CVIS-697.message: Learning Data file does not exist.
CVIS-697.cause: This is an alarm of Vision Learning Function. The Learning Data file does not exist.

CVIS-698.cause: This is an alarm of Model Learning Function. The target cannot be found in the specified images.
CVIS-698.remedy: Set up proper parameters so that targets can be found in the specified images.

CVIS-699.cause: This is an alarm of Model Learning Function. Log image size differs from size of image in Learning Data.
CVIS-699.remedy: Change image size of the selected camera and start Model Learning again.

CVIS-700.message: Circular target mark was not found.
CVIS-700.cause: Circular target mark for learning was not found. Or, the size of the mark may be too small or too large.
CVIS-700.remedy: Place circular taget marks in the field of view before learing.

CVIS-701.message: Target for learing was not found.
CVIS-701.cause: Parts for learning was not found.
CVIS-701.remedy: Place parts in the field of view before learing.

CVIS-702.message: External model train not supported with this Depalletizing VP setting.
CVIS-702.cause: The selected App. Z Mode of the Depalletizing VP is not not compatible with External Model Train.
CVIS-702.remedy: Select the Use Register Value mode.

CVIS-703.cause: The vision data was trained using a different robot.
CVIS-703.remedy: Open the vision data with correct robot, or select the correct group number.

CVIS-704.cause: There are too many vision results to send to ZDT/iRConnect at this time.
CVIS-704.remedy: If the desired vision result(s) are not being transmitted, modify the vision process to reduce the number of potential results. If the desired results are being transmitted, you may safely disregard this error.

CVIS-705.remedy: Merging 3D maps is available only when they are the same in size.

CVIS-706.message: Device for recording Vision Log doesn't exist
CVIS-706.cause: Device for recording Vision Log doesn't exist.
CVIS-706.remedy: Check the communication error with device.

CVIS-707.message: ZDT Runtime Image could not be sent.
CVIS-707.cause: ZDT could not send the runtime image.
CVIS-707.remedy: ZDT communication is likely overloaded. Consider lowering the frequency of sending ZDT data, reducing the ZDT image size in the Vision Configuration settings, or disabling ZDT images.

CVIS-708.message: Normal vectors have not been calculated.
CVIS-708.cause: Normal vectors have not been calculated in 3D Preprocess Tool
CVIS-708.remedy: Please tick Enable checkbox of Normal Calculation in 3D Preprocess Tool

CVIS-709.cause: Selected Area Sensor is not trained.

CVIS-710.message: 3D points in the model are too short
CVIS-710.cause: 3D points in the model are too short.
CVIS-710.remedy: Train a proper model including 3d points enough.

CVIS-711.message: 3D points in the model are too many
CVIS-711.cause: 3D points in the model are too many.
CVIS-711.remedy: Please reduce 3D Map Density on the setup page of 3D Area Sensor.

CVIS-713.message: Log file is too old to load.
CVIS-713.cause: The format of the log file is too old, and the controller cannot load it.
CVIS-713.remedy: Remove the log file from the device specifiled as Log Path.

CVIS-714.message: Log file is too new to load.
CVIS-714.cause: The format of the log file is too new, and the controller cannot load it.
CVIS-714.remedy: Remove the log file from the device specifiled as Log Path.

CVIS-715.message: The value set in Number of Found is too big.
CVIS-715.cause: The value set in Number of Found is too big.
CVIS-715.remedy: Change the value of Number of Found to lower value.

CVIS-719.message: LED settings cannot be changed while LED being turned on.
CVIS-719.cause: LED settings cannot changed while LED being turned on.

CVIS-720.message: Laser settings cannot be changed while laser being turned on.
CVIS-720.cause: Laser settings cannot changed while laser being turned on.

CVIS-721.message: Camera Data has not been calibrated yet.
CVIS-721.cause: The camera data has not been calibrated yet.

CVIS-722.message: The camera specified cannot be found.
CVIS-722.cause: The camera specified cannot be found.

CVIS-723.cause: Meomory consumption does not match between before and after the vision data is opened.

CVIS-724.remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

CVIS-725.remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

CVIS-726.message: Camera is already connected to the port.
CVIS-726.cause: Camera is already connected to the port.
CVIS-726.remedy: Disconnect the camera before connecting new camera.

CVIS-727.message: Resolution reduction level of input image is different on this tool and parent tool.
CVIS-727.cause: Resolution reduction level of input image is different on this tool and parent tool.
CVIS-727.remedy: Please set the resolution reduction level of this tool the same as that of the parent tool to input image.

CVIS-728.message: Two cameras are not connected to the same MUX.
CVIS-728.cause: Two cameras are not connected to the same MUX.
CVIS-728.remedy: Connect two cameras to the same MUX.

CVIS-729.message: This model id is already used.
CVIS-729.cause: Input model id is alreayd used.
CVIS-729.remedy: Please set an unique model id.

CVIS-730.message: The model id of selected result is not same with the selected reference data.
CVIS-730.cause: The model id of selected result is not same with the selected reference data.

CVIS-731.message: Can't find the result of model id.
CVIS-731.cause: There is no result with the model id of selected reference data.
CVIS-731.remedy: Please place the correct workpiece and run find.

CVIS-732.remedy: Please call ACQVAMAP correctly or click [2-3D Snap] on the setup page.

CVIS-734.message: There is an uninitialized value to calculate pick score.
CVIS-734.cause: There is an uninitialized measurement value.
CVIS-734.remedy: Please select correct measurement value to calculate pick score.

CVIS-735.message: Image Shrink tool is not trained.
CVIS-735.cause: Image Shrink tool is not trained.

CVIS-736.cause: There are too many feature points in 3D model.
CVIS-736.remedy: Please tune so that there are fewer 3D Blob or input larger value in Feature Interval.

CVIS-739.message: Resolution reduction level of input image is not valid.
CVIS-739.cause: Resolution reduction level of input image is not valid.
CVIS-739.remedy: Change resolution reduction level of input image or retrain this tool.

CVIS-740.message: Color Component tool is not trained.
CVIS-740.cause: Color Component tool is not trained.

CVIS-741.message: Flat Field tool is not trained.
CVIS-741.cause: Flat Field tool is not trained.

CVIS-742.message: Image Arithmetic tool is not trained.
CVIS-742.cause: Image Arithmetic tool is not trained.

CVIS-743.message: Candidates of 3D Blob are too many.
CVIS-743.cause: Candidates of 3D Blob are too many.
CVIS-743.remedy: Please set up so that less 3D blobs are found. The larger [Z Height] for 3D blobs connection might be effective.

CVIS-744.remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

CVIS-745.message: There is a command tool which is not trained.
CVIS-745.cause: There is a command tool which is not trained above the treeview.
CVIS-745.remedy: Please train the untrained command tool above the treeview.

CVIS-746.remedy: If you are using 3D Area Sensor, please call ACQVAMAP correctly or click [2-3D Snap] on the setup page.

CVIS-747.message: The parent tool is not trained.
CVIS-747.cause: The parent tool is not trained.

CVIS-748.message: Trained auto exposure area is out of snap window.
CVIS-748.cause: Trained auto exposure area is out of snap window.

CVIS-749.message: Trained multi exposure area is out of snap window.
CVIS-749.cause: Trained multi exposure area is out of snap window.

CVIS-750.message: Trained snap window cannot be snapped by this camera.
CVIS-750.cause: Trained snap window cannot be snapped by this camera.

CVIS-751.message: The result in VR is leaning.
CVIS-751.cause: The result in Vision Register is leaning.
CVIS-751.remedy: Use a result not leaning against the offset frame.

CVIS-753.cause: The calibration of camera has failed. There might be some invalid calibration points.
CVIS-753.remedy: Delete invalid calibration points on the setup page of calibration.

CVIS-754.message: The multi exposure area is too narrow.
CVIS-754.cause: The multi exposure area is too narrow.

CVIS-755.message: There is no valid reference position.
CVIS-755.cause: There is no valid reference position.
CVIS-755.remedy: Please teach search window, measurement area or container again.

CVIS-756.cause: A KAREL program has been executed with an argument missing.

CVIS-757.cause: A KAREL program has been executed with an argument invalid.

CVIS-758.message: 3D Area Sensor cannot be turned on/off.
CVIS-758.cause: The camera connection/disconnection function does not support 3D Area Sensor.

CVIS-759.cause: The offset type has not been selected.

CVIS-760.cause: The temperature of 3DV Sensor is rising.

CVIS-761.cause: The led of 3DV Sensor is too hot and 3DV Sensor can not acquire.

CVIS-762.cause: The bad sharpness is specified in the depth snap tool.
CVIS-762.remedy: Specify the valid value in the sharpness.

CVIS-763.cause: Data can not be loaded from 3DV Sensor.
CVIS-763.remedy: Check main board, FROM, multiplexer, cables and 3DV Sensor.

CVIS-764.message: Mounting position of 3DV Sensor is not trained.
CVIS-764.cause: The mounting potision of 3DV Sensor is not trained.
CVIS-764.remedy: Train the mounting position of 3DV Sensor.

CVIS-765.message: The depth around big dots cannot be measured.
CVIS-765.cause: The big dots cannot be found.

CVIS-767.cause: The point to be projected is invalid, for example, it is behind the camera.
CVIS-767.remedy: Please confirm that parameters are proper.

CVIS-768.cause: There is no valid 3D point. The following causes are conceivable. * The target part is not in the camera-view. * The 3D snap condition is not proper for the part and there is no measured 3D point. * The [Meas. Z Range] in the vision process is not proper.

CVIS-769.cause: All 3D points are removed in 3D Data Preprocess Tool or 3D Data Generator Tool.
CVIS-769.remedy: Please confirm that parameters are proper in the above tool.

CVIS-770.cause: 3D position and posture facing the other side of camera can't be projected to camera image. Or 2D position and posture can't be projected to the plane facing the other side of camera.
CVIS-770.remedy: Please take one of following countermeasures. 1. Please set up the offset frame correctly. The z-axis direction of the offset frame need to be roughly equal to the upward direction of the camera. 2. If you use 3DV Sensor Single View Vision Process, you can enable [Camera Base Find].

CVIS-772.remedy: Please specify a 3DV Sensor as camera data.

CVIS-773.message: The shape of model is incorrect
CVIS-773.cause: The shape of model to detect is incorrect.
CVIS-773.remedy: Please modify the model to detect.

CVIS-774.message: Camera command ID does not match
CVIS-774.cause: The camera command ID does not match.
CVIS-774.remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

CVIS-775.cause: Camera parameter error. This is an internal error.
CVIS-775.remedy: Please notify FANUC of the conditions (program executed, operation made, etc.) in which the error occurred.

CVIS-776.cause: Can't read a file because its format isn't supported.

CVIS-777.cause: The parent result doesn't support 2D position adjustments.
CVIS-777.remedy: Please remove the tool which performs position adjustment.

CVIS-778.message: Camera mounting axis is not last axis.
CVIS-778.cause: Mounting a camera on the part of the robot between J1 axis and the last axis is not supported.

CVIS-779.message: User frame has been changed after teaching.
CVIS-779.cause: User frame has been changed after teaching.

CVIS-781.message: [Camera Installation] and actual type of cameras in camera views are different
CVIS-781.cause: Setup item [Camera Installation] and actual type of cameras in camera views are different.
CVIS-781.remedy: Please change either setup item [Camera Installation] or actual type of cameras in camera views.

CVIS-783.remedy: Please make sure the setup of Depth Snap Tool.

CVIS-784.message: Sensor is tilted more than 90 degree.
CVIS-784.cause: Sensor is tilted more than 90 degree.

CVIS-785.message: Selected Camera Data does not match logged Camera Data.
CVIS-785.cause: Selected Camera Data does not match logged Camera Data.
CVIS-785.remedy: Please set Camera Data as same as that of Log.

CVIS-786.message: USB Frame Grabber cannot be connected.
CVIS-786.cause: USB Frame Grabber is not connected.
CVIS-786.remedy: Please connect a USB Frame Grabber.

CVIS-787.message: This grabber type is not supported.
CVIS-787.cause: This grabber type is not supported.
CVIS-787.remedy: Please specify supported type of grabber.

CVIS-788.message: Vision Process %s failed to locate anything
CVIS-788.cause: Nothing was located by the vision process. This may be because the part is not in the camera field of view, or its characteristics have changed and it is no longer recognized by the vision system.
CVIS-788.remedy: If the correct part is present in the camera field of view, then adjust GPM parameters and/or dedicated vision system lighting. If the part is non-conforming, remove it from the system and restart production.

CVIS-789.cause: The vision process did not find a target or no target was present to detect
CVIS-789.remedy: If the correct target is present, parameters of the vision process may need to be adjusted Lighting may also need to be adjusted in order to correctly identify the target

CVIS-790.cause: All targets were located but the relationship between them exceeds the reference combine error limit. This may be caused by 1. The current part is non-conforming and should be removed from production. 2. The reflectiveness of a target is causing its location to appear incorrect. 3. Something other than the intended target is being located.
CVIS-790.remedy: Adjusting target parameters should only be done if the root cause of this error is well understood. Increasing the Max Combine Error should only be done if testing is done to ensure the new process value does not cause equipment damage.

CVIS-791.cause: Value of 3D Vision Sensor intensity is invalid.
CVIS-791.remedy: Please re-train the intensity of 3D Vision Sensor or depth snap tool.

CVIS-792.message: This camera data is not supported with this vision process
CVIS-792.cause: The camera data is not supported with the vision process.

CVIS-794.cause: Vision log could not be exported to the specified device.
CVIS-794.remedy: Check the deveices of input source and output destination.

CVIS-795.message: The part Z height is not set.
CVIS-795.cause: The part Z height is not set.
CVIS-795.remedy: Please set the part Z height.

CVIS-796.message: The logged image buffer is full.
CVIS-796.cause: The logged image buffer is full.
CVIS-796.remedy: Add 'CALL IRVWAITLOG' in a TP program in order to specify at which line the program can wait for completion of logging.

CVIS-797.cause: The specified vision override does not exist.
CVIS-797.remedy: Check the vision override name, and enter the correct name.

CVIS-799.cause: The 3DMV Vision Process failed to locate the vehicle on the first attempt and is automatically reattempting vehicle location.
CVIS-799.remedy: This is only a notification. If successive attempts are unable to locate the vehicle, then another alarm will be posted.

CVIS-800.cause: The 3DMV Offset Server (IRVOFFSV) aborted because there are no members in the Robot Ring.
CVIS-800.remedy: Configure the Robot Ring (RIPE) to allow Robot to Robot communications before trying to run the 3DMV Offset Server.

CVIS-801.cause: The 3DMV Vision Communication handshaking sequence was interrupted unexpectedly. This can occur if a robot requests vision offset data, but its TP programs are paused or aborted before the data is received.
CVIS-801.remedy: After a timeout occurs, the 3DMV Vision Offset Server robot automatically resets the handshaking sequence to clear out incomplete transactions. No action is necessary unless this warning occurs during production, or happens repeatedly whenever any communication attempt is made.

CVIS-802.message: ZDT for vision has been disabled in config settings.
CVIS-802.cause: ZDT has been selectively disabled from the vision related view in the ZDT setup menu
CVIS-802.remedy: If ZDT messages are desired go to the vision related view in the ZDT setup menu and check enable ZDT for iRVision.

CVIS-803.message: ZDT for vision queue is full.
CVIS-803.cause: ZDT queue for vision data is full
CVIS-803.remedy: If this message persists, consider increasing the queue size limit. If vision ZDT is not required, disable it from the Vision related view in the ZDT setup menu.

CVIS-804.message: ZDT for vision has exceeded the data limit.
CVIS-804.cause: ZDT for vision data size has exceeded the data limit
CVIS-804.remedy: If this message persists,consider increasing the data size limit

CVIS-805.message: Select a same type of 3DV Sensor for all camera views.
CVIS-805.cause: The type of selected 3DV Sensor is different from that in the other camera views.
CVIS-805.remedy: Select a same type of 3DV Sensor for all camera views.

DIAG-013.remedy: Use iRDiagnostics Motion Profiler to identify lines with agressive reducer load and reduce speed or ACC or position

DIAG-014.remedy: Use iRDiagnostics Motion Profiler to identify lines with agressive reducer load and reduce speed

DICT-001.cause: A dictionary cannot be reloaded if it was loaded into FROM.
DICT-001.remedy: Load into a different language and use KCL SET LANG to set the language.

DICT-002.message: Not enough memory to load dict
DICT-002.cause: There is no more permanent memory available in the system to load another dictionary.
DICT-002.remedy: Clear all unnecessary programs, dictionaries or variables.

DICT-003.cause: There are no dictionaries loaded for the specified language.
DICT-003.remedy: Use the DEFAULT language or a language in which a dictionary has been loaded.

DICT-004.cause: The specified dictionary was not found.
DICT-004.remedy: Use KCL LOAD DICT to load the dictionary into the DEFAULT language or the current language.

DICT-005.cause: The dictionary element was not found.
DICT-005.remedy: Check the dictionary or element number to be sure it is specified correctly.

DICT-006.cause: Only five levels of dictionary elements can be nested.
DICT-006.remedy: Fix the dictionary text file to include fewer nested levels.

DICT-008.cause: The dictionary element was truncated because the KAREL string array is not large enough to hold all the data.
DICT-008.remedy: Increase either the size of the string or the number of strings in the array.

DICT-009.remedy: This is a notification. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.

DICT-010.remedy: This is a notification. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.

DICT-011.message: Dict opened by too many tasks
DICT-011.cause: Only five dictionaries can be open by one task at one time.
DICT-011.remedy: Load the dictionary to memory or close an unused dictionary.

DICT-012.message: Not enough memory to load dict
DICT-012.cause: Not enough memory exists in TEMP pool on the controller. The dictionary was not loaded.
DICT-012.remedy: This is a notification of insufficient memory resources on the controller. The hardware and software configurations need to be verified.

DICT-013.cause: The dictionary file does not exist on the specified device or in the specified directory.
DICT-013.remedy: Select the proper device/directory and try again.

DICT-014.cause: The dictionary text incorrectly specifies an element without a $.
DICT-014.remedy: Make sure all dictionary elements begin with $.

DICT-015.cause: A reserved word was not recognized in the dictionary text.
DICT-015.remedy: Check for misspelling or look up the correct word in the KAREL Reference Manual.

DICT-016.cause: The dictionary text incorrectly specifies an element without using quotes.
DICT-016.remedy: Make sure all dictionary text is surrounded by double quotes. Use a backslash if you want an actual quote to appear in the text. For example, \“This is an example\” will produce “This is an example”.

DICT-017.cause: A reference to another element is expected.
DICT-017.remedy: Use the element number to reference the element.

DICT-018.cause: The cursor position is specified incorrectly or the values are outside the limits.
DICT-018.remedy: Make sure the cursor position is valid. For example, use @1,1 for the first row and col respectively.

DICT-019.cause: A series of digits are expected after the # to specify an ASCII character code.
DICT-019.remedy: Remove the # or look up the ASCII character code in the KAREL Reference Manual.

DICT-020.cause: An identifier is expected after the and to specify a reserved word.
DICT-020.remedy: Remove the and or look up the reserved word in the KAREL Reference Manual.

DICT-021.cause: An unexpected character was found in the dictionary text file.
DICT-021.remedy: Make sure all dictionary text is correct.

DICT-022.cause: The dictionary is already open by the task.
DICT-022.remedy: This is a notification. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.

DICT-023.message: Dict does not need to be opened
DICT-023.cause: Dictionaries loaded to memory do not need to be opened.
DICT-023.remedy: Do not try to open the dictionary file.

DICT-024.cause: Dictionaries loaded to FROM cannot be removed or a dictionary cannot be removed if another task has it opened.
DICT-024.remedy: Do not try to remove a dictionary loaded to FROM. Remove the dictionary from the same task which loaded it.

DICT-028.message: Not enough memory to load dict
DICT-028.cause: Not enough memory exists in TEMP pool on the controller. The dictionary was not loaded.
DICT-028.remedy: This is a notification of insufficient memory resources on the controller. The hardware and software configurations need to be verified.

DICT-029.cause: The help dictionary element was not found.
DICT-029.remedy: Check the dictionary to be sure the help dictionary element was specified correctly. The help dictionary element must be specified with a question mark (?) followed by the element number.

DICT-030.cause: The function key dictionary element was not found.
DICT-030.remedy: Check the dictionary to be sure the function key element was specified correctly. The function key element must be specified with a caret (^) followed by the element number.

DICT-031.cause: The dictionary containing the error message could not be found.
DICT-031.remedy: Refer to the System Reference Manual for the error message.

DICT-032.cause: The error message was posted to the error log.
DICT-032.remedy: See error window or the Alarms menu for the error message.

DICT-040.cause: The dictionary text incorrectly specifies an element number.
DICT-040.remedy: Make sure all dictionary elements begin with $ followed by the element number.

DICT-041.cause: The dictionary text incorrectly specifies an element name.
DICT-041.remedy: Make sure all dictionary elements are specified as,element_name after the add constant name.

DICT-042.cause: The dictionary text was specified incorrectly.
DICT-042.remedy: Make sure all dictionary elements are specified as +add_const_name after the element number.

DICT-043.cause: The dictionary text was not specified in sequence.
DICT-043.remedy: Make sure all dictionary elements are specified in sequential order.

DICT-044.message: Warning - large hole in ele seq
DICT-044.cause: The dictionary text has a large gap between element numbers.
DICT-044.remedy: Reduce the gap in the element sequence. Each missing element uses up five bytes of memory.

DICT-045.cause: The dictionary text was specified incorrectly.
DICT-045.remedy: Verify that each.LIT is matched with a.END.

DICT-046.cause: The dictionary text was specified incorrectly.

DICT-047.cause: The dictionary compressor expects a file extension.
DICT-047.remedy: Use the.etx file extension for error text, the.utx file extension for uncompressed text, or the.ftx file extension for form text.

DICT-048.cause: The dictionary compressor did not recognize the file extension.
DICT-048.remedy: Use the.etx file extension for error text, the.utx file extension for uncompressed text, or the.ftx file extension for form text.

DICT-049.cause: The dictionary compressor expects a file name.
DICT-049.remedy: Specify a file name after the command.

DICT-050.cause: The dictionary compressor expects a facility number in the.KL command.
DICT-050.remedy: Specify the facility number after the file name.

DICT-051.cause: An invalid command was specified for this type of dictionary file.
DICT-051.remedy: Check the command and if a form is used, verify the file extension is.ftx.

DICT-052.cause: The dictionary text was specified incorrectly.
DICT-052.remedy: Verify that each.FORM is matched with a.ENDFORM.

DICT-053.cause: The include file could not be created.
DICT-053.remedy: Make sure a valid file name has been specified.

DICT-054.cause: The form you are trying to compress is currently being displayed.
DICT-054.remedy: Abort the KAREL program that is displaying the form.

DICT-055.cause: %% is not allowed in KANJI string
DICT-055.remedy: End the KANJI string with a single quote. Use double quotes around the format specifier and afterwards resume the KANJI string with single quotes.

DJOG-000.remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC America Corporation representative.

DJOG-003.remedy: Engage all the brakes and reset

DJOG-005.message: Prog has MCTL of DJOG group

DJOG-006.cause: Robot not clear of DJOG cell

DJOG-020.remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC America Corporation representative.

DJOG-021.remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC America Corporation representative.

DJOG-031.cause: Run program while same group djog is enable

DMDR-001.cause: This will be reported when adjusting mode is canceled and normal mode is selected.
DMDR-001.remedy: Calibration will be lost when this error is posted. Calibration is required to run the program after canceling adjusting mode.

DMDR-002.cause: This will be reported when a master axis is selected in adjusting mode.
DMDR-002.remedy: Set $DUAL_DRIVE.$ADJUST_SEL to 0 when you cancel adjusting mode. Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

DMDR-003.cause: This will be reported when a slave axis is selected in adjusting mode.
DMDR-003.remedy: Set $DUAL_DRIVE.$ADJUST_SEL to 0 when you cancel adjusting mode. Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

DMDR-004.cause: This will be reported when a wrong number is selected in adjusting mode.
DMDR-004.remedy: Set $DUAL_DRIVE.$ADJUST_SEL to the valid number. Variable settings: • 0: Both axes move coordinately • 1: A master axis only moves. • 2: A slave axis only moves. NOTE: Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

DMDR-005.cause: The position inconsistency between a master axis and a slave axis is too large. That is, $DUAL_DRIVE.$POS_GAP has exceeded $DUAL_DRIVE.$POS_GAPTOL.
DMDR-005.remedy: See if no mechanical problem exists. Or, tune up $DUAL_ DRIVE.$POS_GAPTOL properly again. Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

DMDR-006.cause: Motion command inconsistency between a master axis and a slave axis is too large. That is, $DUAL_DRIVE.$CMD_GAP1 has exceeded $DUAL_DRIVE. $CMD_GAPTOL1.
DMDR-006.remedy: See that no mechanical problem exists. Or tune up $DUAL_ DRIVE.$CMD_GAPTOL1 properly again.

DMDR-007.cause: Motion command inconsistency between a master axis and a slave axis is too large. That is, $DUAL_DRIVE.$CMD_GAP2 has exceeded $DUAL_DRIVE. $CMD_GAPTOL2.
DMDR-007.remedy: See that no mechanical problem exists. Or tune up $DUAL_ DRIVE.$CMD_GAPTOL2 properly again.

DMDR-008.cause: The motion command inconsistency between a master axis and a slave axis is too large. That is, $DUAL_DRIVE.$CMD_GAP3 has exceeded $DUAL_DRIVE.$CMD_GAPTOL3.
DMDR-008.remedy: See that no mechanical problem exists. Or, tune up $DUAL_ DRIVE.$CMD_GAPTOL3 properly again.

DMDR-009.cause: The servo error inconsistency between a master axis and a slave axis is too large. That is, $DUAL_DRIVE.$SYNC_ER has exceeded $DUAL_DRIVE. $SYNC_ER_TOL.
DMDR-009.remedy: See that no mechanical problem exists. Or, tune synchronous compensation parameters again. Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

DMDR-021.cause: This will be reported when you perform calibration under adjusting mode.
DMDR-021.remedy: Cancel adjusting mode first when you perform calibration. Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

DMDR-031.cause: There is insufficient memory (DRAM) to allocate memory for the Dual-Drive option.
DMDR-031.remedy: Check the amount of memory(DRAM) being used by the system. Replace the CPU card to the one that has a larger memory size if necessary.

DMER-001.cause: This will be reported when adjusting mode is canceled and normal mode is selected.
DMER-001.remedy: Calibration will be lost when this error is posted. Calibration is required to run the program after canceling adjusting mode.

DMER-002.cause: This will be reported when a master axis is selected in adjusting mode.
DMER-002.remedy: Set $DUAL_DRIVE.$ADJUST_SEL to 0 when you cancel adjusting mode. Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

DMER-003.cause: This will be reported when a slave axis is selected in adjusting mode.
DMER-003.remedy: Set $DUAL_DRIVE.$ADJUST_SEL to 0 when you cancel adjusting mode. Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

DMER-004.cause: This will be reported when a wrong number is selected in adjusting mode.
DMER-004.remedy: Set $DUAL_DRIVE.$ADJUST_SEL to the valid number. 0: Both axes move coordinately 1: A master axis only moves 2: A slave axis only moves Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

DMER-005.cause: Position inconsistency between a master axis and a slave axis is too large. That is, $DUAL_ DRIVE.$POS_GAP has exceeded $DUAL_DRIVE.$POS_GAPTOL.
DMER-005.remedy: See if there is no mechanical problem. Or tune up $DUAL_ DRIVE.$POS_GAPTOL properly again. Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

DMER-006.cause: Motion command inconsistency between a master axis and a slave axis is too large. That is, $DUAL_DRIVE.$CMD_GAP1 has exceeded $DUAL_DRIVE. $CMD_GAPTOL1.
DMER-006.remedy: See if there is no mechanical problem. Or tune up $DUAL_ DRIVE.$CMD_GAPTOL1 properly again.

DMER-007.cause: Motion command inconsistency between a master axis and a slave axis is too large. That is, $DUAL_DRIVE.$CMD_GAP2 has exceeded $DUAL_DRIVE. $CMD_GAPTOL2.
DMER-007.remedy: See if there is no mechanical problem. Or tune up $DUAL_ DRIVE.$CMD_GAPTOL2 properly again.

DMER-008.cause: Motion command inconsistency between a master axis and a slave axis is too large. That is, $DUAL_DRIVE.$CMD_GAP3 has exceeded $DUAL_DRIVE. $CMD_GAPTOL3.
DMER-008.remedy: See if there is no mechanical problem. Or tune up $DUAL_ DRIVE.$CMD_GAPTOL3 properly again.

DMER-009.cause: Servo error inconsistency between a master axis and a slave axis is too large. That is, $DUAL_DRIVE.$SYNC_ER has exceeded $DUAL_DRIVE. $SYNC_ER_TOL.
DMER-009.remedy: See if there is no mechanical problem. Or tune synchronous compensation parameters again. Calibration will be lost when this error is posted.

DMER-010.cause: Internal data does not exist at execution of Sample Start/End.
DMER-010.remedy: Check the available size of permanent memory. Perform controlled start.

DMER-011.cause: A Sample Start instruction has already been executed.
DMER-011.remedy: Remove the duplicate Sample Start instruction.

DMER-012.cause: Sampling has already been started by another task.
DMER-012.remedy: Sample with one task at a time when using multiple tasks.

DMER-013.cause: The executing Data Monitor schedule specifies an invalid item number.
DMER-013.remedy: Edit the Data Monitor schedule specified in the program. Correct all monitored items which do not have item numbers in the range of 1 to $DMONCFG.$NUM_DM_ITMS.

DMER-014.cause: The item type is not supported for sampling.

DMER-015.cause: The sampling schedule references an invalid item number.
DMER-015.remedy: Change the item number in the sampleing schedule.

DMER-016.cause: The register n referenced by the Sample Start[R[n]] instruction is not a valid type.
DMER-016.remedy: Change the register type in the DATA screen.

DMER-017.cause: The Data Monitor functions is checking this item. The item is past the warning limit.

DMER-018.cause: The Data Monitor function is checking this item. The item is past the pause limit.

DMER-019.cause: Data Monitor cannot save data to the specified device.
DMER-019.remedy: Check the if the device listed in the schedule is available.

DMER-020.cause: The Data Monitor record buffer became full.
DMER-020.remedy: Decrease the record frequency or increase the record buffer size and cold start.

DMER-021.cause: The device specified in the Data Monitor schedule does not have enough file space available.
DMER-021.remedy: Use a memory card or floppy disk with more memory available or specify a smaller file_size in the Data Monitor schedule.

DMER-022.cause: The file size specified in the Data Monitor schedule is invalid. This error is reported if the file size specified is negative or larger than the media you are using.
DMER-022.remedy: Make sure the file size specified in the Data Monitor schedule is not negative and is less than the size of the media you are using. If you specify the file_size to be zero, Data Monitor only checks that there is at least one free block available

DMER-023.cause: The data file created on the specified device does not contain a complete record of the sampling session from Sample Start to Sample End. This is most likely due to insufficient memory on the specified device.
DMER-023.remedy: Increase the amount of available memory on the device. Delete old data files if necessary. Reduce the recording rate specified in the schedule. Reduce the time between the Sample Start and Sample End.

DMER-024.cause: Data Monitor is not saving data to the specified device.
DMER-024.remedy: Verify the device listed in the schedule is available.

DMER-025.cause: The type specified for a Data Monitor item does not match the type of the variable being monitored.
DMER-025.remedy: Correct the item type in the Data Monitor screen, and retry the operation.

DMER-026.cause: There is not enough memory to allocate the size of the requested pipe.
DMER-026.remedy: Select a smaller size for the pipe, or select a different device.

DMER-027.cause: Data Monitor was not able to write data to the pipe.
DMER-027.remedy: Reallocate the pipe by changing the pipe size or device using the system variables $DMONCFG.$PIP_SIZE and $DMONCFG.$PIP_DEV_TYP.

DMER-031.cause: Data Acquisition task is not active on the system.
DMER-031.remedy: Make sure the Data Acquisition option has been loaded. Contact FANUC America Corporation for assistance.

DMER-032.cause: The Data Acquisition system has encountered a critical failure.
DMER-032.remedy: Contact FANUC America Corporation for assistance.

DMER-033.cause: The Data Acquisition system failed to initialize properly.
DMER-033.remedy: Contact FANUC America Corporation for assistance.

DMER-034.cause: The tag used for referencing a Data Acquisition pipe is invalid.
DMER-034.remedy: Check the value of the tag to make sure it falls within the proper limits.

DMER-035.cause: The Data Acquisition pipe you are attempting to register has already been registered in the system.
DMER-035.remedy: Unregister the pipe and attempt the operation again.

DMER-036.cause: The Data Acquisition pipe you are attempting to use has not been registered.
DMER-036.remedy: DAQ pipes must be registered by a controller task before they can be used.

DMER-037.cause: You are attempting to activate a Data Acquisition pipe which is already active.

DMER-038.cause: No global files are available to be used by the Data Acquisition system.
DMER-038.remedy: Close a global file before re-attempting this operation.

DMER-039.cause: The pipe you have attempted to use could not be activated for some reason.
DMER-039.remedy: Check all parameters of the activation call.

DMER-040.cause: The pipe you are attempting to access has not been activated.
DMER-040.remedy: Activate the pipe before attempting this operation.

DMER-041.cause: The Data Acquisition system has run out of memory.
DMER-041.remedy: Remove programs to free controller memory, then re-attempt the operation.

DMER-042.cause: You have specified an invalid output device.
DMER-042.remedy: Check the device parameter you have specified.

DMER-043.cause: The output operation you are attempting cannot be performed using the current output device.
DMER-043.remedy: Check the parameters of your output operation.

DMER-044.cause: No output file has been defined for the requested operation.
DMER-044.remedy: Define an output file for the pipe, then re-attempt the operation.

DMER-045.cause: The specified Data Acquisition monitor could not be located.
DMER-045.remedy: Correct your monitor parameter for the requested operation.

DMER-046.cause: You are attempting to add a Data Acquisition monitor which already exists.
DMER-046.remedy: Use the existing monitor, or remove the existing monitor before proceeding.

DMER-047.cause: No client device tags are available for use.
DMER-047.remedy: Deallocate one or more client tags before proceeding.

DMER-048.cause: The specified client tag is not being used.
DMER-048.remedy: Check the client tag parameter to make sure the correct tag is specified.

DMER-049.cause: A mismatch has been detected between the specified data size and the data size for the pipe.

DMER-050.cause: A bad parameter has been detected in the routine call.
DMER-050.remedy: Check all parameter values before making the routine call.

DMER-051.cause: Monitors are still active when you attempted the current operation.
DMER-051.remedy: Remove monitors from the pipe before attempting the operation.

DMER-052.cause: The memory type parameter is invalid.

DMER-053.cause: The pipe size parameter is invalid.

DMER-054.cause: The program name parameter is invalid.

DMER-055.cause: The variable name parameter is invalid.

DMER-056.cause: The output mode parameter is invalid.

DMER-057.cause: The specified task ID does not match the task ID used to register the pipe.
DMER-057.remedy: Unregister the pipe only from the task in which the pipe was registered.

DMER-058.cause: The specified pipe name is invalid.
DMER-058.remedy: Check the name of the pipe for a null string or invalid characters.

DMER-100.remedy: Set the index properly, and retry the operation.

DMER-101.cause: A KAREL variable has been specified that does not exist.
DMER-101.remedy: Confirm whether the variable name is correct. Confirm if specified program is loaded. Then, retry the operation.

DMER-102.cause: The KAREL variable for the data output must be an array.

DMER-103.cause: The KAREL variable to store the number of record must not be an array.
DMER-103.remedy: Use a variable that is not an array.

DMER-104.cause: The KAREL variable for data output is used up.
DMER-104.remedy: Change the setup for the array to accomodate all records. Or increase the number of elements of the array.

DMER-105.cause: The KAREL variable for data output is used up.
DMER-105.remedy: Change setup for the array to accomodate all records. Or increase the number of elements of the array.

DMER-106.cause: The KAREL variable for data output must be a single dimension array.

DMER-107.cause: The Data Monitor item to be sampled specifies an invalid axis number.
DMER-107.remedy: Edit the Data Monitor Item to be sampled to specify the correct axis number and group number. The present axis should be specified.

DMER-110.cause: Data Monitor has been already runnning.

DNET-001.cause: The system device definition file is missing from the system.
DNET-001.remedy: INIT start and reload the DeviceNet Interface option. If the error still exists, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

DNET-002.cause: The application device definition file is missing from the system.
DNET-002.remedy: INIT start and reload the DeviceNet Interface option. If the error still exists, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

DNET-003.cause: There are too many DeviceNet motherboards connected to the robot controller.
DNET-003.remedy: Turn off controller power. Disconnect one of the DeviceNet motherboards. Re-connect any DeviceNet cables to the other DeviceNet motherboard. Power on your controller.

DNET-004.cause: The specified board has failed to initialize.
DNET-004.remedy: Make sure the board parameters are correct. Make sure the board is properly connected to the network and power is supplied.

DNET-005.cause: The text based device definition is invalid. It is missing one of the required fields or the values specified are invalid.
DNET-005.remedy: Correct the text based device definition and then use it. Refer to the header in MD:dndef.dg for more information regarding validity and required fields.

DNET-006.remedy: Document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

DNET-008.cause: An invalid board index has been specified.
DNET-008.remedy: Specify a board index between 0 and 3.

DNET-009.cause: An invalid MAC Id has been specified.
DNET-009.remedy: Specify a MAC Id between 0 and 63 inclusive.

DNET-010.cause: The specified board is already on-line.
DNET-010.remedy: Take the board off-line before attempting the operation.

DNET-011.cause: The specified board is not on-line.
DNET-011.remedy: Put the board on-line before attempting the operation.

DNET-012.cause: The specified device is already on-line.
DNET-012.remedy: Take the device off-line before attempting the operation.

DNET-013.cause: The specified device is not on-line.
DNET-013.remedy: Put the device on-line before attempting the operation.

DNET-014.cause: The attempted DeviceNet command request has timed out.
DNET-014.remedy: Check all network connections. If all connections appear to be in order, re-attempt the command.

DNET-015.cause: The specified board has not been initialized.
DNET-015.remedy: Initialize the board by attempting to put it on-line, and then cycle power. Then, re-attempt the operation.

DNET-016.cause: The DeviceNet Interface system has failed.
DNET-016.remedy: Cold start the system. If the problem persists, INIT start or reload the system. If the problem continues to persist, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

DNET-017.cause: The specified board was not found in the system.
DNET-017.remedy: Make sure the daughter boards are properly configured and properly seated on the motherboard.

DNET-019.cause: The code file required to initialize the board cannot be accessed.
DNET-019.remedy: Cold start the system. If the problem persists, INIT start and reload the DeviceNet Interface option.

DNET-020.cause: The code file required to initialize the board cannot be read.
DNET-020.remedy: Cold start the system. If the problem persists, INIT start and reload the DeviceNet Interface option.

DNET-021.cause: There is a problem with the DeviceNet scanner code file.
DNET-021.remedy: Cold start the system. If the problem persists, INIT start and reload the DeviceNet Interface option. If the problem continues to persist, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

DNET-022.cause: The board initialization routine has timed out.
DNET-022.remedy: Turn the controller off. Make sure the motherboard is correctly seated on the back plane. Cold start the controller. If the problem persists, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

DNET-023.cause: An error has occurred in the board initialization process.
DNET-023.remedy: Cycle power to the controller. If the problem persists, turn the controller off and check the motherboard connection to the back plane. Cold start the controller. If the problem persists, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

DNET-025.cause: A data mismatch has occurred such that the system cannot find a device assigned for the specified board number and MAC Id.
DNET-025.remedy: Turn the controller off and cold start the controller. If the problem persists, delete the board from the Board List screen, reconfigure the board, and re-add devices to the Device List. Cycle power. Also, check the device MAC Id configurations.

DNET-026.message: No match on dev type look-up
DNET-026.cause: The system cannot find the specified device type in its list of defined device types.
DNET-026.remedy: Check the selected device type on the Device List. Next, check the Defined Device List and the Standard Device Definition List for the required device type. If it does not appear, go to the Defined Device List and add the required device definition, then select it on the Device List screen. When you have finished, turn off then turn on the controller.

DNET-027.cause: The device at the specified board number and MAC Id cannot be brought on-line.
DNET-027.remedy: Make sure the device is properly connected to the network. Check the device's MAC Id and baud rate configuration. Check the board's baud rate configuration on the Board Detail screen. Check the board's network connection. Cold Start the controller.

DNET-028.cause: The specified board cannot be brought on-line.
DNET-028.remedy: Make sure the board is properly connected to the network. Check that network power is being supplied. Check that baud rates for the board and devices are in agreement. Cold Start the controller.

DNET-030.message: Std dev file fmt err: Line %d
DNET-030.cause: There is an error in the format of the specified device definition file, on the specified line.
DNET-030.remedy: Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative to obtain a correct device definition file.

DNET-031.message: App dev file fmt err: Line %d
DNET-031.cause: There is an error in the format of the specified device definition file, on the specified line.
DNET-031.remedy: Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative to obtain a correct device definition file.

DNET-033.cause: An unknown keyword has been found in the device definition files.
DNET-033.remedy: Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-034.cause: The user must turn power off and on to the controller to bring online a newly-added device to a board's device list.
DNET-034.remedy: Cycle power to the controller. You will then be able to bring the device online.

DNET-035.message: Bad format or out of range
DNET-035.cause: An integer value in the device definition files is incorrect.
DNET-035.remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-036.cause: The specified line was not found in a device definition file.
DNET-036.remedy: Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-037.cause: The specified line was not found in a device definition file.
DNET-037.remedy: Document the events that led to the error and contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-038.cause: The specified lines were not found in a device definition file.
DNET-038.remedy: Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-039.cause: The specified lines were incorrect in a device definition file.
DNET-039.remedy: Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-040.cause: A definition was incorrect in a device definition file.
DNET-040.remedy: Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-041.cause: A definition was incorrect in a device definition file.
DNET-041.remedy: Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-042.cause: The specified line was not found in a device definition file.
DNET-042.remedy: Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-043.cause: The specified line was not found in a device definition file.
DNET-043.remedy: Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-044.cause: The specified line was not found in a device definition file.
DNET-044.remedy: Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-045.cause: The specified line was not found in a device definition file.
DNET-045.remedy: Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-046.cause: The specified line was not found in a device definition file.
DNET-046.remedy: Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-047.cause: The DeviceNet motherboard is not plugged into the back plane.
DNET-047.remedy: Turn off the controller and make sure the motherboard is properly seated into the back plane of the controller. Cold start the controller.

DNET-048.cause: The device definition file has too many I/O access modes designated as DEFAULT. Only one mode should be designated as DEFAULT.
DNET-048.remedy: Remove the DEFAULT designation from all I/O access modes except one.

DNET-049.cause: Text based device definition does not have the device name for the device.
DNET-049.remedy: Supply a device name along with the device definition and then use the text based device definition. The device name is required and is the primary identification for that definition.

DNET-050.cause: An problem has occurred with the specified daughter board or the DeviceNet network connected to it. The problem is not severe enough to disrupt communications, but should be addressed as soon as possible.
DNET-050.remedy: Refer to the next DNET alarm posted in the alarm log for specific alarm recovery information.

DNET-051.cause: The DeviceNet scanner has detected an abnormal number of communications errors on the network. This message is a warning that the scanner may go offline if errors continue to occur at an abnormal rate.
DNET-051.remedy: Check your network topology to ensure conformance with DeviceNet standards. Check that your network terminators are in place and properly connected. Check that your network power supply is able to handle all of the devices on the network. Ensure that you are using properly shielded cables and connectors.

DNET-052.cause: The specified line was incorrect in the device definition file.
DNET-052.remedy: Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-053.cause: An extraneous line was found in a device definition file.
DNET-053.remedy: Check the Standard Device Definition List to see if device types have been properly loaded. If not, contact FANUC America Corporation to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-054.message: All space in shared RAM used
DNET-054.cause: There is no space left in the DeviceNet I/O buffer.
DNET-054.remedy: Contact FANUC America Corporation to report the problem. Provide all details of the DeviceNet network, including number and type of devices, baud rates, MAC Ids, and network wiring configuration.

DNET-055.cause: An error has occurred with the specified daughter board or the DeviceNet network connected to it.
DNET-055.remedy: Refer to the Cause and Remedy of the cause code (displayed immediately below this error code on the teach pendant).

DNET-056.cause: Power has been removed from the DeviceNet network.
DNET-056.remedy: Check the cable connecting the daughter board to the DeviceNet network. Also, check the connection to the power source. Cycle power to the controller.

DNET-057.cause: A network communications error has occurred on the network connected to the specified board.
DNET-057.remedy: Check that the board's baud rate corresponds to that of the devices. Check cable connections to both the board and devices. Check that the proper device definitions are selected for the devices on the network and that parameters are correct for user-defined devices. Turn off both the controller and the DeviceNet network power, then cold start the controller.

DNET-058.cause: The board has received more messages than it can handle at one time.
DNET-058.remedy: The problem may be momentary; attempt to bring the board on-line again. If the problem persists, check that the board baud rate corresponds to the baud rate of the devices. Turn off then turn on the controller.

DNET-059.cause: The board has missed a message over the DeviceNet network.
DNET-059.remedy: The problem might be momentary; attempt to bring the board on-line again. If the problem persists, check that the board baud rate corresponds to the baud rate of the devices. Turn off then turn on power to the controller.

DNET-060.cause: The traffic on the DeviceNet network is too heavy for the board to communicate with the devices.
DNET-060.remedy: Check that the board baud rate agrees with the baud rate of the devices. If no baud rate problem exists, turn off both the controller and the DeviceNet network power, then turn on both.

DNET-061.cause: All of the devices expected by the board to be on the network appear to be disconnected to the network.
DNET-061.remedy: Check cable connections to the board and to the devices. If a device has been disconnected, reconnect and press RESET on the teach pendant. Check that the board baud rate is the same as baud rate of the devices.

DNET-062.message: Bus off due to comm errors
DNET-062.cause: The board is not communicating to the network because there are too many errors.
DNET-062.remedy: Check that the baud rate of the board and of the devices is the same. Make sure that power is connected to the DeviceNet network. Press RESET on the teach pendant. If the problem persists, begin removing devices from the network; after each device is removed, press RESET. When the board is brought on-line, check the device configuration and the parameters of the device definition.

DNET-063.cause: An error has occurred with the device at the specified board number and MAC Id.
DNET-063.remedy: Refer to the Cause and Remedy for the cause code (displayed directly beneath this error code on the teach pendant).

DNET-064.cause: An error has occurred when attempting connection to the specified device.
DNET-064.remedy: Check that the baud rate of the device agrees with the board baud rate. Check that the device is properly connected to the network; make sure the device is receiving power from the network. Inspect the device definition to see that the I/O type, access mode, and size of I/O are correct. Press RESET on the teach pendant to re-attempt connection.

DNET-065.cause: The vendor Id for the device, as specified in the device definition, is incorrect.
DNET-065.remedy: Delete the device from the Device List. Check the device documentation for the correct vendor Id. Make corrections in the device definition and add the device to the Device List.

DNET-066.cause: The product code for the device, as specified in the device definition, is incorrect.
DNET-066.remedy: Delete the device from the Device List. Check the device documentation for the correct product code. Make corrections in the device definition and add the device to the Device List.

DNET-067.cause: The device type for the device, as specified in the device definition, is incorrect.
DNET-067.remedy: Delete the device from the Device List. Check the device documentation for the correct device type. Make corrections in the device definition and add the device to the Device List.

DNET-068.cause: The connection to the specified device has timed out.
DNET-068.remedy: Check the device's connection to the network. Make sure the device baud rate agrees with the board baud rate. Attempt to bring the device on-line by pressing RESET on the teach pendant.

DNET-069.cause: An unknown error has occurred with the specified device.
DNET-069.remedy: Document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative. Make sure the error code number is noted and reported.

DNET-070.cause: An error has occurred when attempting connection to the specified device.
DNET-070.remedy: Check that the baud rate of the device agrees with the board baud rate. Check that the device is properly connected to the network; make sure the device is receiving power from the network. Inspect the device definition to see that the I/O type, access mode, and size of I/O are correct. Press RESET on the teach pendant to re-attempt connection.

DNET-071.cause: You have two or more DeviceNet daughter boards with the same board number configuration.
DNET-071.remedy: Re-configure the DIP switches on your daughter boards so that you no longer have duplicates. DIP switch configuration information is found in the User's Guide to the FANUC America Corporation DeviceNet Interface.

DNET-072.cause: This cause code is posted together with DNET-071 above to allow the user to easily identify the duplicate daughter board. Please see the Cause text for DNET-071 for more information.
DNET-072.remedy: Please see the Remedy text for DNET-071 to fix this problem.

DNET-073.message: No match on mod type look-up
DNET-073.cause: The system could not find the module type corresponding to a module on the specified device.
DNET-073.remedy: View the module list for the device and delete or change the module in question. If this module was previously functional, cold start the controller and attempt to use this module type again. If the problem persists, perform an INIT start and re-load the DeviceNet Interface option.

DNET-074.cause: An I/O configuration file (.IO file) containing DeviceNet configuration data was loaded at COLD START. The DeviceNet configuration data in this file is ignored.
DNET-074.remedy: Reload the.IO file at controlled start.

DNET-076.cause: There is no more room in the Defined Device List system variable.
DNET-076.remedy: Delete any unneeded device definitions from the Defined Device List before adding a new one.

DNET-077.message: DNet I/O inactive at CTRL start
DNET-077.cause: At controlled start, I/O data assigned to DeviceNet devices is not active.
DNET-077.remedy: This message is for informational purposes only. To make DeviceNet I/O active, COLD start the controller.

DNET-078.cause: The system variable for storage of devices is full.
DNET-078.remedy: If there are devices which are off-line, delete these devices unless they are required to be kept on the Device List. After entries in the device list are freed, new devices can be added.

DNET-079.cause: The device type used by this device is currently unknown to the system.
DNET-079.remedy: This error occurs during the I/O restore. Cold start the controller, add a new device definition corresponding to the specified device, then add the device to the device list.

DNET-080.cause: The previous I/O configuration contains too many modules, devices, or device definitions to be loaded.
DNET-080.remedy: Make sure you have the same memory configuration as the system on which the I/O configuration was saved.

DNET-082.cause: This message appears when a board automatically restarts communication with a DeviceNet network, but some or all devices are not designated as autoreconnecting. Pressing RESET will attempt reconnection with these devices.
DNET-082.remedy: Pressing RESET will attempt reconnection with the non-communicating devices and clear this message.

DNET-083.cause: A board which was previously in error state has automatically restarted communications with the DeviceNet network.
DNET-083.remedy: This message is intended for user notification only and does not indicate the presence of an error situation.

DNET-084.cause: The command to reset the specified board has failed.
DNET-084.remedy: Refer to the Cause and Remedy for the cause code (displayed directly beneath this error code on the teach pendant).

DNET-085.cause: The command to reset the specified device has failed.
DNET-085.remedy: Refer to the Cause and Remedy for the cause code (displayed directly beneath this error code on the teach pendant).

DNET-086.cause: The specified board is unable to acknowledge the stop-scanning command.
DNET-086.remedy: Check DeviceNet connection to the board, as well as DeviceNet power to the network. If board is already in ERROR state, this error can be disregarded.

DNET-087.cause: The board is not acknowledging the command to take it off-line.
DNET-087.remedy: Check DeviceNet connection to the board, as well as DeviceNet power to the network. If the board is already in the ERROR state, this error can be disregarded.

DNET-088.cause: The system does not recognize the module type of the module being loaded.
DNET-088.remedy: Make sure the device definition data files are the same between the current system being loaded and the system on which the I/O configuration was saved. Contact FANUC America Corporation for the correct definition files.

DNET-089.cause: The data file contains lines which specify both POLL access and STROBE access for the same device.
DNET-089.remedy: Contact FANUC America Corporation to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-090.cause: The device definition file specifies a strobed-access device but the number of outputs is not equal to zero.
DNET-090.remedy: Contact FANUC America Corporation to obtain the correct device definition files.

DNET-091.cause: The number of inputs specified in the device definition for this device does not match the number expected by the scanner when it communicates with the device.
DNET-091.remedy: Delete the device, correct the device definition, then re-add the device to the device list.

DNET-092.cause: The number of outputs specified in the device definition for this device does not match the number expected by the scanner when it communicates with the device.
DNET-092.remedy: Delete the device, correct the device definition, then re-add the device to the device list.

DNET-093.cause: The scanner board encountered an error while trying to read the device's vendor ID.
DNET-093.remedy: Check that the device baud rate matches the board baud rate. Check also the device's connection to the network.

DNET-094.cause: The scanner board encountered an error while trying to read the device's device type.
DNET-094.remedy: Check that the device baud rate matches the board baud rate. Check also the device's connection to the network.

DNET-095.cause: The scanner board encountered an error while trying to read the device's product code.
DNET-095.remedy: Check that the device baud rate matches the board baud rate. Check also the device's connection to the network.

DNET-096.cause: The scanner board encountered an error while trying to set the communication packet rate for this device.
DNET-096.remedy: Check that the device baud rate matches the board baud rate. Check also the device's connection to the network. Reset the device if possible.

DNET-097.cause: The board was unable to achieve synchronization in the connection with the specified device.
DNET-097.remedy: Check that the device baud rate matches the board baud rate. Check also the device's connection to the network. Reset the device if possible.

DNET-098.remedy: Check that the board status is ONLINE. Check that the board is not the only node.

DNET-100.message: NULL cmd error ret'd by board
DNET-100.cause: The board returned an error response to the command.
DNET-100.remedy: This is a system error. Document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC or FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

DNET-101.message: CMD cmd error ret'd by board
DNET-101.cause: The board returned an error response to the command.
DNET-101.remedy: This is a system error. Document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC or FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

DNET-102.cause: The board's MAC Id is not between 0 and 63.
DNET-102.remedy: Check the Board Detail screen to see if the board's MAC Id is between 0 - 63, inclusive. If it is not, change the MAC Id to a valid value and press RESET on the teach pendant. If the MAC Id appears valid, cold start the controller. If the problem persists, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

DNET-103.cause: The board's baud rate is not one of: 125 KB, 250 KB, or 500 KB.
DNET-103.remedy: Check the Board Detail screen to see if the board's baud rate is one of the above values. If it is not, change the baud rate to a valid value and press RESET on the teach pendant. If the baud rate appears valid, cold start the controller. If the problem persists, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

DNET-104.cause: The specified device has the same MAC Id as another device on the network.
DNET-104.remedy: Check that no other devices have the same MAC Id, particularly those connected to a different master on the same network. Change the MAC Id of the offending device at both the device and on the Device List, and attempt to bring it on-line. If the problem persists, cold start the controller and try again. If the problem continues, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

DNET-105.cause: There was an attempt to add a device to the board's device list that was a duplicate of a device already on the list.
DNET-105.remedy: If the desired device is already on the network and a second one is not being added, you may ignore the error. Otherwise, change the MAC Id of one of the duplicate devices.

DNET-106.cause: A device expected to be on the network was not found.
DNET-106.remedy: Check that the device is connected to the network. Check that the device baud rate matches the board baud rate. Reset the device if possible. Cycle power to the controller. If the problem persists, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

DNET-107.cause: The board could not perform an operation because the bus was off-line.
DNET-107.remedy: Press RESET on the teach pendant to attempt to bring the board on-line. If the problem persists, cycle power to the controller. If the problem continues to persist, cycle power to the DeviceNet network.

DNET-108.cause: The board could not perform an operation because the it is actively scanning the network.
DNET-108.remedy: Take the board off-line and re-attempt the operation.

DNET-109.cause: The board could not perform an operation because the bus is not off-line.
DNET-109.remedy: Take the board off-line and re-attempt the operation.

DNET-110.cause: The board could not perform an operation because the it is actively scanning the network.
DNET-110.remedy: Take the board off-line and re-attempt the operation.

DNET-111.cause: The board could not perform an operation because the it is not actively scanning the network.
DNET-111.remedy: Bring the board on-line and re-attempt the operation.

DNET-112.cause: An attempt to bring the board on-line was unsuccessful because the board was busy.
DNET-112.remedy: Wait ten seconds and re-attempt to bring the board on-line. If the problem persists, check board connection to the network, baud rate, and network power.

DNET-114.cause: The board has detected a fault on the DeviceNet network, and cannot communicate with devices.
DNET-114.remedy: Check that the baud rate of the board matches the baud rate of all devices on the network. Also, check that power is being supplied to the network. If the problem persists, cycle power to the controller, and then to the network if the problem continues.

DNET-115.cause: A device does not support the requested I/O connection(s). and cannot communicate with devices.
DNET-115.remedy: Check the device documentation to ensure that the requested I/O connection is supported.

DNET-119.cause: This is an Ack Fault. No acknowledge was received during the Duplicate MAC ID sequence.
DNET-119.remedy: Check whether the interface is not the only node on the network. Also check the baud rate of the interface and make sure it is the network baud rate. Finally, check the physical wiring of the network.

DNET-120.cause: The device at the specified board number and MAC Id cannot be brought on-line.
DNET-120.remedy: Make sure the device is properly connected to the network. Check the device's MAC Id and baud rate configuration. Check the board's baud rate configuration on the Board Detail screen. Check the board's network connection. Cold Start the controller.

DNET-121.cause: When a device has been added to a scan list, it cannot be brought online without cycling power to the controller.
DNET-121.remedy: Cycle power to the controller. You will then be able to bring the device online.

DNET-122.cause: An error has occurred with the device at the specified board number and MAC Id.
DNET-122.remedy: Refer to the Cause and Remedy for the cause code (displayed directly beneath this error code on the teach pendant).

DNET-123.cause: The command to reset the specified device has failed.
DNET-123.remedy: Refer to the Cause and Remedy for the cause code (displayed directly beneath this error code on the teach pendant).

DNET-124.cause: This message appears when a board automatically restarts communication with a DeviceNet network, but some or all devices are not designated as autoreconnecting. Pressing RESET will attempt reconnection with these devices.
DNET-124.remedy: Pressing RESET will attempt reconnection with the non-communicating devices and clear this message.

DNET-125.cause: The slave connection of the specified board is idle The remote Master has not yet connected to the slave connection.
DNET-125.remedy: Make sure the remote Master is online and configured properly.

DNET-130.cause: An invalid parameter has been specified for a DeviceNet KAREL built-in.
DNET-130.remedy: Refer to the cause code to determine which parameter is invalid.

DNET-131.cause: The specified board number is invalid.
DNET-131.remedy: Make sure the board number is an integer between 1 and 4, inclusive.

DNET-132.cause: The specified MAC ID is invalid.
DNET-132.remedy: Make sure the MAC ID is an integer between 0 and 63, inclusive.

DNET-133.cause: This indicates that there is a user device definition on the system that matches the one supplied using text-based definitions except for the I/O size. A match is indicated by name, vendor id, device type, product code and mode of operation.
DNET-133.remedy: This error is for display only. No action is required.

DNET-134.cause: The text-based device definition has matched with an existing user definition on the robot except for the mode of operation. A match is indicated by name, vendor id, device type and product code.
DNET-134.remedy: This error is for display only. No action is required.

DNET-135.cause: There is a user defintion on the system that matches one of the entries in the text-based user definition except the size of analog input/outputs. A match is indicated by name, vendor id, product code, device type and mode of operation.
DNET-135.remedy: This is for display only. No action is required.

DNET-137.message: Name and Analog do not match
DNET-137.cause: The text-based device definition matches one that exists on the controller, except for the name and number of analog points. Any entry that has the same vendor id, product code, device type and mode of operation is considered a perfect match.
DNET-137.remedy: This error is for display only. No action is required.

DNET-138.cause: A DevicNet channel has been configured for safety. A safety DeviceNet channel requires DN4 hardware. The detected hardware is not supported for a safety channel.
DNET-138.remedy: Use DN4 DeviceNet hardware or disable safety on this channel.

DPMO-001.cause: Motion line mismatches offset motion line
DPMO-001.remedy: Check offset provider correct the application setting

DPMO-002.remedy: increase the motion segment length or slow the speed

DPMO-003.cause: Offset has be applied during interpolating stage

DPMO-004.cause: Offset arrives beyond allowed window time
DPMO-004.remedy: Reset the window time or Check the application

DPMO-005.cause: Motion segment length is too short

DPMO-010.remedy: Perform a cold start of controller

DPMO-011.remedy: Perform a cold start of controller

DPMO-012.remedy: Perform a cold start of controller

DPMO-018.remedy: calibrate analog input set $cal_done to TRUE

DPMO-023.cause: Schedule number is out of range
DPMO-023.remedy: Check the setup and re-power the controller

DPMO-025.cause: Orientation control does not support TPATH and PATH relative

DPMO-027.remedy: Check DPM type of CFG and SCHED

DPMO-031.message: CD - non CD transition in tracking

DPMO-032.cause: Offset greater than max path offset
DPMO-032.remedy: Check max path offset setting Check offset

DTBR-001.cause: Specified host name is null string.
DTBR-001.remedy: Please check the 1st argument. If SR is used, please check the value.

DTBR-002.cause: Communication with specified host took time and timeout happend.
