DTBR-002.remedy: Please make sure newtwork is working properly. If there is heavy trafic, please reduce it.

DTBR-003.cause: Ethernet connection to specified host failed
DTBR-003.remedy: Please make sure newtwork is working properly. PING should always work for specified remote host

DTBR-014.cause: Specified register or position register does not exist on remote host.
DTBR-014.remedy: Please check parameter. Please check valid range of index for specified host.

DTBR-015.cause: Specified group does not exist on remote host.
DTBR-015.remedy: Please check parameter. Please check valid range of group number for specified host.

DX-001.cause: The Delta Tool/Frame global variables have NOT been properly loaded.
DX-001.remedy: Check the application installation manual for the proper installation procedure for Delta Tool/Frame.

DX-002.cause: Delta Tool/Frame internal memory allocation failed.
DX-002.remedy: Check Memory usage and Delta Tool/Frame installation.

DX-003.cause: Delta Tool/Frame system variables (e.g. $DXSCH[]) not found.
DX-003.remedy: Check the application installation manual for the proper installation procedure for the Delta Tool/Frame system.

DX-004.remedy: Check all schedule numbers used within the specified program to verify that they are within the allowable range specified for the $DXSCH[] system variable.

DX-005.cause: Requested Delta Tool/Frame schedule number has already been enabled.
DX-005.remedy: Use END_OFFSET or abort program to disable schedule.

DX-006.cause: Try to disable a schedule which has not been enabled.
DX-006.remedy: Check to see if the requested schedule has been disabled before, or whether the requested schedule has not been enabled at all.

DX-007.cause: Try to apply offset to a schedule which has not been enabled.
DX-007.remedy: Check to see if the requested schedule has been disabled before, or whether the requested schedule has not been enabled at all.

DX-008.cause: Internal error: cannot find dxfndofs schedule.

DX-009.cause: Wrong packet was sent to INTP to signal completion of updating $DXMOR deltatool or deltaframe offset.

DX-010.cause: Attempt to enable deltajoint with deltatool and/or deltaframe in a schedule.
DX-010.remedy: Do not enable deltajoint with deltatool and/or deltaframe in a schedule.

DX-011.cause: Attempt to enable deltatool with deltaframe in a schedule.
DX-011.remedy: Do not enable deltatool with deltaframe in a schedule.

DX-012.cause: The specified motion group has been already enabled by DX function.
DX-012.remedy: Abort the enabled DX function before this start.

DX-013.cause: Invalid motion group tracking for robot link function.

DX-014.cause: The calculated offset orientation of this time is out of range specified by $DXRLINK.$ortmax.
DX-014.remedy: Decrease the speed of the Master robot or Check the noize on the Ethernet.

DX-015.cause: The calculated offset distance of this time is out of range specified by $DXRLINK.$locmax.
DX-015.remedy: Decrease the speed of the Master robot or Check the noize on the Ethernet.

DX-016.cause: UT of master robot is changed.
DX-016.remedy: Don't change UT of master during robot link.

ELOG-009.remedy: Perform a cold start: 1. Turn off the robot. 2. On the teach pendant, press and hold the SHIFT and RESET keys. 3. While still pressing the SHIFT and RESET keys, turn on the robot. If the error is not cleared, document the events that let to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

ELOG-011.message: Power off, if you want to recover.
ELOG-011.remedy: Perform a Cold start: 1. Turn off the robot. 2. On the teach pendant, press and hold the SHIFT and RESET keys. 3. While still pressing the SHIFT and RESET keys, turn on the robot. If the error is not cleared, document the events that let to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

ELOG-012.message: A system error has been occurred.
ELOG-012.remedy: Perform a cold start: 1. Turn off the robot. 2. On the teach pendant, press and hold the SHIFT and RESET keys. 3. While still pressing the SHIFT and RESET keys, turn on the robot. If the error is not cleared, document the events that let to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

EVIO-001.cause: A parameter passed into the program was the wrong data type
EVIO-001.remedy: Verify the parameters passed into the program

EVIO-003.cause: An invalid argument was passed into the program.
EVIO-003.remedy: Verify all arguments passed into this program.

EVIO-004.cause: The status was not returned by the vision system.
EVIO-004.remedy: Verify the command sent was correct, and the vision system is sending correct data to the robot.

EVIO-005.cause: The values returned by the vision system did not match what the program was expecting.
EVIO-005.remedy: Verify the data from the vision system is correct, and it matches the format in the external vision interface manual.

EVIO-006.cause: The program failed to set the position register with the data returned from the vision system.
EVIO-006.remedy: Verify the position register passed into this program is a valid position register.

EVIO-007.cause: The program failed to set the numeric register.
EVIO-007.remedy: Verify the register passed into this program is a valid numeric register.

EVIO-008.cause: Typically this is caused by the socket messaging communication failing to open the connection.
EVIO-008.remedy: Verify the socket messaging tag is configured properly as per the manual. Verify multiple instances of the program were not attempted to run concurrently.

EVIO-009.cause: The vision system did not return any data.
EVIO-009.remedy: Verify the command sent to the vision system is the correct syntax, and the vision system properly handles this command.

EVIO-010.cause: The program could not read a return string from the vision system.
EVIO-010.remedy: Verify communication is correct, and verify the vision system can handle this type of command.

EVIO-011.cause: The tag ID was not in the range of 1-8.
EVIO-011.remedy: Verify the first argument to this program is 1-8

EVIO-012.cause: The program failed to connect to the vision system.
EVIO-012.remedy: Verify network communication, verify socket messaging is correctly configured.

EVIO-013.message: %s not ready, no status string returned
EVIO-013.remedy: Try again once the vision system is not busy.

EVIO-014.cause: The command returned a non-zero value
EVIO-014.remedy: See the manual for the vision system to determine how to remedy the error indicated in the status register.

EVIO-015.cause: Typically this is caused by the socket messaging communication failing to open the connection.
EVIO-015.remedy: Verify the socket messaging tag is configured properly as per the manual. Verify multiple instances of the program were not attempted to run concurrently.

EVIO-016.remedy: This may be desired behavior. If it is not, then modify the argument passed into this program.

EVIO-017.cause: The external vision system failed to set the project name.
EVIO-017.remedy: See the vision system manual and the status value to determine the root cause and remedy.

EVIO-018.cause: The command argument was blank for MVS_SEND_CMD.
EVIO-018.remedy: Enter a command for the string argument to send.

EVIO-019.cause: An invalid command was sent to the machine vision system.
EVIO-019.remedy: Verify the parameters of the command.

EVIO-020.cause: More than 2 vision data buffers are in use concurrently
EVIO-020.remedy: Do not run more than 2 external vision processes at the same time

EVIO-021.message: Failed to send command to MVS
EVIO-021.cause: Sending the message to the vision system failed.
EVIO-021.remedy: Verify arguments passed into this program.

EVIO-022.cause: Failed to read the string register passed into this program.
EVIO-022.remedy: Verify the string register argument is a valid string register. The argument is an integer value, not the SR[] itself

EVIO-023.cause: Could not connect to the machine vision system.
EVIO-023.remedy: Verify the socket messsaging setup is correct. Verify the IP addresses are correct and tag is configured correctly.

EVIO-024.message: Error received unknown command in STATUS
EVIO-024.cause: The vision system did not recognize the command sent.
EVIO-024.remedy: Verify the command sent is valid syntax for the system.

EVIO-025.message: Cannot receive message from the MVS in %s
EVIO-025.cause: The machine vision system did not send a return string.
EVIO-025.remedy: This may be caused by the vision system refusing commands, possibly because it is busy processing another command. Check the status register value for more information.

EVIO-026.message: Number found is invalid in GET_LOCATE
EVIO-026.cause: The number of found results is not what was expected.
EVIO-026.remedy: Verify the vision process is accurate, and the number expected is what the vision system is seeing.

EVIO-027.message: Number of measurements is invalid in GET_LOCATE
EVIO-027.cause: The number of measurements for the vision process is invalid.
EVIO-027.remedy: Verify the number of measurements the vision process is expected to return, and the vision process is set up correctly.

EVIO-028.message: Model ID is invalid in GET_LOCATE
EVIO-028.cause: The model ID is not valid.
EVIO-028.remedy: Verify the model ID from the vision process, and the correct model ID argument is passed into GET_LOCATE.

EVIO-029.message: Position results is invalid in GET_LOCATE
EVIO-029.cause: The position data returned from the vision system is invalid.
EVIO-029.remedy: Verify the data output by the vision system matches the format expected, as per the external vision interface option manual.

EVIO-030.message: Measurement data is invalid in GET_LOCATE
EVIO-030.cause: The measurement data is not valid.
EVIO-030.remedy: Verify the data output by the vision system matches the format expected, as per the external vision interface option manual.

EVIO-031.message: Second string packet is invalid in GET_LOCATE
EVIO-031.cause: The second set of 254 characters from the vision system was invalid.
EVIO-031.remedy: Retry the process. If error persists, verify the command string is correct.

EVIO-032.cause: There were more than 100 vision results.
EVIO-032.remedy: Reduce the number of results to less than 100 Only up to 100 results at a time are supported.

EVIO-033.cause: This result index does not exist in the results.
EVIO-033.remedy: Verify the result values and the result index requested

FILE-001.cause: Specified file device is not ready.
FILE-001.remedy: Check if the device is mounted and ready to use. Check if the device name is correct.

FILE-002.cause: Device is full. There is no more space to store data on the device.
FILE-002.remedy: Delete any unnecessary files or change to a new device.

FILE-003.cause: Device is protected. So, you cannot write to the device.

FILE-004.cause: The device is not assigned. The specified device is not recognized by the system. If using RD, then $FILE_MAXSEC is set to 0.
FILE-004.remedy: If using RD, set $FILE_MAXSEC > 0, or else a system error will occur.

FILE-005.cause: Device is not mounted. You should mount the device before using it.

FILE-006.cause: You tried to mount the device which had been already mounted.

FILE-007.remedy: This is an internal error. Check the validity of the device number.

FILE-008.cause: Device name contains an illegal character.
FILE-008.remedy: Check spelling and validity of device name.

FILE-009.remedy: This is an internal error. Check the validity of the logical unit number.

FILE-011.cause: Directory is full. You tried to create a file in the root directory which execeeded the maximum number of files allowed on the device.
FILE-011.remedy: Delete unnecessary files in the root directory.

FILE-012.cause: You tried to write to a write protected directory.
FILE-012.remedy: Release the protection to the directory.

FILE-013.cause: Directory name contains an illegal character.

FILE-014.cause: The specified file was not found.
FILE-014.remedy: Check that the file exists and that the file name was spelled correctly.

FILE-015.cause: You tried to access a protected file.

FILE-017.cause: You tried to access a file which is not open.

FILE-018.cause: You tried to create/delete/rename a file which is already opened.

FILE-019.cause: You tried to access a file which is locked.

FILE-020.remedy: Change file size to be correct.

FILE-021.remedy: This is a notification. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.

FILE-022.cause: File name contains an illegal character.

FILE-023.remedy: Use a valid file number which is the ID returned from an open request.

FILE-024.cause: File type contains an illegal character.
FILE-024.remedy: Check the spelling and validity of the file type.

FILE-025.remedy: Check if the protection code is correct.

FILE-026.remedy: Check if the access mode is correct.

FILE-027.cause: File attribute in the SET_ATTRIBUTE request is illegal.
FILE-027.remedy: Check that attribute specified is valid.

FILE-028.cause: Data block is broken which is used in FIND_NEXT request.
FILE-028.remedy: You should keep the data block which is returned from the previous FIND_FIRST or FIND_NEXT request.

FILE-029.remedy: Check if the request code is corect.

FILE-031.cause: Path name contains an illegal character.
FILE-031.remedy: Check if the path name is correct.

FILE-032.remedy: Check that all parameters for the request are valid.

FILE-034.remedy: Check that the file position parameter from SEEK request is positive and not beyond the end of file.

FILE-035.cause: You tried to access a unformatted device.
FILE-035.remedy: Format the device before using it.

FILE-036.cause: You tried to rename a file to an already existing file name.
FILE-036.remedy: Change the new file name to be unique or delete the existing file.

FILE-037.cause: You tried to remove a subdirectory which contains some files or directories.
FILE-037.remedy: Remove all files and directories in the subdirectory before removing subdirectory.

FILE-038.message: File locked by too many tasks
FILE-038.cause: There are too many lock requests to same file.
FILE-038.remedy: Unlock any unnecessary file lock requests.

FILE-039.cause: You tried to create a sub-directory that already exists.
FILE-039.remedy: Use a unique name for new sub-directory

FILE-040.cause: You tried to read from a write only opened file or tried to write to a read only opened file.
FILE-040.remedy: Open a file with correct access mode.

FILE-041.cause: You tried to unlock file which you had not locked.
FILE-041.remedy: Don't unlock a file that is not locked. You can only unlock files which YOU have locked.

FILE-045.cause: $FILE_MAXSEC has not been set and must be be set before device can be formatted.
FILE-045.remedy: Set variable $FILE_MAXSEC to valid value. 800 is a good default value.

FILE-049.cause: A file operation has been attempted on a file which is not a standard file
FILE-049.remedy: Use a standard file device (e.g., FR: or RD:

FILE-050.message: PChamp %s device NOT ready - device FULL
FILE-050.cause: PChamp output device NOT ready or FULL
FILE-050.remedy: Check device OR delete old files on device

FILE-051.cause: A call to kread was made while a WOULDBLOCK read was pending
FILE-051.remedy: Do not call kread again until the packet from the previous read has been rcvd

FILE-052.cause: A call to kread was made following a WOULDBLOCK read with a different buf_p
FILE-052.remedy: Call kread with the same buf_p as was used in the original kread call

FILE-053.cause: Memory Card (MC) has been inserted and properly detected by the system
FILE-053.remedy: Start MC access after receiving this message

FILE-054.cause: Memory Card (MC) has been removed from the system
FILE-054.remedy: Reinstall Memory Card if you wish to continue

FILE-055.cause: Either the Memory Card (MC) is not properly inserted or the Card that is inserted is not a Memory Card type (SRAM or Flashdisk)
FILE-055.remedy: Either insert a MC or exchange inserted card with a MC

FILE-056.cause: Modem Card has been inserted and properly detected by the system
FILE-056.remedy: Start Modem Card access after receiving this message

FILE-057.cause: Modem Card has been removed from the system
FILE-057.remedy: Reinstall Modem Card if you wish to continue

FILE-058.remedy: Remove any non alpha numeric character which is not an underscore.

FILE-059.message: Not enough TEMP memory for file operation
FILE-059.cause: The TEMP memory is too low to complete the file operation.
FILE-059.remedy: Try one of the following: 1. Remove unnecessary files/programs from the system. 2. Remove unused options from the controller by reloading with fewer options. 3. Add more D-RAM to the system.

FILE-060.cause: Requested RD Size (Req) exceeds Max Available (Max). RD Left at Actual Size (Ac)
FILE-060.remedy: Adjust $FILE_MAXSEC Memory Size (Req) to less than or equal to the Max Available (Max)

FILE-061.cause: The requested RD Size (Req)exceeds the Max Available (Max). RD Left at Actual Size (Ac).
FILE-061.remedy: Adjust $FILE_MAXSEC Memory Size (Req) to less than or equal to the Max Available (Max).

FILE-062.cause: The backup file is not correct.
FILE-062.remedy: Try performing the file backup operation to another device, or use another media type.

FILE-063.cause: The indicated file is not loaded when all files are restored in Automatic Software Update function.
FILE-063.remedy: Check cause code for more information.

FILE-064.cause: An unusual File System error has occurred. This alarm should rarely occur. The number after the error text indicates: 50 – Device was removed and replaced before flush 51 – Driver reports that the device is not working 52 – Trying to access a drive that wasn't initialized 53 – Driver reports that the device is empty 54 – Driver reports that the device is not recognized 60 – No signature found in BPB (need to format) 61 – No signature found in MBR 62 – Partition requested but none at that offset 63 – IO error reading MBR (note: MBR is first to be read on a new insert) 64 – IO error reading BPB (block 0) 65 – IO error reading FAT32 INFO struc (BPB extension) 70 – Error reading a directory block through the buffer pool 71 – Error reading a fat block through the fat buffer pool 72 – Error writing a directory block through the buffer pool 73 – Error writing a fat block through the fat buffer pool 74 – Error writing info block during fat flush
FILE-064.remedy: Retry the operation. If the alarm consistently occurs then manually check that the files were read, written, etc. Using a personal computer check the media with a Check Disk or Error-checking tool. If reporting the alarm to FANUC America Corporation, be sure to include the number that is provided.

FILE-065.cause: An unexpected internal File System error has occurred. This alarm should occur very rarely. The number after the error text indicates: 100 – Unexpected block number encountered, use a check disk 101 – Unexpected cluster encountered, use a check disk 102 – A specified path that must be a directory was not. 103 – Unexpected condition, use a check disk 110 – Out of directory object structures 111 – Out of directory and scratch blocks
FILE-065.remedy: Retry the operation. If the alarm consistently occurs then manually check that the files were read, written, etc. Using a personal computer check the media with a Check Disk or Error-checking tool. If reporting the alarm to FANUC America Corporation, be sure to include the number that is provided.

FILE-066.cause: The USB memory stick has been inserted and properly detected by the system.
FILE-066.remedy: Start UDx: access after receiving this message.

FILE-067.cause: The USB memory stick has been removed from the system.
FILE-067.remedy: Reinstall the memory stick if you want to continue.

FILE-068.cause: Either the USB memory stick is not properly inserted, or the stick that is inserted is not a the correct type.
FILE-068.remedy: Try removing and reinserting the memory stick, or use a different memory stick.

FILE-069.cause: A USB hub was inserted and detected as identified in the string parameters. This is informational only to identify the insertion of a hub device.

FILE-070.cause: A USB hub was removed. This is informational only.

FILE-071.cause: USB device details. This will appear as a cause code to the FILE-066 alarm to identify the device inserted.

FILE-072.cause: The attached USB devices are drawing more than 500mA of current.
FILE-072.remedy: Reduce the power draw by removing some devices, or use an external power supply.

FILE-073.cause: An unusual USB File System error has occurred. This alarm should rarely occur
FILE-073.remedy: Report the error number to the FANUC America Corporation Help Hotline.

FILE-074.cause: The USB device is not supported on this hardware.
FILE-074.remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

FILE-075.cause: The appropriate media is not inserted or properly inserted, or the media that is inserted is not of the correct type.
FILE-075.remedy: Insert the appropriate media, such as a USB memory stick or a memory card. Try removing and reinserting the media, or use a different one.

FILE-076.cause: The device has an invalid sector size and can not be used by the file system.

FILE-080.cause: Auto backup in progress Auto backup

FILE-081.cause: The named file failed to be read and loaded correctly.
FILE-081.remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

FILE-082.cause: This occurs with the alarm: Backup file is not correct. This alarm indicates the file or one of the files that was not found.
FILE-082.remedy: Find this file in an older backup or maybe on another controller and load it.

FILE-083.cause: This occurs with the alarm: Backup file is not correct. This alarm indicates the file or one of the files that was found to be empty or have a zero length.
FILE-083.remedy: Find this file in an older backup or maybe on another controller and load it.

FILE-084.cause: The device has some problem or is worn out.
FILE-084.remedy: Retry the operation. If the alarm consistently occurs then try a different device. Using a personal computer check the device with a Check Disk or Error-checking tool.

FILE-085.cause: CHKDSK has determined that the file device has an error.
FILE-085.remedy: Contact FANUC America Corporation or FANUC Ltd. software support.

FILE-089.cause: USB device key board is installed and detected.
FILE-089.remedy: It is possible to use USB device key board.

FILE-090.cause: USB device key board is removed.
FILE-090.remedy: Connect the USB device key board again if you want to continue.

FILE-091.cause: USB device mouse is installed and detected.
FILE-091.remedy: It is possible to use USB device mouse.

FILE-092.remedy: Connect the USB device mouse again if you want to continue.

FILE-093.cause: A parity error was detected in the USB controllers ram.
FILE-093.remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC or FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

FILE-094.cause: An error occurred with DMA transfer from or to the USB controllers RAM. It was then done without DMA.
FILE-094.remedy: Document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC or FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

FILE-102.cause: Described value is over the limit.
FILE-102.remedy: Fix the value not to be over the limit.

FILE-104.cause: The file is over the max size allowed.
FILE-104.remedy: Reduce file size by splitting up into multiple files.

FILE-105.cause: Requested Memory Size ($FILE_MAXSEC) exceeds Max Available. TD Left at Actual Size.
FILE-105.remedy: Adjust Requested Memory Size ($FILE_TD_SEC) to less than or equal to the Max Available.

FILE-106.cause: Requested TD Size (Req) exceeds Max Available (Max). TD Left at Actual Size (Ac).
FILE-106.remedy: Adjust $FILE_TD_SEC Memory Size (Req) to less than or equal to the Max Available (Max)

FILE-108.cause: Frequent auto back to FRA: can reduce FROM life.
FILE-108.remedy: Reduce the frequency of auto backup to FRA: within 5 times in a day or change device to MC: or USB:.

FLPY-001.cause: Your listing has reached the end of the directory. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.
FLPY-001.remedy: This is a notification. You do not have to do anything for this warning message.

FLPY-002.cause: The file name you are trying to create already exists on this device.
FLPY-002.remedy: Delete the file of this name or choose a different file name.

FLPY-003.cause: The file you are trying to open does not exist on this device.
FLPY-003.remedy: Open a file that does exist on the device.

FLPY-004.cause: Operation is not supported on floppy disk.
FLPY-004.remedy: Use only operations supported on floppy disk.

FLPY-005.cause: The disk file capacity has been reached.
FLPY-005.remedy: Delete some unneeded files or use a disk with sufficient free space.

FLPY-006.cause: The end of the file was reached while reading.
FLPY-006.remedy: Do not attempt to read beyond the end of a file.

FLPY-008.message: Only one file may be opened
FLPY-008.cause: An attempt was made to open more than one file.
FLPY-008.remedy: Do not attempt to open more than one file at a time.

FLPY-015.cause: The disk has write protection enabled.
FLPY-015.remedy: Remove write protection from the disk or use a disk that is not write protected.

FLPY-100.cause: The directory information is corrupted and unreadable.
FLPY-100.remedy: Try another disk or reformat the disk.

FLPY-101.cause: The checksum data is bad. Data is corrupted on disk and can not be read.
FLPY-101.remedy: Try another disk, or reformat the disk

FLPY-103.cause: There is a bad sector or track on the disk.
FLPY-103.remedy: Clean the disk drive, try another disk, or reformat the disk.

FLPY-104.cause: The drive did not respond to a command.
FLPY-104.remedy: Check the cable to the drive and make sure drive power is on.

FLPY-105.cause: The disk has write protection enabled.
FLPY-105.remedy: Remove write protection from the disk or use a disk that is not write protected.

FLPY-106.cause: Memory Card hardware error is detected.
FLPY-106.remedy: Check Memory Card I/F unit connection or battery of the card.

FLPY-107.cause: The Memory Card is not formatted.
FLPY-107.remedy: Format the card with UTILITY menu on FILE screen.

FORC-001.cause: The controller's main board does not have a force sensor interface.
FORC-001.remedy: 1. Turn the controller OFF. 2. Mount the main board that force sensor is supported.

FORC-002.remedy: 1. Turn the controller OFF. 2. Mount the force control board.

FORC-004.cause: The system cannot cammunicate with the force control board.
FORC-004.remedy: Please check the force control board.

FORC-005.cause: Force control function is disabled because robot hasn't been mastered.
FORC-005.remedy: Perform mastering from the calibration screen.

FORC-006.cause: Force board has been disabled because of the alarm displayed at the same time.
FORC-006.remedy: Refer to the remedy of the alarm displayed at the same time.

FORC-007.cause: There was an error at memory initialization internally. Maybe, memory is lack, or, the memory module is broken.
FORC-007.remedy: Contact FANUC or FANUC Robotics and report the error status.

FORC-011.cause: The program cannot control the specified motion group.
FORC-011.remedy: Please check the default motion groups in the program.

FORC-012.cause: The system cannot start force control.
FORC-012.remedy: Please check the force control board.

FORC-013.cause: The system cannot communicate with the force control board.
FORC-013.remedy: Please check the force control board.

FORC-014.cause: The tool number is set to 0.
FORC-014.remedy: Please set the correct tool number.

FORC-015.cause: As a result of the force sensor diagnosis the error of the force sensor exceeded the tolerance.

FORC-017.cause: 3-axis Force sensor data has been set

FORC-018.cause: Initial force sensor data is uninitialized
FORC-018.remedy: Please initialize the force sensor data.

FORC-019.remedy: Please set up the system variable $CCS_GRP.$INIT_TOL.

FORC-021.cause: The force sensor which is specified by sensor index does not exist.

FORC-022.cause: A FORCE CTRL was executed before an OFFSET CONDITION instruction or a VOFFSET CONDITION instruction. A position register was not taught in the OFFSET CONDITION instruction. A Vision register was not taught in the VOFFSET CONDITION instruction.
FORC-022.remedy: Add an OFFSET CONDITION or VOFFSET CONDITION instruction before the FORCE CTRL. Teach the position register or execute vision.

FORC-023.remedy: Please check the state of the force sensor.

FORC-024.cause: The error occurred from the force control board. The error jump is not done, because label number is 0.
FORC-024.remedy: Refer to the remedy of the force control alarm which occurred before this alarm.

FORC-025.cause: Cannot execute instruction because Unused is selected.

FORC-026.cause: Initial force sensor data has been set now

FORC-027.cause: Another tuning mode is already enabled

FORC-028.remedy: Contact FANUC or FANUC Robotics and report the error status.

FORC-029.remedy: Check the following. 1.J518 is ordered. 2.Selected Axis is connected. 3.Selected Axis is Auxiliary Axis. 4.Selected Axis is Rotary Axis.

FORC-030.remedy: Prepare the memory device such as USB or memory card or disable force data log function

FORC-036.cause: Vision Register's type is not Fixed Frame Offset.
FORC-036.remedy: Set Vision Register's type Fixed Frame Offset.

FORC-037.message: Fixed sensor option is not ordered
FORC-037.cause: Fixed sensor option is not ordered

FORC-038.cause: Sensor frame for fixed sensor is not set

FORC-039.cause: Sensor frame has not been updated
FORC-039.remedy: Please reboot controller in order to update sensor frame

FORC-040.message: Can't exec. F/C with hand sensor
FORC-040.cause: There is No force sensor for this robot to be attached
FORC-040.remedy: Change attachment type of force sensor to FIXED

FORC-041.cause: This robot with force sensor doesn't support this controller
FORC-041.remedy: Contact FANUC Robotics to report the error.

FORC-050.remedy: Do not execute SENSOR CONNECT while the robot is moving.

FORC-051.remedy: Do not execute SENSOR DISCONNECT while the robot is moving.

FORC-052.cause: Tried to execute Force control while force sensor is disconnected.

FORC-053.remedy: Contact FANUC Robotics to report the error.

FORC-101.cause: Selected default data is not correct
FORC-101.remedy: Please confirm the default data of system variables

FORC-102.cause: The default data still has not been selected
FORC-102.remedy: Please select the default data at the default menu

FORC-104.cause: Number of array in selected default data is not correct
FORC-104.remedy: Please confirm the number of array in the default data ($CCBD_ARRAY[x,y].$BDDN or $CCID_ARRAY[x,y].$IDDN)

FORC-105.cause: The force group of program has not been existed in this system
FORC-105.remedy: Please create this statement in this system again

FORC-106.message: Mass data is out of range
FORC-106.cause: The mass data which has been calculated by entering data is out of range

FORC-107.message: Damper data is out of range
FORC-107.cause: The damper data which has been calculated by entering data is out of range

FORC-108.message: Input data is out of minimum
FORC-108.cause: The input data is out of minimum range

FORC-109.message: Input data is out of maximum
FORC-109.cause: The input data is out of maximum range

FORC-110.cause: Selected memory card on a controller where memory card is not available
FORC-110.remedy: Select devices other than memory card

FORC-114.cause: Because the ending condition switch is changed, the individual difference exceeds limit.

FORC-115.cause: Modified bearing rotation axis or groove direction is set to be the same as insert direction. This is impossible in the present case.
FORC-115.remedy: Verify the insert direction in 'Basic Data'.

FORC-116.cause: Force Control and Soft Float Combination is prohibited.
FORC-116.remedy: Do not execute Force Control and Soft Float simultaneously.

FORC-117.cause: Cannot set phase match impedance rate because auto impedance tuning is not finished.
FORC-117.remedy: Do auto tuning and set phase match impedance rate again

FORC-118.cause: Modified insert direction is the same as groove direction. For this case, it cannot be realistically.

FORC-119.cause: Parent schedule's parent is child: Infinit loop
FORC-119.remedy: Verify parent and child relationship And set right parent number

FORC-120.cause: There are two children for retry
FORC-120.remedy: Parmitted number of child for retry is only one

FORC-121.cause: There are two children for insertion
FORC-121.remedy: Parmitted number of child for insertion is only one

FORC-122.cause: Child for retry can't have child

FORC-123.cause: Parameters of customized schedules were synchronized changed
FORC-123.remedy: If you don't want to synchronized chage, turn off synchronized switch

FORC-124.cause: Parameters of customized schedules were not synchronized changed
FORC-124.remedy: If you want to synchronized chage, turn on synchronized switch

FORC-125.remedy: Contact FANUC or FANUC Robotics and report the error status.

FORC-126.cause: Parameter of customized schedules Auto.Cont.Exec. is inappropriate
FORC-126.remedy: Check Function, Frame, Parent Number, Child Number, Vision Compensation etc.

FORC-127.cause: Parameter of Signal Output for ERR is inappropriate

FORC-128.cause: The switch of F.Ctrl. Gain Auto Modify is OFF.
FORC-128.remedy: Turn on the switch of F.Ctrl. Gain Auto Modify.

FORC-129.message: Direction is same as ins. dir.
FORC-129.cause: Input direction for the search menu is same as the insertion direction.

FORC-130.remedy: Contact FANUC Robotics to report the error.

FORC-131.cause: Auto Gain Tuning was executed when the robot is not prepared.
FORC-131.remedy: Move the robot in any directions and Execute Auto Gain Tuning again.

FORC-151.cause: The version of FPGA is old.
FORC-151.remedy: Contact FANUC Robotics to report the error.

FORC-158.cause: An output error occurred from the sensor head.
FORC-158.remedy: 1. Move the robot to a safe pose. 2. Turn the controller OFF, then ON again. If this alarm occurs again, go to the next step. 3. Replace the sensor head.

FORC-159.cause: An excessive load was put on the sensor head.
FORC-159.remedy: 1. Make sure that the value of 'Insert Force' in 'Basic Data' is not too large. If not, go to the next step. 2. Bad impedance parameters can cause vibration during force control. Increase the Mass value in the impedance parameters.

FORC-161.cause: Calibration data has not been loaded correctly.
FORC-161.remedy: 1. Controlled start the controller. 2. Load the force sensor calibration data, then cold start the controller.

FORC-162.cause: Temperature output error occurred in the sensor head.
FORC-162.remedy: 1. Move the robot to a safe pose. 2. Turn the controller OFF, then ON again. If this alarm occurs again, go to the next step. 3. Replace the sensor head.

FORC-164.cause: The temperature measured at the sensor head is too low.
FORC-164.remedy: 1. Check the temperature around the sensor head. If it is not low, go to the next step. 2. Check the sensor cable connectivity. Check also for cut lines. If there is nothing wrong, go to the next step. 3. Replace the sensor board. If this alarm occurs again, go to the next step. 4. Replace the sensor head.

FORC-165.cause: The temperature measured at the sensor head is too high.
FORC-165.remedy: 1. Check the temperature around the sensor head. If it is not high, go to the next step. 2. Check the sensor cable connectivity. Check also for cut lines. If there is nothing wrong, go to the next step. 3. Replace the sensor board. If this alarm occurs again, go to the next step. 4. Replace the sensor head.

FORC-171.cause: The output data from the sensor head is frozen (unchanging).
FORC-171.remedy: 1. Check the force sensor output data on TP (Force sensor status screen). The value must vary slightly over time due to sensor background noise. If the value is constant, it is frozen; go to the next step. 2. Check the sensor cable connectivity. Check also for cut lines. If there is nothing wrong, go to the next step. 3. Replace the sensor board. If this alarm occurs again, go to the next step. 4. Replace the sensor head.

FORC-174.cause: An excessive load was put on the sensor head.
FORC-174.remedy: 1. Reduce the velocity or acceleration of the robot motion. 2. Reduce the weight or inertia of the load.

FORC-175.cause: The differential value of the force during force control is too large.
FORC-175.remedy: 1. Gradually increase the values of the 'Mass' and 'Damper' impedance parameters. 2. Decerase the value of 'Insert Force' or 'Pushing Force' in Basic Data.

FORC-180.cause: Communication failed between the sensor board and the force sensor.
FORC-180.remedy: 1. Move the robot to a safe pose. 2. Turn the controller OFF, then ON again. If this alarm occurs again, go to the next step. 3. Check the sensor cable connectivity. Check also for cut lines. If there is nothing wrong, go to the next step. 4. Replace the sensor board. If this alarm occurs again, go to the next step. 5. Replace the sensor head.

FORC-181.cause: force sensor type has been changed.
FORC-181.remedy: 1. Move the robot to a safe pose. 2. Turn the controller OFF, then ON again. If this alarm occurs again, go to the next step. 3. Check the sensor cable connectivity. Check also for cut lines. If there is nothing wrong, go to the next step. 4. Replace the sensor board. If this alarm occurs again, go to the next step. 5. Replace the sensor head.

FORC-183.cause: The settings of Mass Measurement are illegal.
FORC-183.remedy: 1. Check if Reg.No.Basis Measure, Reg.No.Mass Measure and Reg.No.Mass Result are different. 2. Check if Reg.No.Basis Measure, Reg.No.Mass Measure and Reg.No.Mass Result are positive integers. 3. Don't execute Basis Measurement and Mass Measurement simultaneously. 4. Don't execute Basis Measurement or Mass Measurement and Force Control simultaneously.

FORC-184.cause: Mass Measurement exceeded Max Data Record Time.
FORC-184.remedy: 1. Check the start timing and end timing of Basis Measurement or Mass Measurement. 2. Increase Max.Data Record Time.

FORC-188.message: Auto Tuning SW is turned off
FORC-188.cause: Auto Impedance Tuning switch is tuned off.
FORC-188.remedy: This is not error.If you desire to execute tuning again, turn on Auto Impedance Tuning switch.

FORC-199.cause: The axis has approached a singularity point during force control.
FORC-199.remedy: There are two possible robot poses which cause this alarm: 1. The angle of J5 is 0 degrees. 2. The sum of the angles of J3 and J5 is 90 degrees. Be sure to avoid approaching these states during force control.

FORC-201.cause: The robot has approached a singularity due to the positions of J1 and J6 during force control.
FORC-201.remedy: Force control must not be executed while J6 is directly above J1 (the robot base).

FORC-203.cause: Robot has approached its envelope limit.
FORC-203.remedy: Force control must not be executed near envelope limit.

FORC-211.remedy: Refer to the remedy of the alarm displayed at the same time.

FORC-216.cause: the Force in X direction is too big.

FORC-217.cause: the Force in Y direction is too big.

FORC-218.cause: the Force in Z direction is too big.

FORC-219.cause: the Moment about X direction is too big.

FORC-220.cause: the Moment about Y direction is too big.

FORC-221.cause: the Moment about Z direction is too big.

FORC-223.remedy: Contact the FANUC service center and report the error status.

FORC-224.remedy: 1. Change the position and orientation of the robot. If this alarm occurs again, go to the next step. 2. Replace the force control board.

FORC-260.message: Force at the end is not ok (F:%d^1)

FORC-260.remedy: Change parameters or position and retry

FORC-261.message: Torque at the end is not ok (F:%d^1)
FORC-261.cause: Torque at the end is larger than 'Torque Upper Limit'
FORC-261.remedy: Change parameters or position and retry

FORC-262.message: End Force and Torque is not ok (F:%d^1)

FORC-262.remedy: Change parameters or position and retry

FORC-263.cause: The robot did not contact the work surface during a required time period.
FORC-263.remedy: 1. Check the distance betweent the approach position and contact position - 5 mm or less is appropriate. 2. Make the value of 'Approach Velocity' in Basic Data larger.

FORC-264.cause: Insertion did not complete during the required time.
FORC-264.remedy: 1. The orientation of the robot might have changed too much during the force control. If so, correct the approach position. 2. The clearance between the object and work area might be too small. 3. The 'Insert Velocity' in Basic Data might be too small. 4. The 'Insert time MAX Limit' in Basic Data might be too short.

FORC-265.cause: The orientation change during the insertion exceeded the limit value.
FORC-265.remedy: 1. Check that the orientation of the insertion task is correct. 2. Check that 'Change MAX Limit' in Basic Data is not too small.

FORC-266.cause: Insert depth is out of range.
FORC-266.remedy: Insert depth is out of range that is configured with the Force Control Basic Data Screen.

FORC-267.cause: Insertion did not complete during the required time.(Threading)
FORC-267.remedy: 1. The orientation of the robot might have changed too much during the force control. If so, correct the approach position. 2. The clearance between the object and work area might be too small. 3. The 'Insert Velocity' in Basic Data might be too small. 4. The 'Insert time MAX Limit' in Basic Data might be too short.

FORC-269.cause: The insertion direction acquired by the end condition acquisition is wrong.
FORC-269.remedy: Execute the end condition acquisition again.

FORC-270.cause: The insertion length acquired by the end condition acquisition is wrong.
FORC-270.remedy: Execute the end condition acquisition again.

FORC-271.cause: The sign of the force command during torque error acquisition is different from the one during force control.
FORC-271.remedy: Reverse the sign of 'Insert Force' in Basic Data, or execute the torque error acquisition again.

FORC-272.remedy: Check the setting of Simple Customize Function

FORC-273.cause: Setting of frames, insertion dir. for Retry are wrong.
FORC-273.remedy: User Frame and Tool Frame of previous force schedule has to be same and insertion direction has to be opposite of those of schedule of which Retry is valid.

FORC-276.cause: Numerical Register number used for Force control End by register is wrong.
FORC-276.remedy: Set appropriate number to End Reg.No. in performance screen.

FORC-277.remedy: Extend the distance between ContactP. and SensorOrg

FORC-278.cause: The object was inserted further than the specified length.
FORC-278.remedy: 1. Check that the distance between the approach point and the Insertion finishing point is appropriate. 2. Check that the value of 'Insert Depth (Design)' in Basic Data is appropriate. 3. Increase the value of 'Individual Diff.(+)' in Basic Data.

FORC-283.cause: Position error during contouring exceeded the limit value
FORC-283.remedy: Reduce the velocity command or increase the limit value

FORC-285.cause: Auto tuning for contouring is impossible
FORC-285.remedy: Don't make Auto tuning for contouring

FORC-286.remedy: Some parameters cannot be used in combination with UF Fixed. Check Param.Settings.

FORC-295.remedy: Check Cntr.TPP Auto.Gen. parameters and settings

FORC-296.remedy: Abort Contouring before you satrt force control.

FORC-298.remedy: Check max. and min. val. and other val.

FORC-422.cause: Force or Velocity command of the search direction is wrong.

FORC-428.cause: The values of 'Search frequency', 'Search range' or 'Clearance & Chamfer' are wrong.
FORC-428.remedy: Reduce the value of 'Search frequency'. Reduce the value of 'Search range'. Reduce the value of 'Clearance & Chamfer'.

FORC-542.remedy: 1. Increase the value of 'Phase Match Push F' in Basic Data. 2. Make sure that the clearance between the workpiece and the object is not too small.

FORC-546.cause: Not customized force control were continuously executed
FORC-546.remedy: 1. Customize two force control schedule 2. Move robot position before second force control execution

FORC-547.cause: Previous executed force control was not parent force control
FORC-547.remedy: Execute child force control immediately after parent force control

FORC-549.remedy: 1. If you want to retry, set same frame number and reversed insert direction 2. If you want to insert, you can't execute child after errror of parent

FORC-631.remedy: Please confirm following items: 1.Robot is mastered. 2.Force sensor calibration data is loaded. 3.Force sensor cable is connected.
