LECO-901.remedy: Verify the weld was made at the proper travel speed and for the correct amount of time. Verify the time limits for the weld profile.

LNTK-000.remedy: Perform a COLD start of the system. (Cycle power.) Notify FANUC America Corporation if problem persists.

LNTK-001.cause: The Line Track global variables have NOT been properly loaded.
LNTK-001.remedy: Check the application installation manual for the proper installation procedure for the Line Track system.

LNTK-002.cause: The Line Track internal motion data was NOT found.
LNTK-002.remedy: Perform a COLD start of the system. (Cycle power.) Notify FANUC America Corporation if problem persists.

LNTK-003.cause: The Line track internal memory allocation failed.
LNTK-003.remedy: Check Memory usage and Line Track installation.

LNTK-004.cause: The Line Track system variables (eg. $LNSCH[], $LNSNRSCH[]) were not found.
LNTK-004.remedy: Check the application installation manual for the proper installation procedure for the Line Track system.

LNTK-005.cause: An invalid Line Track schedule (track or frame) number was used within a program instruction (eg. TRK[59]) or program header data (eg. FRAME = 59).
LNTK-005.remedy: Check all schedule numbers (TRK[] or FRAME usages) used within the specified program to verify that they are within the allowable range specified for the $LNSCH[] system variable.

LNTK-006.cause: An invalid tracking type was specified within the tracking schedule (i.e. $LNSCH[]) associated with the specified program.
LNTK-006.remedy: Check the value of $LNSCH[i].$TRK_TYPE (where 'i' is the FRAME number specified within the DETAIL screen for the specified program) to make sure that it is one of the valid values listed under the description for this system variable.

LNTK-007.cause: An invalid sensor(encoder) number was used within the specified tracking program instruction or within the program's associated schedule $LNSCH[i].$TRK_ENC_NUM value (where 'i' is the FRAME number used within the DETAIL screen for the specified program).
LNTK-007.remedy: Check the value of the specified program instruction's LINE[] parameter and the program's associated schedule $LNSCH[i].$TRK_ENC_NUM value to make sure that it is one of the valid values listed under the description for the $ENC_STAT[] system variable.

LNTK-008.cause: An invalid or uninitialized nominal tracking frame position was used within the tracking schedule (i.e. $LNSCH[]) associated with the specified program.
LNTK-008.remedy: Check the value of $LNSCH[i].$TRK_FRAME (where 'i' is the FRAME number specified within the DETAIL screen for the specified program) to make sure that it is a properly initialized, valid position.

LNTK-009.cause: The position type or representation used within the specified program is not valid. (LINE and CIRC tracking programs MUST store all positions in Cartesian representation. Joint representation is not allowed.)
LNTK-009.remedy: Check the KAREL or TPE user manual for valid position types. Check the position representation used to store the positions within the tracking program to make sure that Cartesian representation is being used.

LNTK-010.cause: An invalid sensor(encoder) schedule number was used within the specified tracking program instruction's SCH[] parameter.
LNTK-010.remedy: Check the $LNSNRSCH[] system variable description for the range of valid sensor schedule numbers.

LNTK-011.cause: An illegal value was used within the specified tracking program instruction or within the program's associated schedule $LNSCH[i].$SEL_BOUND value (where 'i' is the FRAME number used within the DETAIL screen for the specified program).
LNTK-011.remedy: Check the value of the specified program instruction's BOUND[] parameter and the program's associated schedule $LNSCH[i].$SEL_BOUND value to make sure that they are one of the valid values listed under the description for this system variable.

LNTK-012.cause: An invalid or uninitialized position was used within the specified tracking program instruction.
LNTK-012.remedy: Check the position (or position register) value for the specified tracking program instruction to make sure that it is a properly initialized, valid position.

LNTK-013.cause: An invalid or uninitialized value was used for the specified tracking program instruction's trigger value.
LNTK-013.remedy: Check the value of the program register used by the specified tracking program instruction.

LNTK-014.cause: The tracking sensor(encoder) associated with the specified program (specified by $LNSCH[i].$TRK_ENC_NUM, where 'i' is the FRAME number used within the DETAIL screen for the specified program) must be enabled to perform this program instruction.
LNTK-014.remedy: Use the LINE enable instruction to enable the proper tracking sensor(encoder).

LNTK-015.cause: An invalid or uninitialized sensor(encoder) trigger value (specified by $LNSCH[i].$TRIG_VALUE, where 'i' is the FRAME number used within the DETAIL screen for the specified program) was found.
LNTK-015.remedy: Make sure that this value is properly set prior to either teaching path positions, or issuing programmed robot motion instructions.

LNTK-016.cause: An invalid or uninitialized prediction time was used within the specified tracking program instruction.
LNTK-016.remedy: Check the prediction time being used for proper initialization.

LNTK-017.cause: An invalid internal position input pointer was specified.
LNTK-017.remedy: Perform a COLD start of the system. (Cycle power.) Notify FANUC America Corporation if problem persists.

LNTK-018.cause: An invalid or uninitialized teach distance value (specified by $LNSCH[i].$TEACH_DIST, where 'i' is the FRAME number used within the DETAIL screen for the specified program) was found.
LNTK-018.remedy: Make sure that this value is properly set prior to either teaching path positions, or issuing programmed robot motion instructions.

LNTK-019.cause: An invalid or uninitialized scale factor value (specified by $LNSCH[i].$SCALE, where 'i' is the FRAME number used within the DETAIL screen for the specified program) was found.
LNTK-019.remedy: Make sure that this value is properly set prior to either teaching path positions, or issuing programmed robot motion instructions. NOTE: This value may NOT be equal to 0.0

LNTK-020.cause: An invalid or uninitialized extreme position value (specified by $LNSCH[i].$TCP_EXTRM, where 'i' is the FRAME number used within the DETAIL screen for the specified program) was found.
LNTK-020.remedy: Make sure that this value is properly set prior to either teaching path positions, or issuing programmed robot motion instructions. NOTE: A value of 1,000,000 (1.0e6) may be set to disable TCP extreme position checking.

LNTK-021.cause: An invalid or uninitialized track axis number (specified by $LNSCH[i].$TRK_AXIS_NUM, where 'i' is the FRAME number used within the DETAIL screen for the specified program) was found.
LNTK-021.remedy: Make sure that this value is properly set to one of the valid values listed under the description for this system variable.

LNTK-022.cause: No tracking sensor hardware interface or improperly initialized system variables
LNTK-022.remedy: Check tracking hardware setup and the values of $SCR.$ENC_TYPE and $SCR.$ENC_AXIS

LNTK-023.remedy: Check all sensor hardware, cables, and connections

LNTK-024.remedy: Use a valid encoder average number

LNTK-025.remedy: Use a valid encoder multiplier number

LNTK-026.remedy: Enable the tracking encoder before reading its COUNT or RATE within the program

LNTK-027.cause: Invalid data was found on the tracking stack.
LNTK-027.remedy: Perform a COLD start of the system. (Cycle power.) Notify FANUC America Corporation if problem persists.

LNTK-028.cause: The tracking stack attempted to read more data than was present.
LNTK-028.remedy: Perform a COLD start of the system. (Cycle power.) Notify FANUC America Corporation if problem persists.

LNTK-029.cause: Too many tracking subprocesses are present. There is a limit to the number of tracking processes that can be called from other programs.
LNTK-029.remedy: Check to ensure sub-processes are not being called erroneously. Consider rewriting procedures so that fewer sub-processes are used.

LNTK-030.cause: The schedule number on the tracking stack did not match the schedule of the program it corresponds to.
LNTK-030.remedy: Perform a COLD start of the system. (Cycle power.) Notify FANUC America Corporation if problem persists.

LNTK-031.cause: User frames cannot be used when tracking.

LNTK-032.cause: The conveyor was not resynchronized properly.
LNTK-032.remedy: Make sure the Tracking Schedule is properly initialized, the encoder is active, and all hardware is functioning properly.

LNTK-033.cause: Failed to send a packet including trigger value.
LNTK-033.remedy: Perform a COLD start of the system. (Cycle power.) Notify FANUC America Corporation if problem persists.

LNTK-034.cause: Failed to make a packet including trigger value.
LNTK-034.remedy: Perform a COLD start of the system. (Cycle power.) Notify FANUC America Corporation if problem persists.

LNTK-035.cause: An invalid internal function pointer was encountered.
LNTK-035.remedy: Perform a COLD start of the system. (Cycle power.) Notify FANUC America Corporation if problem persists.

LNTK-036.cause: This group does not support tracking
LNTK-036.remedy: Modify $LNCFG.$GROUP_MSK to enable this group for tracking. Cold start afterwards Notify FANUC America Corporation if problem persists.

LNTK-037.cause: Track Uframe rotation difference between teach and playback exceeds limit.
LNTK-037.remedy: Limit the track Uframe rotation difference within the limit or change the limit ($lnsch[i].$ufrm_rt_lim).

LNTK-038.cause: Use tracking Uframe in CIRCLE Tracking
LNTK-038.remedy: Do NOT use tracking Uframe in CIRCLE tracking.

LNTK-039.message: Use track uframe is not YES
LNTK-039.cause: Use Tracking Uframe in schedule SETUP is set to NO while using Tracking User Frame.
LNTK-039.remedy: Set Use Tracking Uframe to YES if you want to use Tracking Use Frame.

LNTK-040.cause: Line tracking task is not found in line tracking continue track resume.
LNTK-040.remedy: Perform a COLD start of the system. (Cycle power.) Notify FANUC America Corporation if the problem persists.

LNTK-041.message: Encoder is moved in T1 mode.
LNTK-041.cause: If the encoder motion is detected in T1 mode, the robot stops with this alarm to prevent the robot violating the safety speed.
LNTK-041.remedy: Do not move the encoder in T1 mode.

LNTK-042.cause: The robot can not reach the destination before it get out of the specified boundary. So skip this motion to prevent pausing of program execution
LNTK-042.remedy: Program at faster speed or extend the boundary.

LNTK-043.cause: Tracking programs do not support multiple group motion.
LNTK-043.remedy: Change the program to a single group program.

LNTK-044.cause: The Digital output specified in the indicated schedule is not a valid DOUT.
LNTK-044.remedy: Change the variable for Outbound DOUT to represent a valid, correctly mapped digital output.

LNTK-045.cause: The robot is approaching the downstream boundary that is currently in use.
LNTK-045.remedy: This is a warning to indicate that a Track Destination Gone error could be imminent. It can be avoided by stopping the conveyor, changing the boundary or touching up the path to improve cycle time.

LNTK-046.cause: Continuous turn option is loaded without turn on permition key
LNTK-046.remedy: Continuous turn greoup can not be line tracking group. $scr.$update_map1 bit 0x400000 needs to turn on

LNTK-047.cause: Change Fee is needed to avoid limit error. However new fee verification fail. Typically it is because boundary setting cause new fee delay tracking move that robot will go to un-reachalbe position such as dead zone
LNTK-047.remedy: Re-teach the position or adjust tracking boundary

LNTK-048.cause: Try to run a tracking move in a none-tracking environment or try to run a none-tracking move in a tracking environment
LNTK-048.remedy: Abort the program. Then make the move

LNTK-049.message: FEE Change to avoid limit LN:%d
LNTK-049.cause: System change robot last axis moving direction for this motion line to avoid limit error
LNTK-049.remedy: This is a warning to indicate that System change robot last axis moving direction for this motion line to avoid limit error

LNTK-050.cause: Line tracking group also is continuous turn gorup
LNTK-050.remedy: Line tracking group can not support continuous turn in same group

LNTK-051.remedy: Set $lncfg.$slc_pt_trig to true then cycle power

LNTK-052.cause: System run servo conveyer filter to protect robot mechanic
LNTK-052.remedy: This is a warning to indicate that system run servo conveyer filter within time that specified by $lnsch[].$trk_fltr_ln

LNTK-053.cause: Ethernet Encoder is not ready either bacause of Master Encoder DAL or did not get master encoder value for the time out period
LNTK-053.remedy: If it is master DAL alarm, correct master DAL alarm If not getting master encoder value: Check Ethernet Cable for this controller and master. Sometimes it maybe due to timeout value too small.

LNTK-054.cause: Line Tracking does not support Encoder number above 8
LNTK-054.remedy: Change Tracking schedule to use encoder 1-8

LNTK-055.cause: Ethernet Master Encoder has DAL Alarm

LNTK-056.cause: Ethernet Master Encoder did not update slave for a timeout period
LNTK-056.remedy: Ethernet Master Encoder controller maybe offline. Bring master controller on line

LNTK-057.cause: If the encoder motion is detected with Joint space JBF, the robot stops with this alarm to prevent path shift along conveyor direction.
LNTK-057.remedy: Do not move the encoder or use 100% ovrd.

LNTK-058.cause: Indexer setup and tracking schedule scale setup mismatch.
LNTK-058.remedy: If lnsch scale done with actual teaching, the Indexer setup for index distance is not correct. Re-do indexer setup and Indexer program generation

LNTK-059.cause: Ethernet Master Encoder has DTER Alarm

LNTK-060.cause: The Register is a float type. Its value is too big to fit into an integer.
LNTK-060.remedy: Reduce the value or use an Integer Register.

LNTK-061.message: Not a valid trkcd group mask
LNTK-061.cause: This tracking program group mask does not match $cd_param.$mh_rob_gmsk

LNTK-062.cause: Leader robot and follower robot is out of synch
LNTK-062.remedy: Jog follower so that relative to leader is within tolerance

LNTK-063.message: COORD is needed in TRKCD prog
LNTK-063.cause: All the motion line inside a trkcd program needs to be COORD motion option
LNTK-063.remedy: Add Coord motion option to every motion line

LNTK-064.cause: Conveyor moved after Error occured Can not resume TRKCD move

LNTK-065.cause: Transition from TRKCD needs to be a COORD motion
LNTK-065.remedy: Add Coord motion option to TRKCD Transition motion

LNTK-066.cause: Transition of TRKCD program has problem get leader joint angle

LNTK-067.cause: Diagonal linear axis can not supported for Rail Tracking.
LNTK-067.remedy: Change linear axis type to other than diagonal axis

LNTK-068.cause: Rail tracking or Circular tracking doees not supported circular boundary

LNTK-069.cause: circular boundary does not support tcp extreme

LNTK-070.remedy: Current specification does not support conveyor moves upstream. If the conveyor is actually moving down stream, then the line tracking scale needs to be re-taught. If the application needs to support upstream conveyor motion, then disable this checking by turn off bit 0x8000 on $lncfg.$comp_sw2.

LNTK-071.message: Can only record in Left pane
LNTK-071.cause: Can not Record tracking position in right pane
LNTK-071.remedy: Edit and record tracking position in left pane.

LNTK-072.message: Wrong Uframe used in TRKCD prg
LNTK-072.cause: follower uframe number is not set correctly
LNTK-072.remedy: Set follower uframe number as dynamic uframe number specified in Coord setup. menu.

LNTK-073.remedy: Perform a COLD start of the system. (Cycle power.) Notify FANUC Robotics if problem persists.

LNTK-074.remedy: Perform a COLD start of the system. (Cycle power.) Notify FANUC Robotics if problem persists.

LNTK-075.cause: Circular tracking frame z is not parallel to world z. Circular boundary can not be used for this circular tracking
LNTK-075.remedy: circular boundary function is not supported

LRNR-000.remedy: Please make sure gemetric data or user frame is defined correctly.

LRNR-001.cause: TP line has too many motion options

LRNR-003.cause: LRN offset data is too large

LRNR-004.cause: TCP trace mismatch with the current data
LRNR-004.remedy: Stop other TCP trace display such as 4D graphics

LRNR-005.cause: Current orientation cannot be used for 5 axis motion.
LRNR-005.remedy: Teach new program with different spin angle

LRNR-006.cause: Current line has LRN data existed

LRNR-007.cause: Position representation type is not supported
LRNR-007.remedy: Change the position representation type to Cartesian

LRNR-008.cause: Other motion options such INC or WJNT added to the motion line with LRN
LRNR-008.remedy: Remove other motion modifiers such as INC or WJNT

LRNR-009.cause: Not enough momery for data collection
LRNR-009.remedy: Try to use portion of TP program one at a time.

LRNR-010.remedy: Make sure learning data matched current TP program.

LRNR-011.message: TP point not on circle L%d
LRNR-011.cause: The TP point is not on the circle. Cannot add more TP lines.
LRNR-011.remedy: Make sure either geometric data is correct or TP program taught correctly.

LRNR-012.cause: The existing TP lines are not CIR lines. Cannot add more TP lines.
LRNR-012.remedy: Use CIR TP lines to use Auto Add Lines functions

LRNR-013.cause: The target program has been modified.
LRNR-013.remedy: Please use related view (i + FCTN) to start LPC one more time.

LSTP-001.cause: You have requested that a motion group enter local stop mode while motion is still active for the requested group.
LSTP-001.remedy: Press RESET and ensure that the requested group does not have motion activity before you request that the motion group enter local stop mode.

LSTP-002.cause: The brake is not engaged after the brake on timer has expired.
LSTP-002.remedy: This is an internal system error. Contact FANUC America Corporation.

LSTP-003.cause: The brake is not released after the brake off timer has expired.
LSTP-003.remedy: This is a warning message. Contact FANUC America Corporation technical support if the error message occurs consistently.

LSTP-004.cause: An error has occurred when the SDO singal was set to ON.
LSTP-004.remedy: Verify that the SDO signal port type and port number assignment for the specified motion group is correct.

LSTP-005.cause: An error has occurred when the SDO signal was set to OFF.
LSTP-005.remedy: This is an internal system error. Contact FANUC America Corporation.

LSTP-006.cause: The SDI1 ON signal timer has expired.
LSTP-006.remedy: This is an internal system error. Contact FANUC America Corporation.

LSTP-007.cause: The SDI1 OFF signal timer has expired.
LSTP-007.remedy: This is an internal system error. Contact FANUC America Corporation.

LSTP-008.cause: The SDI1 signal is OFF while local stop is enabled for the specified motion group.
LSTP-008.remedy: This is an internal system error. Contact FANUC America Corporation.

LSTP-009.cause: The SDI1 signal is ON while local stop is disabled for the specified motion group.
LSTP-009.remedy: This is an internal system error. Contact FANUC America Corporation.

LSTP-010.cause: Motion command is received while the specified group is entering the local stop mode.
LSTP-010.remedy: Press RESET then set the SDI2 signal to ON to disable the local stop function if you want to send a motion command to this motion group.

LSTP-011.cause: The motion command was received while the specified group is in the local stop mode.
LSTP-011.remedy: Press RESET then disable the local stop if you want to send a motion command to this motion group.

LSTP-012.message: LSU %d is in HDWR FAIL mode
LSTP-012.cause: The Local Stop Unit is in hardware failure mode.
LSTP-012.remedy: This is an internal system error. Contact FANUC America Corporation.

LSTP-013.cause: Trying to request a motion group to enter local stop mode while torque is still active for the requested group.
LSTP-013.remedy: Please reset the error and ensure the requested group does not have motion activity.

LSTP-014.cause: Trying to request a motion group to enter local stop mode while torque is still active for the requested group.
LSTP-014.remedy: This is a warning message. A real alarm will be posted after the timer has expired.

LSTP-015.cause: 1: Servo off(brake control) of the local stop group is disabled. 2: The brake number of the local stop group is zero. 3: The brake number of the local stop group is used in other group.
LSTP-015.remedy: 1: Enable servo off(brake control) for the local stop group. 2: Set correct brake number for the local stop group.

MACR-001.cause: The conditions for assigning macros are not correct.
MACR-001.remedy: Check if there is a double definition or if the index is over the range.

MACR-003.cause: It is not possible to assign a program with MOTION lock group to the User Key(UK) button.
MACR-003.remedy: Remove the motion lock group from the program.

MACR-004.cause: It is not possible to execute a program with MOTION lock group with the User Key(UK) button.
MACR-004.remedy: Remove the motion lock group from the program.

MACR-005.cause: It is not possible to execute a program when the teach pendant is disabled.

MACR-006.cause: It is not possible to execute a program when the teach pendant is enabled.

MACR-007.cause: The macro assign type already exists.
MACR-007.remedy: Change the assign type to another.

MACR-008.cause: This assign type is only enabled at REMOTE condition.

MACR-009.message: The index is out of range
MACR-009.cause: This assign index is out of range.

MACR-010.cause: This SOP buttom is not enabled for macro execution.
MACR-010.remedy: Change the value of the $MACRSOPENBL system variable. Refer to the SYSTEM RJ Software Reference Manual, Chapter 2, System Variable Alphabetical Description", for more information on setting system variables.

MACR-011.cause: This UOP signal is not enabled for macro execution.
MACR-011.remedy: Change the value of the $MACRSOPENBL system variable. Refer to the SYSTEM RJ Software Reference Manual, Chapter 2, System Variable Alphabetical Description", for more information on setting system variables.

MACR-012.cause: The number of RI+DI is over the maximum number. You can assign RI and DI to macro assign type, but the total number of assignments possible is restricted by the system variable $MACROMAXDRI. $MACROMAXDRI must be set to 5 and never be changed. When the total number of assignments is over $MACROMAXDRI, this alarm occurs.
MACR-012.remedy: First deassign the other RI or DI assignments. Then assign the new macro as RI or DI.

MACR-013.remedy: Refer to the error cause code. Use to display the Alarm Log screen.

MACR-016.remedy: The macro will begin executing from the first line at the next execution.

MARL-000.cause: User tried to change data that was in use by robot
MARL-000.remedy: This is a warning message. In order to change data, in this case, you must first ABORT ALL

MARL-001.cause: User tried to change data that was in use by robot
MARL-001.remedy: This is a warning message. In order to change data, in this case, you must first ABORT ALL

MARL-002.cause: KAREL GET_VAR built-in did not return a successful status
MARL-002.remedy: Check if the variable exists or is initialized If the variable does not exist or is uninitia- lized, try to figure out why. Call FANUC America Corporation for assistance with the number posted with the error.

MARL-003.cause: KAREL SET_VAR built-in did not return a successful status
MARL-003.remedy: Check if the variable exists or is initialized If the variable does not exist or is uninitia- lized, try to figure out why. Call FANUC America Corporation for assistance with the number posted with the error.

MARL-004.cause: Error occurred while saving a.VR file
MARL-004.remedy: Check if the disk drive is connected or if there is a problem with the cable. Check if the floppy disk is formatted and if it is a double density diskette. Check if the diskette is full.

MARL-005.cause: Error occurred while loading a.VR file
MARL-005.remedy: Check if the disk drive is connected or if there is a problem with the cable. Check if the floppy disk is formatted and if it is a double density diskette. Check if the diskette is full.

MARL-006.cause: Error occurred while creating the file MRDTxxx.vr
MARL-006.remedy: Check RAM memory from the STATUS Memory menu. Perhaps there isn't enough memory to create the data file. If the memory looks ok, contact FANUC America Corporation with the number associated with the message.

MARL-007.cause: Error occurred while creating a variable
MARL-007.remedy: This message is an informational message and is always posted with another message.

MARL-008.cause: Error occurred while reading the data which the user entered.
MARL-008.remedy: This is a warning message. Try again. If you keep getting this message contact FANUCAmerica Corporation with the number in the error string.

MARL-009.cause: User is trying to modify a file which does not exist in the controller RAM.
MARL-009.remedy: This is a warning message. Either create a new file or if you forgot, the load the file first.

MARL-010.cause: File does not exist in the controller RAM.

MARL-011.cause: Either operator panel E-STOP, teach pendant E-STOP is ON or teach pendant is enabled.
MARL-011.remedy: This is a warning message and is posted with another message which will tell you exactly why the program cannot be resumed.

MARL-012.cause: Program cannot run with operator panel E-STOP
MARL-012.remedy: Release Operator panel E-stop, press reset and push cycle start to continue.

MARL-013.cause: Program cannot run with teach pendant E-STOP
MARL-013.remedy: Release teach pendant E-stop, press reset and push cycle start to continue.

MARL-014.cause: Program cannot run with teach pendant enabled
MARL-014.remedy: Disable teach pendant, press reset, and push cycle start to continue.

MARL-015.cause: No program was selected from the SELECT menu prior to pressing CYCLE START.
MARL-015.remedy: Select a program and then press CYCLE START.

MARL-016.cause: An attempt was made to run a program that was already running.
MARL-016.remedy: No action necssary. This is only a warning message.

MARL-017.cause: Register not defined or out of range.
MARL-017.remedy: Check if the register is defined, if it is between 1-32.

MARL-018.remedy: Check if the register is defined, if it is between 1-32 and if it hast the right value. ABORT ALL and retry

MARL-019.cause: User switched to another screen without pressing DONE in the cycle start menu.
MARL-019.remedy: This is a warning message. Do not switch screens before pressing DONE at the cycle start menu.

MARL-020.cause: User pressed DONE key without entering the product number in the cycle start menu.
MARL-020.remedy: This is a warning message. Enter the product number and then press DONE.

MARL-021.cause: An attempt was made to copy a file which is already loaded on the controller.

MARL-022.cause: An error occurred while loading a file to the controller memory.
MARL-022.remedy: This is a warning message. The file did not get loaded. Check if the communications cable is connected and that it is ok. Make sure the file you want to load exists on the floppy.

MARL-023.remedy: Check if the position value is defined and if it is valid. ABORT ALL and retry

MARL-031.cause: This alarm indicates that there is a problem with the serial line used for the active gripper device.
MARL-031.remedy: You must clear the serial line by changing it in the PORT I/O menu from No Use to Host Comm and then back to No Use. Follow these steps: 1. Select SETUP. 2. Press F1, [TYPE]. 3. Select Port Init.

MARL-038.cause: This indicates that there is a problem with the serial line used for the active gripper device.
MARL-038.remedy: You must clear the serial line by changing it in the PORT I/O menu from No Use to Host Comm and then back to No Use. Follow these steps: 1. Select SETUP. 2. Press F1, [TYPE]. 3. Select Port Init.

MARL-046.cause: An error has occurred. THIS NEEDS TO BE MORE SPECIFIC.
MARL-046.remedy: Refer to Pushcorp's FCU1000 Controller Manual for detailed info on the error. If you are unable to resolve the error, contact the FANUC America Corporation Hotline. The following errors might be assigned to MARL-046: 1001 “Unknown command” 1

MASI-001.cause: Internal error. This class of error should not be encountered during normal operation
MASI-001.remedy: The system may have been corrupted. This may have been caused by any of a number of reasons including: Incorrect loading and setup loading incompatible options, mixing software version when adding options and other memory corruption problems. The following is a list of possible remedies: 1. Perform a cold start. 2. Perform an init start and setup the robot again 3. Confirm that any options or additional software not on the original software distribution media is the same version number. If the main system software was supplied on several disks or memory cards, make sure that you are using a matched set. Also make sure that the installation manual being used is for this version of software. If any of the software version are not matched, a complete re-load with the correct software will be necessary. 4. Confirm that no incompatible or mutually exclusive option have been loaded. 5. Full software reload. 6. If the error is not cleared, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

If the main system software was supplied on several disks or memory cards, make sure that you are using a matched set. Also make sure that the installation manual being used is for this version of software. If any of the software version are not matched, a complete re-load with the correct software will be necessary. 4. Confirm that no incompatible or mutually exclusive option have been loaded. 5. Full software reload. 6. If the error is not cleared, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

MASI-028.cause: Internal error. This class of error should not be encountered during normal operation
MASI-028.remedy: The system may have been corrupted. This may have been caused by any of a number of reasons including: Incorrect loading and setup loading incompatible options, mixing software version when adding options and other memory corruption problems. The following is a list of possible remedies: 1. Perform a cold start. 2. Perform an init start and setup the robot again 3. Confirm that any options or additional software not on the original software distribution media is the same version number. If the main system software was supplied on several disks or memory cards, make sure that you are using a matched set. Also make sure that the installation manual being used is for this version of software. If any of the software version are not matched, a complete re-load with the correct software will be necessary. 4. Confirm that no incompatible or mutually exclusive option have been loaded. 5. Full software reload. 6. If the error is not cleared, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

MCTL-001.cause: Teach pendant is enabled, therefore motion control was not granted.

MCTL-002.cause: The teach pendant is disabled, therefore motion control was not granted.
MCTL-002.remedy: Enable the teach pendant, and try the operation again.

MCTL-003.cause: The system is in error status, therefore motion control was not granted.
MCTL-003.remedy: Clear the error by pressing RESET, and try the operation again.

MCTL-004.cause: Motion control was not granted because otion is still in progress.
MCTL-004.remedy: Wait until the robot comes to a complete stop.

MCTL-005.cause: Motion control was not granted because brakes were engaged.
MCTL-005.remedy: Make sure all brakes are released and try the operation again.

MCTL-006.cause: The teach pendant currently has the motion control, therefore motion control was not granted.
MCTL-006.remedy: Disable the teach pendant, and try the same operation again.

MCTL-007.cause: The program has the motion control, therefore motion control was not granted.
MCTL-007.remedy: Pause or abort the program, and try the same operation again.

MCTL-008.cause: Becasue the operator panel has the motion control, the motion control was not granted.
MCTL-008.remedy: Set the $rmt_master system variable correctly, and try the operation again.

MCTL-009.cause: Other device has the motion control, and the motion control was not granted.
MCTL-009.remedy: Set the $rmt_master system variable correctly, and try the operation again.

MCTL-010.remedy: Perform a cold start: 1. Turn off the robot. 2. On the teach pendant, press and hold the SHIFT and RESET keys. 3. While still pressing the SHIFT and RESET keys, turn on the robot. If the error is not cleared, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

MCTL-011.remedy: Perform a cold start: 1. Turn off the robot. 2. On the teach pendant, press and hold the SHIFT and RESET keys. 3. While still pressing the SHIFT and RESET keys, turn on the robot. If the error is not cleared, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

MCTL-012.remedy: Perform a cold start: 1. Turn off the robot. 2. On the teach pendant, press and hold the SHIFT and RESET keys. 3. While still pressing the SHIFT and RESET keys, turn on the robot. MCTL-013.cause: ENBL input on the UOP is off.

MCTL-014.cause: The motion control was not granted because servo was not up.

MCTL-015.cause: The motion control was not granted because manual brake control is enabled.

MEMO-158.cause: When loading the specified KAREL program the variable type definition required conversion. The program was loaded and converted as needed.

MEMO-159.remedy: See the diagnostic data file, FR:KRLCONV.LS, for more information about the specific variable and program involved. Translate this program using a version of the translator that matches the version of the controller. Then try to load the program again.

MEMO-160.cause: When loading a KAREL program or dictionary, a backup copy could not be made to the specified file. The program or dictionary was loaded into memory.
MEMO-160.remedy: Check that there is space available on the specified device. If not, remove some unneeded files. Check the cause message for this alarm. It will provide the specific reason that the copy could not complete.

MEMO-161.cause: When loading the specified KAREL program the variable type definition required conversion to the specified version.
MEMO-161.remedy: If conversion was expected then no action is required. If conversion was not expected, then maybe the loaded program was not the version of the program that was needed. Check for other versions of this program and load them as needed.

MEMO-163.cause: The type definition for a field in a structure already exists but is of a different type than what you are attempting to load.
MEMO-163.remedy: Translate this program using a version of the translator that matches the version of the controller. Then try to load the program again.

MEMO-164.cause: The type definition for a structure in a KAREL program already exists but is of a different type than what you are attempting to load.

MEMO-169.cause: The program that you attempted to clear with the PROG_CLEAR builtin failed.
MEMO-169.remedy: Refer to the remedy on the cause code. Typically the cause of the error is that the program is selected. In this case, unselect the program via the SELECT_TPE builtin before executing the PROG_CLEAR builtin.

MEMO-170.cause: The program name must be shorter than eight characters when long program names are not enabled or configured.

MEMO-172.cause: The operation requires extended storage option to be loaded.

MEMO-173.cause: No more program space is available

MEMO-176.cause: A TP file in the file directory has been deleted or the resource containing TP FILE programs is unavailable
MEMO-176.remedy: Check the TP FILE programs directory to make sure that it is accesible from the robot posting this error.

MEMO-177.cause: The ON DEMAND program could not be loaded
MEMO-177.remedy: If the problem persists please document the events that led to the error, and contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

MHND-001.cause: Program cannot run because an error condition will not clear. When on the ALARM page, select this error and press HELP to see error detail.
MHND-001.remedy: Fix the error condition, press reset,

MHND-002.cause: Program cannot run with operator panel E-STOP
MHND-002.remedy: Release Operator panel E-stop, press reset and push cycle start to continue.

MHND-003.cause: Program cannot run with teach pendant E-STOP
MHND-003.remedy: Release teach pendant E-stop, press reset and push cycle start to continue.

MHND-004.cause: Program cannot run with teach pendant enabled
MHND-004.remedy: Disable teach pendant, press reset, and push cycle start to continue.

MHND-005.cause: An error condition exists such that the robot cannot be reset.
MHND-005.remedy: Fix the error condition, press reset.

MHND-006.cause: To run a.tp program in local you must first select the program.
MHND-006.remedy: Press SELECT key and choose a program to run. If trying to run M.H. Shell, the key switch must be in REMOTE.

MHND-007.cause: A UOP signal was detected, but the controller is not set up to start using UOPs.
MHND-007.remedy: UOP must be set as the start device or the UOP signal will be ignored.

MHND-008.cause: A SOP signal was detected, but the controller is not set up to start using SOPs.
MHND-008.remedy: SOP must be set as the start device or the SOP signal will be ignored.

MHND-009.cause: While M.H. Shell was internally trying to run another program in multi-tasking mode, an error occurred.

MHND-010.cause: An old smaller POSREG.VR file was loaded onto the controller. The number of position registers was changed to fewer than what the current version of M.H. Shell needs.
MHND-010.remedy: M.H. Shell logic has automatically set the number of position registers to the necessary size again. But a cold start is needed to increase the position register table size. Do a cold start.

MHND-011.cause: An old smaller SYSMACRO.SV file was loaded onto the controller. The number of macros was changed to fewer than what the current version of M.H. Shell needs.
MHND-011.remedy: M.H. Shell logic has automatically set the number of macros to the necessary size again. But it needs a cold start in order for the macro table size to be increased. Do a cold start.

MHND-012.cause: Temporary memory is getting too low to download more files.
MHND-012.remedy: Warning only. Delete any unneeded data before down-loading files.

MHND-013.cause: The robot must be calibrated to run tp programs.

MHND-014.message: Robot must be at home position
MHND-014.cause: The At home check function is enabled but the robot is not at the home position when the start was received.
MHND-014.remedy: Move the robot to the home position. Once the robot is at home, then you can re-issue the request.

MHND-015.cause: The At home check function is enabled but the Home refpos has not been fully setup.
MHND-015.remedy: Select SETUP, [TYPE], Ref Position. Make sure the selected Refpos is taught and enabled. Select SETUP, [TYPE], Shell config. Make sure the Which ReFpos is HOME position is setup under the Special Positions DETAILS. Then ABORT and retry.

MHND-016.cause: The REMOTE keyswitch is on LOCAL, and needs to be set to REMOTE.
MHND-016.remedy: Turn the REMOTE keyswitch to REMOTE.

MHND-017.message: UOP is not the master device
MHND-017.cause: The UOP is not the master device, which prevents the run request from executing.
MHND-017.remedy: Go the the Variables menu under SYSTEM, and set $RMT_MASTER=0.

MHND-018.cause: The program that you tried to run is not loaded on the controller.
MHND-018.remedy: Load or create the program. If the program name shown in the error code is wrong, then check that the MENU, SETUP, Shell Config TP program ID method and DETAILS are correct

MHND-019.cause: The robot mode is not MANUAL, so the operation requested cannot be performed.
MHND-019.remedy: The manual mode din from the PLC is set OFF. It must be ON for manual mode operations.

MHND-020.message: Robot must be in AUTO mode
MHND-020.cause: The robot must be in full automatic mode with the PLC before production operation can occur.
MHND-020.remedy: The manual mode din from the PLC is set ON. It must be OFF for automatic control of production.

MHND-021.cause: On manual mode entry - Manual mode input from the PLC just turned ON. All PLC manual mode input functions are enabled.

MHND-022.cause: On manual mode exit - Manual mode input from the PLC just turned OFF. All PLC manual mode input functions are disabled. Normal auto mode execution is allowed.

MHND-023.message: Robot is busy. Mode change pending.
MHND-023.cause: Robot mode is being changed while the robot is busy
MHND-023.remedy: When the robot is idle, change the manual mode bit again to the desired state. NOTE: The system is watching for a change in input setting to change the robot mode.

MHND-024.cause: Step mode is enabled, which prevents the run request from executing.
MHND-024.remedy: Press the STEP hardkey to disable step mode.

MHND-025.message: UOP CYCLE START can only resume
MHND-025.cause: A UOP CYCLE START input was detected but no paused program exists.
MHND-025.remedy: None available. This error is only generated if your Cell interface has been specified using $shell_cfg.$cont_only=TRUE. If this is the case, then for safety reasons UOP CYCLE START is only used for resuming paused programs.

MHND-026.cause: A DIN program select was detected but either the keyswitch is not in remote or the selected program does not exist.
MHND-026.remedy: Check the keyswitch settings. Check the program selected.

MHND-028.cause: A PNS program select was detected but either the keyswitch is not in remote or the selected program does not exist.
MHND-028.remedy: Check the keyswitch settings. Check the program selected.

MHND-029.cause: A GIN program select was detected but either the keyswitch is not in remote or the selected program does not exist.
MHND-029.remedy: Check the keyswitch settings. Check the program selected.

MHND-030.cause: A RSR program select was detected but either the keyswitch is not in remote or the selected program does not exist.
MHND-030.remedy: Check the keyswitch settings. Check the program selected.

MHND-031.cause: The cycle interrupt option has been disabled.
MHND-031.remedy: This is a status message only.

MHND-032.cause: The cycle interrupt option has been enabled.
MHND-032.remedy: This is a status message only.

MHND-033.cause: A DIN signal was detected, but the controller is not set up to start using DINs.
MHND-033.remedy: DIN must be set as the start device or the DIN signal will be ignored.

MHND-034.cause: The job selection setup was not completed properly. Selected I/O does not exist.
MHND-034.remedy: Go to the MENU, SETUP, Shell Config menu and make sure the TP program ID method and details are setup correctly.

MHND-035.cause: A start signal was received but a TP program is already running. A second TP program will not be started at this time.

MHND-037.cause: The menu test screen is displayed on the TP. A TP program cannot be started until a different screen is displayed.
MHND-037.remedy: Display a different menu on the TP and give another start signal.

MHND-038.cause: MULTIIO.TP is not running. It will be restarted.
MHND-038.remedy: If MULTIIO.TP does not automatically restart, check alarm log for errors.

MHND-039.message: Cycle power to change user alarms
MHND-039.cause: The new number of user alarms will not take effect until after a cold start.

MHND-040.message: Cycle power to change no of tasks
MHND-040.cause: The new number of tasks will not take effect until after a cold start.

MHND-041.cause: CMOS memory is getting too low to create more variable files.
MHND-041.remedy: Warning only. Delete any unneeded data.

MHND-100.cause: A customized pause error was detected.

MOTN-000.cause: Internal system error. This class of error should not be encountered by the user during normal operation
MOTN-000.remedy: The system may have been corrupted. This may have been caused by any of a number of reasons including: Incorrect loading and setup loading incompatible options, mixing software version when adding options and other memory corruption problems. The following is a list of possible remedies: 1. Perform a cold start. 2. Perform an init start and setup the robot again 3. Confirm that any options or additional software not on the original software distribution media is the same version number. If the main system software was supplied on several disks or memory cards, make sure that you are using a matched set. Also make sure that the installation manual being used is for this version of software. If any of the software version are not matched, a complete re-load with the correct software will be necessary. 4. Confirm that no incompatible or mutually exclusive option have been loaded. 5. Full software reload. 6. If the error is not cleared, document the events that led to the error and call your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

MOTN-208.remedy: Make the taught configuration reachable by touching up the point at the stop position when the warning message is posted under single-step-forward mode.

MOTN-209.cause: This warning message indicates that the taught position at the specific line is inside a singularity zone. By default, the system modifies it in order to control the rotation of axis 4. If $ra_prarmgrp[].$use_strt_j4 = TRUE, the Auto Singularity Avoidance function will internally modify the destination position when it is inside a pre-defined singularity zone in the following way: • The joint angle of Axis 4 is kept the same as the value of the previous position • The TCP location (x, y and z) of the position is the same as it was taught (no location error) • The orientation (w, p and r) of the position is kept as close to the taught position as possible (minimal orientation error) This warning message is posted only when the program motion is executed under T1/T2 mode and $ra_paramgrp[].$warnmessenb = TRUE.
MOTN-209.remedy: If you do not want the system to modify the singularity point, set $ra_paramgrp[].$use_strt_j4 = FALSE.

MOTN-356.cause: The change in the SPIN angle from start to destination is 180 deg.
MOTN-356.remedy: Re-teach points such that the change in the SPIN angle from start to destination is less than 180 deg.

MOTN-357.cause: The resumed planned data is not the same as the original data.
MOTN-357.remedy: Press RESET or Abort the program.

MOTN-358.cause: The prev and start positions of this A motion are too close to each other.
MOTN-358.remedy: Re-touch up the taught point(s) of the immediate previous A motion line(s) OR jog robot away from current position.

MOTN-359.cause: The Start and Next positions of this A motion are too close to each other.
MOTN-359.remedy: Re-touch up either the taught point of the previous A motion line or the taught point of the next A motion line.

MOTN-360.cause: The destination and previous positions of this A motion are too close to each other.
MOTN-360.remedy: Re-touch up either the taught point of the current A motion line or the taught point of the A motion line that is prior to the previous A motion line.

MOTN-361.cause: The destination and next positions of this A motion are too close to each other.
MOTN-361.remedy: Re-touch up either the taught point of the current A motion line or the taught point of the next A motion line.

MOTN-362.cause: Blending of two arc segments is not supported.

MOTN-363.cause: Motype A does not support tracking.
MOTN-363.remedy: Do not use motion type A.

MOTN-364.cause: Motype A does not support the option.
MOTN-364.remedy: Do not use motion type A.

MOTN-365.cause: The softpart does not support motion type A.
MOTN-365.remedy: Do not use motion type A.

MOTN-366.cause: RPM does not support motion type A.
MOTN-366.remedy: Do not use motion type A.

MOTN-367.remedy: This is just a notification message only. Re-taught points if necessary.

MOTN-368.cause: CLAMP function does not support ARC and CRC.

MOTN-369.message: CLAMP of CART cannot be calculated

MOTN-369.remedy: Don't use ARC and CRC when CLAMP function is effective.

MOTN-375.cause: The system does NOT support KAREL path motions.
MOTN-375.remedy: Do not run KAREL Path motions and use teach pendant programs instead.

MOTN-380.cause: The main body's arm and runner are too close to each other.
MOTN-380.remedy: Expand the distance of main body's arm and Runner.

MOTN-381.cause: The main body's hand and runner are too close to each other.
MOTN-381.remedy: Expand the distance of main body's hand and runner.

MOTN-385.cause: Please attach the weight on the backside of the J3 link.

MOTN-390.cause: The required motion option is not loaded.
MOTN-390.remedy: Verify motion options loaded in the controller and make sure the required option is also loaded.

MOTN-391.cause: Motion option configuration file is not loaded or cannot be read.
MOTN-391.remedy: Re-load correct motion option config file.

MOTN-392.cause: The number of softparts exceeds the limit of 32.
MOTN-392.remedy: Reload the system with less than 32 softparts.

MOTN-393.cause: When Small Circle Accuracy is ordered, you can't use this setting.
MOTN-393.remedy: Don't order Small Circle Accuracy when you use this setting.

MOTN-394.cause: When Servo Torch is ordered, you can't use this setting.
MOTN-394.remedy: Don't order Servo Torch when you use this setting.

MOTN-400.cause: No register has been defined for use with the Collision Guard Update macro.

MOTN-401.cause: The data contained in the Collision Guard macro register is not an integer or is not in the range of 1 to 200.
MOTN-401.remedy: Enter the correct data into the Collision Guard macro register.

MOTN-402.cause: Servo system failed to acknowledge servo parameter update.
MOTN-402.remedy: Check that communication between servo and host is OK. HSCD does not support tabletop controller.

MOTN-403.cause: Servo system is updating servo parameters to match user-defined HSCD parameters.
MOTN-403.remedy: No action needed. This warning is only a reminder.

MOTN-404.cause: The COL ADJUST instruction was used in a teach pendant program, but the group mask contained a group that did not support High Sensitivity Collision Detection (HSCD).
MOTN-404.remedy: Do not attempt to change the sensitivity for a group that does not support HSCD.

MOTN-410.cause: The selected UFRAME is disabled for jogging.
MOTN-410.remedy: Enable the affected UFRAME for jogging, or use a different UFRAME to jog.

MOTN-474.cause: The option can not use with CLSM motion
MOTN-474.remedy: Please remove either CLSM or the option.

MOTN-481.cause: The robot could not synchronize with external/virtual clock
MOTN-481.remedy: The following items are considered to this alarm. Please check them and fix the cause. 1: It is possible for clock speed to be faster than the robot motoion. Please make the clock speed do more slowly than current one. 2: It is possible for motion sentence in TP program to be slower than the colck speed. If the program speed can be faster than current one, make it faster than current program speed. 3: It is possible for motion sentence in TP program to be slower than the colck speed. If the program speed can be faster than current one, make it faster than current program speed.

MOTN-482.remedy: The following items are considered to this alarm. Please check them and fix the cause. 1: The position between current actual robot and simultaneous start motion sentence is different. Teach the normal motion sentence which have same position as simultaneous start motion sentence 2: Clock data might be wrong or invalid. Check if the clock data is valid.

MOTN-483.message: CS: Can't do simul-motion on the way
MOTN-483.cause: Tried to start simultaneous motion on the way to it.
MOTN-483.remedy: Starting simultaneous motion on the way to it can not be permitted. Please execute from start line of simultaneous motion.

MOTN-484.cause: Executed operation of OVERRIDE change on simultaneous motion.
MOTN-484.remedy: The operation of OVERRIDE change can not be permitted on simultaneous motion because it might be possible not to continue the simultaneous motion. Please do not operate the OVERRIDE change on simultaneous motion.

MOTN-485.cause: On simultaneous motion, HOLD or E-STOP signal is inputted into controller After it, users tried to restart simultaneous motion.
MOTN-485.remedy: Restart after HOLD or E-STOP on simultaneous motion can not be permitted. Please execute from start line of simultaneous motion.

MOTN-486.cause: Executed operation of singlestep on simultaneous motion.
MOTN-486.remedy: The operation of singlestep can not be permitted on simultaneous motion because it might be possible not to continue the simultaneous motion. Please do not operate the singlestep on simultaneous motion.

MOTN-520.cause: Reducer torque overs the threshold. Payload setting is wrong. or the value of acceleration override instruction(ACC) is too large.
MOTN-520.remedy: 1. Verify payload setting is correct. 2. Lessen acceleration(ACC) of motion that generates this warning.

MOTN-521.cause: Load that is given to J2 axis exceeds threshold. Payload setting is wrong or the value of ACC is too large.
MOTN-521.remedy: 1. Verify payload setting is correct. 2. Lessen acceleration(ACC) of motion that generates this warning.

MOTN-522.cause: Load that is given to the joint between LinkA and LinkB exceeds threshold. Payload setting is wrong or the value of ACC is too large.
MOTN-522.remedy: 1: Verify payload setting is correct. 2: Lessen acceleration(ACC) of motion that generates this warning.

MOTN-524.cause: The memory for LVC is full. 1st parameter means the modal number of learning data. 2nd parameter means the name of TP program. 3rd parameter means line number to alarm's be ocuured. 4th parameter means section of LVC memory area.
MOTN-524.remedy: Please operate the following procedure. 1. If you can decrease the motion statements in LVC modal, please decrease them. 2. If you can not decrease the motion statements in LVC modal, please devide into two modal.

MOTN-525.cause: LVC has failed of getting memory from DRAM
MOTN-525.remedy: 1. Confirm that the size of DRAM is as much as 64MB. If not, change DRAM. 2. If MOTN-525 is posted after you operate the above, the system might use many DRAM because many option S/W are loaded. In this case, you might need to un-install S/W option if you enable to use LVC.

MOTN-526.cause: Gun touch speed is over designated speed. The 1st parameter shows line number at which MOTN-526 is posted. The 2nd parameter shows how is over designated GunTouchSpeed. The cause might be considered. 1. The inner override is too high 2. The filter length of Gun open motion or approach motion is too long.
MOTN-526.remedy: Add the new taught point near the motion statement at which MOTN-526 is posted.

MOTN-527.cause: LVC has failed to get memory for before-learning on DRAM.
MOTN-527.remedy: First, confirm that the size of DRAM is at least 64MB. If not, change DRAM. If MOTN-527 is posted after you operate the above, the system could be out of DRAM because many software options are loaded. In this case, you can not use LVC.

MOTN-528.cause: LVC has failed to get memory for after-learning on DRAM.
MOTN-528.remedy: First, confirm that the size of DRAM is at least 64MB. If not, change DRAM. Next, decrease the number of $LVCFG.$MAX_MDL_NUM and Power OFF/ON. If MOTN-528 is posted after you operate the above, the system might be out of DRAM because many software options are loaded. In this case, you can not use LVC.

MOTN-529.cause: The motion instruction which can not be executed with LVC is taught. MOTN-529 has two parameters. The first parameter shows line number at which MOTN-529 is posted. The 2nd parameter shows motion instruction which can not be executed with LVC as follows: 1. external path optimization 3. Weaving 4. Line tracking 5. Touch Sensor 6. Coordinated motion 7. Continuous turn 8. Clock Simultaneous function
MOTN-529.remedy: Delete motion instruction which can not be executed with LVC or LVC instruction.

MOTN-530.cause: The axis besides an object of LVC moved.
MOTN-530.remedy: Teach the position not to move axis besides an object of LVC

MOTN-531.remedy: There is no action required for this alarm.

MOTN-533.cause: Override change has been done in LVC execution. LVC always works at 100% override.
MOTN-533.remedy: Don't change override during LVC execution. If override instruction is less than 100%, delete the override instruction.

MOTN-534.cause: Single Step occurred during LVC execution. LVC does not work with Single Step.
MOTN-534.remedy: Don't use single step during LVC execution.

MOTN-536.cause: LVC has been disabled on part of the path because the path has changed. Cycle time may be slower because the disabled part of the path does not speed up.

MOTN-537.cause: The motion which will be executed is different from the motion saved in LVC. The cause might be that the re-teaching occurred after learning finished. MOTN-537 has three parameters. The first parameter shows modal number which is executed when MOTN-537 is posted. The second parameter shows line number which is executed when MOTN-537 is posted. The third parameter shows the changed element: 1: motion type 2: start position 4: destination position 8: via position 16: taught speed 32: termination type 64: the value of CNT termination 128: user tool coordination 256: user frame coordination 512: override 1024: payload 2048: the value of ACC instruction 4096: PTH instruction 8192: WJNT instruction 16384: INC instruction 32768: the value of PSPD instruction 65536: MAXSPEED instruction 131072: the value of RT_LD, AP_LD instruction 262144: the value of CR instruction 524288: RTCP instruction 1048576: the value of Simultaneous EV or Independent EV instruction 2097152: Simultaneous EV or Independent EV instruction 4194304: number of points in robot 8388608: number of points in external axis 16777216: filter length 33554432: filter type 67108864: $progoverride 134217728: group number
MOTN-537.remedy: Recover data before re-teaching or do learning again.

MOTN-538.cause: In learning or replaying, the interval between start of motion might be changed. For example, WAIT instruction is inserted between motion sentences or the value of it is changed. First paramter means modal number of LVC instruction. Second parameter means line number of changed motion.
MOTN-538.remedy: Recover data before re-teaching or do learning again.

MOTN-539.cause: In learning or replaying, the interval from start of motion to end might be changed. For example, DVC or DAC occurred, or the motion is changed by logic instruction. First parameter means modal number of LVC instruction. Second parameter means line number of changed motion.
MOTN-539.remedy: Recover data before re-teaching or do learning again.

MOTN-542.cause: The memory for LVC is full.
MOTN-542.remedy: Please follow this procedure. 1. If you can reduce the number motion statements between LVC_START and LVC_END, please reduce them. 2. If you don't reduce the motion statements in LVC modal, please divide into two sets of LVC_START and LVC_END.

MOTN-543.cause: There is no learned data to set in memory for LVC.
MOTN-543.remedy: If the problem could not be resolved, contact your local FANUC representative.

MOTN-544.cause: There is no learned data to get from memory for LVC.
MOTN-544.remedy: 1. If you are in the middle of the learning process, un-do any program changes to return the program to the original state. 2. Re-do LVC learning. 3. If the problem could not be resolved, contact your local FANUC representative.

MOTN-545.cause: LVC motion was switched to normal motion because the motion changed. 1st parameter means the modal number of learning data. 2nd parameter means the name of TP program. 3rd parameter means line number where motion is changed.
MOTN-545.remedy: No need to remedy because of warning.

MOTN-546.cause: LVC motion restarted from normal motion. 1st parameter means the modal number of learning data. 2nd parameter means the name of TP program. 3rd parameter means line number where motion is changed.
MOTN-546.remedy: No need to remedy because of warning.

MOTN-547.cause: LVC doesnot support synchronous motion in case that two or more group are robot group.
MOTN-547.remedy: Please use RUN instruction in TP program to control two or more robot in the same time

MOTN-548.cause: Group number of the robot which is in learning is not match the setup in LVC DATA setup screen
MOTN-548.remedy: Please set the correct group number in LVC DATA screen.

MOTN-549.cause: Multi learn data cannot be in learning at the same time.
MOTN-549.remedy: Please comment out all of LVC_START and LVC_END so that only one learn data is in learning. Or disable learn data in LVC DATA screen that left only one data enabled.

MOTN-550.cause: LVC motion was switched to normal motion because the motion changed during auto-learn mode. 1st parameter means the modal number of learning data. 2nd parameter means the name of TP program. 3rd parameter means line number to motion's be changed.
MOTN-550.remedy: No need to remedy because of warning.

MOTN-553.cause: This means that sensor have been ready with reciever.

MOTN-554.cause: The number of wireless sensor is not enough.
MOTN-554.remedy: 1: Please try to execute the target TP again. 2: Delete or decrease the time of waiting instruction before LVC_END.

MOTN-555.cause: Failure to send packet to wast task.

MOTN-556.remedy: 1: Verify Wireless Sensor is switched on. If not, please turn it on. 2: Change the battery of Wireless Sensor. 3: Replace the Wireless Sensor.

MOTN-557.cause: The USB receiver cannot be detected.
MOTN-557.remedy: 1: Verify USB receiver is connected. If not, please connect it to iPendant. 2: Replace the USB receiver. 3: The USB port on iPendant is broken. Replace the iPendant.

MOTN-558.cause: The battery of wireless sensor is weakening.
MOTN-558.remedy: Change the battery of the wireless sensor.

MOTN-559.remedy: 1: Verify Wireless Sensor is switched on. If not, please turn it on. 2: Verify the receiver is connected. If not, please connect it. 3: Change the battery of Wireless Sensor. 4: Replace the Wireless Sensor and receiver.

MOTN-560.cause: The teaching speed with high-speed skip instruction reached to the speed limit and automatically clamped with the limit.

MOTN-561.cause: The collision skip is used with normal skip instruction or the robot that high-speed skip is not available.

MOTN-565.cause: The user program is trying to move the arm where there should be no movement.
MOTN-565.remedy: With 'Position Check' option, certain motions has to be 'zero-distance' motion, such as the first motion in a program or a sub-program, after returning from a sub-program, or after a JUMP label instruction. Make sure the sub-program name is correct, and the positions are correctly taught for these motions.

MOTN-566.cause: The orthogonality of uframe or utool is invalid
MOTN-566.remedy: Please set uframe or utool again in frame setup menu so that the orthogonality of the frame can be recovered. Number of uframe or utool which is needed to be set again is shown in alarm message as UTxx or UFxx.

MOTN-568.cause: The motion moved out of station.
MOTN-568.remedy: Try to set the fixed stations correctly.

MOTN-569.cause: Fixed stations which the user set are overlapped.
MOTN-569.remedy: Try to set the fixed stations not to overlap again.

MOTN-570.cause: The payload has changed since GLC learning. GLC learned data does not match payload.

MOTN-571.cause: The LEARN instruction is not valid in iRpick system.

MOTN-572.cause: 2 Consecutive LEARN instruction is not allow.
MOTN-572.remedy: Remove LEARN motion instruction from none transfer move motion line

MOTN-573.cause: GLC has failed of getting memory from DRAM
MOTN-573.remedy: 1. Confirm that the available memory of DRAM is enough. If not, change DRAM. 2. If MOTN-573 is posted after you operate the above, the system might use many DRAM because many option S/W are loaded. In this case, you might need to un-install S/W option if you enable to use GLC.

MOTN-574.cause: The motion instruction which can not be executed with GLC is taught. The 1st parameter shows line number at which MOTN-574 is posted. The 2nd parameter Id* shows motion instruction which can not be executed with GLC. ID list is written at GLC manual
MOTN-574.remedy: Delete motion instruction which can not be executed with GLC

MOTN-575.cause: The memory for GLC is full. The parameter means section of GLC memory area.

MOTN-576.remedy: The parameter Id* shows type of error. ID list is written at GLC manual

MOTN-577.message: GLC Not stop in station No%d
MOTN-577.cause: Robot did not stop in the configured station.
MOTN-577.remedy: Confirm the size of area and teach the size again if need.

MOTN-578.remedy: The parameter Id* shows cause of error. ID list is written in GLC manual

MOTN-579.remedy: TP program name, line number and the cause is output. The cause list is written in GLC manual

MOTN-580.cause: ACC sensor frame Auto setting was interrupted by User.
MOTN-580.remedy: Execute ACC sensor frame Auto setting again.

MOTN-581.cause: Sensor frame automatic setting function failed to calculate the sensor frame.
MOTN-581.remedy: Apply the following procedure. 1. Make sure sensor type (wired or wireless) is selected correctly and retry sensor frame automatic setting function. 2. Make sure whether the accelerometer is fixed firmly to an end-of-arm tool or servo gun, and retry sensor frame automatic setting function. 3. Set the sensor frame by six point method.

MOTN-582.cause: Sensor frame automatic setting function was executed with incorrect payload setting.
MOTN-582.remedy: Apply the following procedure and retry the sensor frame automatic setting function. 1. Display “Motion Performance” screen by pressing [MENU] key-“0 NEXT”-“6 SYSTEM”-F1[TYPE]-“Motion”. Then press F5,[SETIND] and set active payload number to other than 0. 2. Display “Motion Performance” screen by pressing [MENU] key-“0 NEXT”-“6 SYSTEM”-F1,[TYPE]-“Motion”. Then move the cursor to the active payload number and press F3,”DETAIL”. Enter the correct value of weight, gravity center position of the load, and inertia about its gravity center.

MOTN-583.cause: In sensor frame automatic setting function, the accuracy of the calculated sensor frame is not sufficient.
MOTN-583.remedy: Apply the following procedure and retry sensor frame automatic setting function. If the problem cannot be resolved, set the sensor frame by six point method. 1. Verify whether the accelerometer is fixed firmly to an end-of-arm tool or servo gun. 2. Display “Motion Performance” screen by pressing [MENU] key-“0 NEXT”-“6 SYSTEM”-F1[TYPE]-“Motion”. Verify the active payload number. 3. Display “Motion Performance” screen by pressing [MENU] key-“0 NEXT”-“6 SYSTEM”-F1,[TYPE]-“Motion”. Then move the cursor to the active payload number and press F3,”DETAIL”. Verify the value of weight, gravity center position of the load, and inertia about its gravity center. 4. Set the base position for sensor frame automatic setting function as close to the recommended posture as possible.

MOTN-584.cause: The execution was interrupted because the override has been changed during the fast movements of sensor frame automatic setting function.
MOTN-584.remedy: Retry sensor frame automatic setting function. Please do not change the override during the fast movements.

MOTN-585.cause: Calibration data for wireless sensor is illegal.

MOTN-586.cause: Can't finish learning because shortage of learning iteration.

MOTN-588.cause: Single Step has been inputted in APC execution. APC does not work with Single Step.
MOTN-588.remedy: You should reset this alarm and execute program again. After restart, not APC motion, but normal motion is executed.

MOTN-590.cause: Internal debug recorded exceeded max size.

MOTN-591.cause: Frame of ORNT_BASE is changed with CNT motion
MOTN-591.remedy: Use same frame or change term-type to FINE

MOTN-592.cause: ORNT_BASE is used with Linear or Joint motion

MOTN-593.cause: This instruction cannot use with ORNT_BASE

MOTN-594.cause: The frame specfied by ORNT_BASE is not suitable

MOTN-595.cause: The frame specfied by ORNT_BASE is not suitable

MOTN-600.message: ST: Sequence No error. PC %d, Rob %d
MOTN-600.cause: Sequence No. in stream motion data is invalid. Or answer of PC is too late.
MOTN-600.remedy: Correct Sequence No. Sequence No. should be same with the number sent from robot. Or answer more fast from PC.

MOTN-601.cause: Sequence No. in stream motion data is invalid. Or answer of PC is too late.
MOTN-601.remedy: Correct Sequence No. Sequence No. should be same with the number sent from robot. Or answer more fast from PC.

MOTN-602.cause: Data type in stream motion data is invalid.
MOTN-602.remedy: Correct data type. Data type should be 0:Cartesian or 1:Joint.

MOTN-603.cause: Robot can't receive stream motion command data in $STMO.$COM_INT ms.
MOTN-603.remedy: Reconsider the route between external device and robot. Or change program to send command data earlier. Or you may send the Data output stopping packet during stream motion.

MOTN-604.cause: Robot received too many packet for stream motion.
MOTN-604.remedy: Stack less packet or change $STMO.$PKT_STACK larger.

MOTN-605.remedy: Verify feasibility of the streaming position data.

MOTN-606.message: ST: Need to AUTO and 100% ovrd
MOTN-606.cause: Stream motion can do only on AUTO mode and 100% override.

MOTN-607.message: ST: Protocol version mismatch PC %d, Rob %d
MOTN-607.cause: Protocol version of Stream motion is mismatched.

MOTN-608.message: ST: TCP/IP error. See Cause and Remedy.
MOTN-608.cause: Cable may be unplugged or communication setting may not be correct or Ethernet is too busy
MOTN-608.remedy: This is only the information of the reason of last 2 HOST-380.

MOTN-609.cause: Robot received command data which exceeds joint velocity limit.
MOTN-609.remedy: Verify joint velocity of the streaming data.

MOTN-610.cause: Robot received command data which exceeds joint acc/dec limit.
MOTN-610.remedy: Verify joint acc/dec of the streaming data.

MOTN-611.cause: Robot received command data which exceeds joint jerk limit.
MOTN-611.remedy: Verify joint jerk of the streaming data.

MOTN-612.cause: Robot received command data which close to joint velocity limit.
MOTN-612.remedy: Verify joint velocity of the streaming data.

MOTN-613.cause: Robot received command data which close to joint acc/dec limit.
MOTN-613.remedy: Verify joint acc/dec of the streaming data.

MOTN-614.cause: Robot received command data which close to joint jerk limit.
MOTN-614.remedy: Verify joint jerk of the streaming data.

MOTN-615.cause: Brake control is not supported by stream motion.

MOTN-617.remedy: Verify command and the current position of the robot.

MOTN-619.cause: Cartesian type is not supported for this robot.

MOTN-620.cause: A wrist axis didn't reach to the taught turn number.

MOTN-621.message: Reduced TCP speed by elbow speed limit.(L:%d)
MOTN-621.cause: TCP speed is reduced so that elbow speed does not exceed the limit.
MOTN-621.remedy: Please modify the TP program line if the reduced TCP speed is unacceptable.

MOTN-622.cause: Motion was done between different wrist configuration. This occurs when (Wjnt when config changes) is enabled in system config menu and wrist configuration changed.

MOTN-623.cause: Resume Offset is not supported by stream motion.

MOTN-624.remedy: Press and hold the SHIFT and RESET keys. Release only RESET key. Still pressing the SHIFT key, and press any jog key to the axis away from the collision OR do manual guided teaching operation

MOTN-630.cause: S motion type requires Spline Motion option.
MOTN-630.remedy: Load Spline Motion option (R904) or use a different motion type

MOTN-632.cause: Speed reduced due to large orientation change or large motion in another group
MOTN-632.remedy: Reduce program speed or modify the program. Refer to your application-specific Setup and Operations Manual for more detail.

MOTN-633.cause: Command exceeds velocity, accel or jerk limits

MOTN-635.cause: Adjacent program points are taught at the same location.
MOTN-635.remedy: Do not teach segments with zero move

MOTN-636.cause: Robot cannot reach the end of Spline block.
MOTN-636.remedy: Get motion debug and report the issue

MOTN-637.remedy: Do not teach segments with direction reversal

MOTN-638.cause: S BWD moves linearly to previous point when in blending region. On-path motion is not possible.

MOTN-639.message: SPL:Enable CP to use S motion
MOTN-639.remedy: Enable CP option and cold start

MOTN-640.cause: After Hold, S motion type cannot resume on path when Original Path Resume is disabled.
MOTN-640.remedy: Enable Original Path Resume, or move cursor to another line and jog the robot to a safe place to start from that line before continuing. It should be possible to still support STEP FWD and STEP BWD for the org_path_resume disabled case, as long as the robot moves all the way to the taught point without hold.

MOTN-641.cause: Internal error in Spline planning This class of error should not be encountered during normal operation
MOTN-641.remedy: Please log debug and report the issue

MOTN-642.cause: Internal error in Spline execution This class of error should not be encountered during normal operation
MOTN-642.remedy: Please log debug and report the issue

MOTN-643.cause: Robot cannot do backward motion on spline path.
MOTN-643.remedy: Move cursor to different line and go forward

MOTN-644.cause: Spline path changed due to program edit
MOTN-644.remedy: Move cursor to a different line and resume

MUPS-001.message: use of M-PASS SP's bef. init

MUPS-002.remedy: Must have at least two points

MUPS-003.remedy: Internal error: motion type is not Joint, Linear, or Circular. If this error persists, contact FANUC America Corporation.

MUPS-005.remedy: Set OFFSET_MODE to a valid value.

MUPS-006.remedy: Multi-Pass does not support backward motion. Please do not use Shift-BWD in Multi-Pass.

MUPS-007.remedy: Add or remove motion option COORD.

MUPS-009.remedy: Pass direction can only be 0: Normal or 1: Reverse. First pass direction must be 0

MUPS-010.cause: Pass number and direction are not acceptable
MUPS-010.remedy: Check the pass number and direction

MUPS-011.message: Pass number is out of sequence
MUPS-011.cause: Pass number is not in sequence

MUPS-012.cause: Last pass was not welded to completion

NCBN-002.remedy: Correct the command syntax and load the program again

NCBN-003.remedy: Correct the command syntax and load the program again

NCBN-008.remedy: Correct the command syntax and load the program again
