SVGN-202.remedy: Correct the error on the gun number corresponding to GunB (gun index 2).

SVGN-203.message: GunA, GunB contact speed is different
SVGN-203.cause: The contact speed used in this Pressure Schedule is different for Gun A and Gun B - but contact speed must match to achieve synchronized contact with the part.
SVGN-203.remedy: Set the contact speed of the Pressure Schedule to the same value for both guns. This is done by adjusting the pressure calibration data which determines the contact speed. The Speed at a given Pressure must be the same for both guns. It is recommended to use matching Pressure and Speed values for each calibration point for both guns. Then, find the unique torque% required to achieve the pressure for each gun. OR, just set the contact speed for all points in the Pressure Calibration table for both guns to the same value.

SVGN-204.message: GunA, GunB pushing depth is different
SVGN-204.cause: Pushing depth is different for GunA and GunB. Equal pushing depth is required, for synchronized move to pressure position.
SVGN-204.remedy: Set $sgsch#[].$pushing depth, and $sggun#.$setup.$push_margin to same value, for both guns.

SVGN-205.message: GunA, GunB creep distance is different
SVGN-205.cause: The creep distances are different for GunA and GunB. Equal creep distance is required to achieve synchronized contact with the part.
SVGN-205.remedy: Set the system variable $sggun#.$setup.$creep_dst to the same value, for both guns on this dual-gun (# represents the gun number).

SVGN-206.message: GunA, GunB part thickness is different
SVGN-206.cause: The Part Thickness used in this Pressure Schedule is different for GunA and GunB. Equal thickness is required to achieve synchronized contact with the part.
SVGN-206.remedy: Set the part thickness to same value, for both guns.

SVGN-208.message: GunA, GunB linear distance is different
SVGN-208.remedy: Specify the same linear distance value for GunA and GunB.

SVGN-209.message: GunA, GunB joint velocity limits differ.
SVGN-209.cause: Joint velocity limits are different for gunA and gunB. Joint velocity limit must be equal to achieve synchronized contact with the part.
SVGN-209.remedy: Use the Gun Setup Utility to set the Maximum Speed (i.e. joint velocity limit) of both Gun A and B to the same value. - Go to UTILITIES - GUN SETUP - Press the F6 key, DG_CHECK - Press the F4 key, SETSPD and reply YES to the prompt to set the speed to same value - Cycle Power to activate the change

SVGN-210.cause: Acceleration Times are different for gunA and gunB. The acceleration times must be equal to achieve synchronized contact with the part.
SVGN-210.remedy: Use the Gun Setup Utility to set the Acceleration Times of both Gun A and B to the same value. - Go to UTILITIES - GUN SETUP - Press the F6 key, DG_CHECK - Press the F5 key, SETACC and reply YES to the prompt to set the accel time to same value - Cycle Power to activate the change

SVGN-211.cause: Weight calculation in the autotuning is not completed. Therefore, pressure was not able to be compensated.
SVGN-211.remedy: Complete weight calculation of the autotuning screen.

SVGN-212.message: Incomp weight calc for X gun
SVGN-212.cause: Weight calculation for X gun is not completed. Therefore, pressure was not able to be compensated.
SVGN-212.remedy: Complete weight calculation by executing WT_MEAS.TP.

SVGN-213.remedy: The setting of the tool coordinate system is wrong. It is necessary to set the tool coordinate system to the servo gun tips of fixed side. Moreover, +Z tool coordinate axial direction should be the same as the gun open direction.

SVGN-214.message: Servo gun type is not set
SVGN-214.cause: Servo gun type is not set. Therefore, pressure was not able to be compensated.
SVGN-214.remedy: Confirm the weight compensation gun type of the Servo Gun General Setup screen.

SVGN-215.cause: Incomplete manual weight compensation setup was performed. Therefore, pressure was not able to be compensated.
SVGN-215.remedy: Go to the Servo Gun General Setup screen, select Manual weight compen. Complete compensation formula.

SVGN-216.cause: The weight compensation value is too large. Therefore, pressure was not able to be compensated.
SVGN-216.remedy: Confirm the contents of the setup of the weight compensation function.

SVGN-217.cause: There is mistake in the setting of weight compensation function at pressure calibration.
SVGN-217.remedy: Confirm the weight compensation gun type of the Servo Gun General Setup screen Confirm the setting of tool coordinate system Execute pressure calibration again.

SVGN-218.cause: Because this command pressure was lower than the value of WT compensation press low lim of Servo Gun General Setup screen, this command pressure was not able to be compensated.
SVGN-218.remedy: Confirm the value of WT compn press low lim of the Servo Gun General Setup screen.

SVGN-219.cause: A set value of the angle is wrong.
SVGN-219.remedy: The interval between angle and angle at pressure calibration should be away by 70 degrees or more. Confirm the set value of the angle.

SVGN-220.cause: A set value is wrong. The calculated weight has become negative.
SVGN-220.remedy: The interval between angle and angle at pressure calibration should be away by 70 degrees or more. Confirm the set value of the angle. The pressure or the command pressure might be wrong. Confirm the set values of the pressure and the command pressure.

SVGN-221.cause: Incomplete semi-auto weight compensation setup has occurred. Therefore, the pressure was not able to be compensated.
SVGN-221.remedy: Go to the Servo Gun General Setup screen, and select the Semi-auto weight compensation. Complete semi-auto weight compensation setup.

SVGN-222.message: UT correct ang is out of range
SVGN-222.cause: The UT correct angle is out of range. Therefore, the position of the gun was not able to be calculated.
SVGN-222.remedy: Go to the Servo Gun General Setup screen. Set up the WT compen UT correct angle between 0 and 360.

SVGN-223.cause: Max disturbance torque exceeds the tolerance.

SVGN-224.cause: Average disturbance torque exceeds the tolerance.

SVGN-225.cause: Min disturbance torque exceeds the tolerance.

SVGN-230.cause: A mistake is found in the setting of the manual weight compensation. Therefore, pressure was not able to be compensated.
SVGN-230.remedy: Go to the Servo Gun General Setup screen, select Manual weight compen. Confirm the setting of the manual weight compensation function.

SVGN-231.remedy: The setting of the tool coordinate system is wrong. It is necessary to set the tool coordinate system to the servo gun tips of fixed side. Moreover, +Z tool coordinate axial direction should be the same as the gun open direction.

SVGN-232.cause: This gun cannot use the auto weight compensation type.
SVGN-232.remedy: Set the gun to another weight compensation type.

SVGN-233.cause: This gun cannot use the auto weight compensation type.
SVGN-233.remedy: Set the gun to another weight compensation type.

SVGN-234.cause: This message is posted if user presses F2(rec) fkey when prompt "Is tip on panel" is presented. SVGN-234 is merely a status message, it is not a problem.
SVGN-234.remedy: Set $SGSYSTCH.$LOG_FLAG=FALSE and/or $SGSYSTCH.$MAN_LOG_ENB=FALSE, if you do not wish to record touchup log.

SVGN-235.cause: User notification that touchup log already exists. This message is posted if F2(rec) fkey is pressed more than once, when tip on panel prompt is presented.

SVGN-236.cause: Program execution paused because position and/or thickness is out of tolerance. This pause occurs when DET/THK/POS error pause severity is set to warn or alarm, and one more of the following conditions exist: upper panel mis-detect: SVGN-240, thickness out of tolerance: SVGN-239, position out of tolerance: SVGN-237.
SVGN-236.remedy: Set Det/Thk/Pos error pause Sev in the gun teach setup screen to DISABLE if you do not want robot to pause when the alarms above occur.

SVGN-237.cause: Measured position error is greater than maximum allowable position error or less than min allowable position error.
SVGN-237.remedy: Increase maximum allowable position error or decrease min allowable position error, on gun teach setup screen. If problem persists, take the following actions: 1.Confirm the position error offset in the spot program touchup setup screen. This alarm might be generated immediately after the position error offset is changed. 2. Confirm the parameter to correct position for Xgun in the spot program touchup setup screen. This alarm might be generated immediately after the parameter to correct position for Xgun is changed. 3. Confirm the master position for the gun axis and make sure the tips touch at the zero. Position error correction might not be correctly calculated when the master position for the gun axis is not correct. 4. Confirm the tip wear amount is correct. Re-execute the tip wear measurement when the tip wear amount is not correct. 5. Re-execute the thickness check calibration.

SVGN-238.cause: Program execution paused because TCHDSB is attached to spot instruction, and SpotprogTouch_DSB pause severity = warn or alarm.
SVGN-238.remedy: If you do not want the robot to pause, either: a. set SpotProgTouch_Dsb pause Sev in the gun teach setup screen to DISABLE OR b. remove TCH_DSB from spot instruction.

SVGN-239.cause: Measured thickness is out of tolerance. Note: SVGN-242 Act thick:x.x, Nom thick: y.y is posted as cause code for SVGN-239.
SVGN-239.remedy: Confirm that: 1. actual panel thickness is correct. 2. nominal thickness in the pressure schedule is correct. 3. OverThickness and UnderThickness tolerance values on gun teach setup screen are appropriate

SVGN-240.cause: Upper panel detection distance is larger (gun more open) than max detect distance. where: max detect distance = pos.err.max + thk.nom + thk.err.max This alarm occurs only during program touchup (not point touchup). Note: SVGN-243 ActDetDist:x.x, MaxDetDist: y.y is posted as cause code for SVGN-240.
SVGN-240.remedy: Confirm that: 1. no obstruction exists between guntip and panel. 2. actual panel thickness is correct 3. nominal thickness in pressure schedule is correct. 4. OverThickness tolerance (on gun teach setup screen) is large enough. 5. Max allowable Pos error (on gun teach setup screen) is large enough.

SVGN-241.cause: Position error exceeds Max allowable pos error. SVGN-241 supplies the actual position error and maximum allowable position error for alarm SVGN-237.

SVGN-242.cause: Thickness error exceeds OverThickness tolerance or UnderThickness tolerance. SVGN-242 supplies the actual thickness and nominal thickness for SVGN-239.

SVGN-243.cause: Detect distance (observed) exceeds Max Detect distance. SVGN-243 supplies the actual detection distance and max detect distance for SVGN-240.

SVGN-244.cause: Thickness check calibration (0kgf)is incomplete. Thickness check calibration is required for touchup.
SVGN-244.remedy: Execute thickness check calibration on gun setup util.

SVGN-245.message: Gun not open to undeflect pos
SVGN-245.cause: Position register (PR) that stores undeflect (relax) position for gun/robot could not be set. Note that undeflect pos is starting point for thickness check, it removes deflection at lower panel detect end. Note that Refer to cause code for specific reason.
SVGN-245.remedy: Correct problem identified in cause code, and retry touchup.

SVGN-246.cause: Panel simulation is enabled, but machinelock is disabled on robot group or gun group. Machinelock must be ENABLED on both robot group and gun group, when panel simulation is enabled.
SVGN-246.remedy: Disable panel simulation($SGSYSTCH.$SIM_PNL_ENB=FALSE) or ENABLE machinelock on robot group and gun group.

SVGN-247.cause: Touchup is already in progress on an arm and touchup is being requested on another arm (at the same time). Touchup can only be performed on one arm at a time.
SVGN-247.remedy: Wait for touchup operation that is already in progress to complete, before starting touchup on another arm.

SVGN-248.cause: Upper or lower panel search ended, but panel was not detected. I.E. gun speed never fell below speed threshold, during search. The following conditions can cause this problem: 1. missing panel 2. large gun friction 3. large pressure margin
SVGN-248.remedy: 1. ensure that panel is present. 2. increase $sggun#.$teach.$pnldflctdst. 3. decrease pressure margin. If problem persists, contact a FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

SVGN-249.cause: Panel was not detected during second part of upper panel search. Internal condition for search termination was not met. This can occur if panel is soft.

SVGN-250.cause: A tp program started (or resumed) and spot program touchup function is enabled with execution mode = TOUCHUP. Touchup mode means that points will be evaluated AND positions will be modified.
SVGN-250.remedy: If verify (not touchup) mode is desired, change execution mode via Touchup setup screen: a. if tp is disabled, set Execution mode for AUTO = VERIFY mode, b. if tp is enabled, set Execution mode for TEACH = VERIFY mode, If normal spot (not touchup or verify) operation is desired, disable program touchup via: a. DIN, if tp is enabled. b. Touchup mode setup screen, if tp is disabled.

SVGN-251.cause: Position error (change between observed position and recorded position) is less than MinPosError. This message is posted to display magnitude of observed position error and minimum pos error, when SVGN-237 occurs. Note that min pos error is used in conjunction with max pos error to control when points are touched up. Points are only touched up if position error is greater than or equal to min pos error and less than or equal to max pos error. Min pos error tolerance identifies when position change is small and/or insignificant.
SVGN-251.remedy: If position error is acceptable, decrease min pos error and execute touchup again. Set min pos error = 0.0, to disable min pos error check completely.

SVGN-252.cause: Upper panel detection failed. The integer parameter ()identifies the failure type: type1: gun tip did not contact panel during search motion (internal condition to terminate search was not met). type2: exact position of detection could not be found (no distinct transition in the data)
SVGN-252.remedy: Confirm that: 1. no obstruction exists between guntip and panel. 2. actual panel thickness is correct 3. nominal thickness in pressure schedule is correct. 4. Over thickness tolerance (on gun teach setup screen) is large enough. 5. Max allowable pos error (on gun teach setup screen) is large enough.

SVGN-254.cause: Measured thickness was too large at lower panel detection.
SVGN-254.remedy: Confirm that: 1. no obstruction exists between panel and either tip, 2. actual panel thickness is correct, 3. nominal thickness in pressure schedule is correct.

SVGN-255.cause: Detection data for the second upper panel search is invalid.
SVGN-255.remedy: Retry spot program touchup. Confirm that gun tip contacts panel at upper panel detection. If this problem persists after taking the above actions, perform the following actions: 1. Acquire the diagnostic data. See the procedure for diagnostic data collection at Troubleshooting section. 2. Contact a FANUC technical representative.

SVGN-256.cause: Register specified for SPTCH_OFS or SPTCH_RSD is invalid. Note: SPTCH_OFS is attached to spot instruction to specify offset/adjustment value that is added to final offset for point modification. SPTCH_RSD is attached to spot instruction to specify offset distance for robot tip.
SVGN-256.remedy: Set a valid parameter for the instruction: 1. SPTCH_OFS: Greater than -2.0mm and less than 2.0mm 2. SPTCH_RSD: greater than or equal to 0.0mm and less than or equal to 20.0mm

SVGN-257.cause: Register specified for SPTCH_OFS or SPTCH_RSD is invalid.
SVGN-257.remedy: Specify a valid register number in SPTCH_OFS or SPTCH_RSD instruction: min: 1 max: posreg max (position registers item, on program limits setup screen)

SVGN-258.cause: Initial touchup attempt failed, but retries are enabled, and touchup will be attempted again.
SVGN-258.remedy: This message is provided for information purposes only. Note Set the maximum retry number = 0 on the gun teach setup screen to disable retries.

SVGN-259.cause: Initial touchup attempt and retries failed.
SVGN-259.remedy: Examine log and determine reason for failure.

SVGN-260.cause: Upper panel detection failed. Robot motion stopped before gun tip touched panel. Data for the detection is invalid.

SVGN-261.cause: Gun torque command is erratic. This gun may have mechanical issues.
SVGN-261.remedy: Examine the servo gun. Confirm that there is no actuator damage or binding. If gun is ok, retry touchup function.

SVGN-262.cause: Gun torque command is erratic. This gun may have mechanical issues.
SVGN-262.remedy: Examine the servo gun. Confirm that there is no actuator damage or binding. If gun is ok, retry touchup function.

SVGN-263.message: Variation in disturbance is too much.
SVGN-263.cause: Gun torque command is erratic. This gun may have mechanical issues.
SVGN-263.remedy: Examine the servo gun. Confirm that there is no actuator damage or binding. If gun is ok, retry touchup function.

SVGN-264.message: Variation in disturbance is too much.
SVGN-264.cause: Gun torque command is erratic. This gun may have mechanical issues.
SVGN-264.remedy: Examine the servo gun. Confirm that there is no actuator damage or binding. If gun is ok, retry touchup function.

SVGN-265.cause: Mechanical calibration for point/program touchup function completed successfully.
SVGN-265.remedy: This is a status message for informational purposes.

SVGN-266.cause: This message shows the compensation value for point/program touchup function. Value in () means Num of Successful calibration / Specified Num of calibrations.
SVGN-266.remedy: This is a status message for informational purposes.

SVGN-267.cause: Mechanical calibration for point/program touchup function failed.

SVGN-268.cause: This message identifies cause of gun mechanical compensation (calibration) failure. It is posted, along with SVGN-267. input data is invalid - parameter specified in SGKTCHCL() is invalid. The remedy depends on the parameter (p1-p5) that is identified: Invalid gun number. Specify Gun number between 1 and $SGSYSCFG.$GUN_NUM Invalid thickness: Specify thickness value greater than or equal to 1.0 Invalid Gun Open Distance: Specified gun tip open distance is not invalid. Invalid Robot Open Distance: Specified robot tip open distance is not invalid. Invalid Num of Calib: Calibration iterations (number) is invalid. Minimum=1 Check system status:Calibration cannot proceed due to system error or illegal condition. - Any alarm occur, and/or HOLD is turn on - Enable single step and/or machine lock - Disable gun stroke (mode) - Spot program touchup disabled ALL Calib. NOT SUCCESS: Calibration failed due to one of the following: - Alarm or HOLD occurs during calibration. - Misdetect error - Thickness out of tolerance - Position out of tolerance
SVGN-268.remedy: Invalid gun number. Correct gun number between 1 and $SGSYSCFG.$GUN_NUM Invalid thickness: Corrct thickness value greater than or equal to 1.0 Invalid Gun Open Distance: Correct gun tip open distance. Invalid Robot Open Distance: Correct robot tip open distance. Invalid Num of Calib: Correct calibration iterations (number) Check system status:Calibration cannot proceed due to system error or illegal condition. - Rest nny alarm occur, and/or HOLD. - Disable single step and/or machine lock - Enable gun stroke (mode) - Enable Spot program touchup ALL Calib. NOT SUCCESS: Calibration failed due to one of the following: - Reset alarm or HOLD. - Identify cause of misdetect error - Correct thickness for fixture - Correct position for fixture

SVGN-269.cause: This indicates spot program touchup is disabled.
SVGN-269.remedy: Enable spot program touchup via TEST CYCLE or CELL INTERFACE I/O

SVGN-270.cause: Gun tip contacted upper panel surface before search motion started. Torque limit became unexpectedly-large during upper panel detection step1.
SVGN-270.remedy: Confirm that distance of gun panel contact is not larger than search start distance. Retry spot program touchup. If gun tip contacts upper panel surface before search start distance, increase start distance(SD) for gun tip. If this problem persists after taking the above actions, perform the following actions: 1. Acquire diagnostic data. See the procedure for diagnostic data collection at Troubleshooting section. 2. Contact a FANUC technical representative.

SVGN-271.cause: Robot tip contacted lower panel surface before search motion started. Torque limit became unexpectedly-large during lower panel detection.
SVGN-271.remedy: Confirm that distance of panel contact is not larger than search start distance. Retry spot program touchup. If robot tip contacts lower panel surface before search start distance, increase start distance(SD) for robot tip and/or lower panel detection distance. Refer to Chapter "20.6 LOWER PANEL DETECTION DISTANCE CLAMP" or "20.13 SPTCH_RSD INSTRUCTION" for more information about the lower panel detection distance If this problem persists after taking the above actions, perform the following actions: 1. Acquire diagnostic data. See the procedure for diagnostic data collection at Troubleshooting section. 2. Contact a FANUC technical representative.

SVGN-272.message: Lower Det start pos was wrong.
SVGN-272.cause: Open distance of a gun axis was too short at start position of lower panel detection.
SVGN-272.remedy: Confirm that robot tip has enough clearance from panel surface at start position. If distance between robot tip and panel is too short, increase start distance(SD) for robot tip an/or lower panel detection distance. Refer to Chapter "20.6 LOWER PANEL DETECTION DISTANCE CLAMP" or "20.13 SPTCH_RSD INSTRUCTION" for more information about the lower panel detection distance. Retry spot program touchup. If this problem persists after taking the above actions, perform the following actions: 1. Acquire the diagnostic data. See the procedure for diagnostic data collection at Troubleshooting section. 2. Contact a FANUC technical representative.

SVGN-273.cause: A gun tip was contacted an upper panel surface on a free running section before search motion.
SVGN-273.remedy: R:1 means that error occurred during upper panel detection. Confirm that gun tip has enough clearance from upper panel surface at start position.If distance between the tip and the panel is too short, increase start distance(SD) for gun tip. R:3 means that error occurred during lower panel detection. Confirm that robot tip has enough clearance from panel surface at start position and that there is no obstacle between the panel and the robot tip at start position. If distance between the tip and the panel is too short, increase start distance(SD) for robot tip and/or lower panel detection distance. Refer to Chapter “20.6 LOWER PANEL DETECTION DISTANCE CLAMP” or “20.13 SPTCH_RSD INSTRUCTION” in OPERATOR’S MANUAL of Servo Gun Function for more information about the lower panel detection distance. Retry spot program touchup. If this problem persists after taking the above actions, perform the following actions: 1. Acquire diagnostic data. See the procedure for diagnostic data collection at Troubleshooting section. 2. Contact a FANUC technical representative. Note: This alarm is posted when the time to execute phases2,3 take longer than anticipated, during upper1 detection and lower detection. R: Request number. R:1 is upper1 detection. R:3 is lower detection. P: Phase number. P:2 is phase of acceleration. P3: is phase to collect data to calculate threshold. If the tip touch panel during above phase, this alarm is posted. Please check whether the tip touch panel or the gun is closed(or grabbed panel) at position of search start.

SVGN-274.cause: Threshold to detect panel contact became unexpectedly-low.
SVGN-274.remedy: If gun tip contacted panel surface at start position, increase start distance(SD) for gun tip. If robot tip contacted lower panel surface at start position, increase start distance(SD) for robot tip and/or lower panel detection distance. Refer to Chapter "20.6 LOWER PANEL DETECTION DISTANCE CLAMP" or "20.13 SPTCH_RSD INSTRUCTION" for more information about the lower panel detection distance. Retry spot program touchup. If this problem persists after taking the above actions, perform the following actions: 1. Acquire the diagnostic data. See the procedure for diagnostic data collection at Troubleshooting section. 2. Contact a FANUC technical representative.

SVGN-275.cause: Search start distance was clamped due to gun open limit. SVGN-275 is posted as cause code for SVGN-190. Actual search start distance is displayed, along with desired (unclamped) search start distance.

SVGN-276.cause: Search mode was not selected. Therefore, position detection was not done.

SVGN-277.cause: Gun open deistance required for normalization search is larger than open limit. Normalization process aborts because of this condition.
SVGN-277.remedy: Initiate normalization process with smaller gun open distance or increase gun open limit (if possible).

SVGN-278.cause: Axis speed will be varied during search motion. So counter-measure is turned ENABLE automatically.
SVGN-278.remedy: If the gun has no abnormality, there is no remedy.

SVGN-279.cause: Axis speed will be varied during search motion. So counter-measure is used automatically.
SVGN-279.remedy: If the gun has no abnormality, there is no remedy. Turn Use averaging speed OFF/ON manually if you want to disable this message.

SVGN-280.cause: Wear down amount of gun side is exceeded to max compensation tolerance. Cap tip may be worn out and/or shank may be shorter than original length. Gun axis will run over away mechanical stroke limit and gun tip would interfere object/panel if gun tip clearance is small.
SVGN-280.remedy: Change tip to new tip. If shank is shorter than original length, change to new shank

SVGN-281.cause: Wear down amount of robot side is exceeded to max compensation tolerance. Cap tip may be worn out and/or shank may be shorter than original length. Gun axis will run over away mechanical stroke limit. And gun tip and robot would interfere object/panel if tip clearance is small.
SVGN-281.remedy: Change tip to new tip. If shank is shorter than original length, change to new shank.

SVGN-282.cause: Wear ratio was updated. Displayed value means old wear ratio -> new wear ratio.
SVGN-282.remedy: This is just information. There is no remedy.

SVGN-283.cause: Wear ratio was updated. (However wear down was updated) System can not calcarate when tips are not WORN.DOWN(= cap tip is increased). There are some causes - Cap has been replaced. But new tip flag is OFF - Cap wear has been hardly changing. Wear ratio could not be updated in too short cycle See SVGN-284 to confirm wear down changing.
SVGN-283.remedy: Turn on new tip when tip is replaced in next time. Also Perform 2step after tip dressing several times

SVGN-284.cause: This indicates wear down changing: The last 2step wear down -> Current 2step wear down If The last 2step wear down is larger than current 2step wear down, tip would be replaced If cap wear has been hardly changing, 2 step is performed with too short cycle
SVGN-284.remedy: Turn on new tip when tip is replaced in next time. Also Perform 2step after tip dressing several times.

SVGN-285.cause: This indicates calculated wear down is exceeded user's tolerance - Cap has been replaced. But new tip flag is OFF - Cap wear has been hardly changing. Wear ratio could not be updated in too short cycle
SVGN-285.remedy: Turn on new tip when tip is replaced in next time. Also Perform 2 step after tip dressing several times. User's tolerance can be changed in TWD setup screen

SVGN-286.cause: This indicates calcurated wear down and user's tolerance(Max)

SVGN-287.cause: This indicates calcurated wear down and user's tolerance(Max)

SVGN-288.cause: 1step performed with new tip flag. Do not perform 1step with new tip falg when auto update wear ratio is enable.
SVGN-288.remedy: Perform 2step with new tip falg agin.

SVGN-289.cause: Wear ratio has not been updated for long time.

SVGN-290.cause: There is mistake in the setting at pressure calibration

SVGN-291.cause: Temperature compensation value is too large. Therefore, pressure was not able to be compensated.
SVGN-291.remedy: Confirm the content of the setup of temperature compensation function.

SVGN-292.cause: Invalid AI,GI conversion factor setting is not correct.
SVGN-292.remedy: Confirm the AI,GI conversion factor setting.

SVGN-293.message: Temp info from motor isn't obtained:G%d
SVGN-293.cause: Temperature information cannot be obtained from this pulse corder.
SVGN-293.remedy: Examine the figure number for the pulse corder. Examine whether the pulse coda is breakdown.

SVGN-294.cause: Temperature exceeded abnormal motor temperature upper limit value.
SVGN-294.remedy: Confirm the temperature sensor is not out of order.

SVGN-295.cause: Temperature fell below abnormal motor temperature lower limit value.
SVGN-295.remedy: Confirm the temperature sensor is not out of order.

SVGN-296.cause: Temperature coefficient setting is not correct.

SVGN-297.message: Temp info from AI isn't obtained:G%d
SVGN-297.cause: Temperature information cannot be obtained from AI

SVGN-298.message: Temp info from GI isn't obtained:G%d
SVGN-298.cause: Temperature information cannot be obtained from GI

SVGN-299.cause: Instruction for which invalid thickness was specified was executed.
SVGN-299.remedy: Confirm the thickness in the instruction.

SVGN-300.cause: Program is paused when gun is closing with early welding. Early welding is disabled for resumed gun closing.
SVGN-300.remedy: This is just warning massage. Early welding is disabled for the only resumed gun closing. In next spot line, early welding is eanbled again. And, if program is executed with BWD, early welding is enabled for the SPOT.

SVGN-301.cause: Early weld calibration is incomplete. Early welding can not be enabled.
SVGN-301.remedy: Execute early weld calibration on gun setup utiltiy screen.

SVGN-302.cause: When pressure did not reach target pressure, weld init would asserted in pressure shortage.
SVGN-302.remedy: Please refer to remedy of SVGN-020 Also, Execute early weld calibration again.

SVGN-303.cause: in pressure of dual gun, either gun disable early welding. Weld init will assert when pressure of gun that disables early welding rearches target pressure.
SVGN-303.remedy: Enable/Disable early welding for both gun.

SVGN-304.cause: Invalid early welding time was specified. Early welding time is too large
SVGN-304.remedy: Correct early welding time. Early welding time can not larger than torque up time of gun

SVGN-305.cause: General override is not 100%. Early welding time can work correctly with OVR 100%

SVGN-306.remedy: This is just a message. It's no remedy.

SVGN-314.message: Thickness%d not read, deflect cal incomp
SVGN-314.cause: Thickness could not be read because deflection calibration is incomplete. Number after thickness refers to type of thickness that could not be read 1=before weld, 2=after weld.
SVGN-314.remedy: Perform deflection calibration or disable thickness read ($RDTHK_ENB=TRUE).

SVGN-315.message: Torque value not in deflect cal table.
SVGN-315.cause: Torque value for current pressure is not in deflection calibration table - deflection value is obtained via interpolation. Accuracy of deflection estimate may improve if deflection is performed again.
SVGN-315.remedy: 1. Go to pressure calibration screen and add present pressure to pressure calibration table (if it is not there already). 2. Set pressure calibration to complete. 3. perform deflection calibration. OR disable this alarm(SVGN-315), by setting $SGCFG[].$DFLINTRPALM=0

SVGN-320.cause: Thickness error has occurred and operator attention is required.
SVGN-320.remedy: Refer to cause and remedy of thickness error. Note that this alarm is posted AFTER gun has opened. Actual thickness error is posted BEFORE gun open, when thickness error is detected.

SVGN-321.cause: Expected change in thickness (decrease) was NOT observed.

SVGN-322.cause: Observed thickness decrease and minimum thickness decrease are presented.
SVGN-322.remedy: None. This alarm is for informational purposes only.

SVGN-323.cause: Observed thickness decrease and maximum thickness decrease are presented.
SVGN-323.remedy: None. This alarm is for informational purposes only.

SVGN-324.cause: Thickness measured (#.#) after weld was within tolerance.
SVGN-324.remedy: None. This alarm is for informational purposes only.

SVGN-325.cause: Thickness change from before weld to after weld (#.#) is provided. Note: Thickness decrease is displayed as a positive value.
SVGN-325.remedy: None. This alarm is for informational purposes only.

SVGN-326.cause: Thickness error has occurred and operator attention is required.
SVGN-326.remedy: Refer to cause and remedy of thickness error. Note that this alarm is posted AFTER gun has opened. Actual thickness error is posted BEFORE gun open, when thickness error is detected.

SVGN-327.cause: Measured thickness is within tolerance (ok). This warning is posted for information purposes only.
SVGN-327.remedy: Disable thickness ok message to suppress this warning.

SVGN-328.cause: Measured thickness before weld was smaller than nominal thickness + under thickness limit. Note that this alarm is posted as cause code for SVGN-193. SVGN-193 and SVGN-270 are posted after gun opens to SD.
SVGN-328.remedy: 1. Confirm that panel is ok, and that robot is at correct location on panel. 2. Confirm that nominal thickness is correct. 3. Confirm that underthickness limit is large enough to accomodate normal panel variation and measurement error.

SVGN-329.cause: Measured thickness before weld was larger than nominal thickness + over thickness limit. Note that this alarm is posted as cause code for SVGN-193. SVGN-193 and SVGN-271 are posted after gun opens to SD.
SVGN-329.remedy: 1. Confirm that panel is ok, and that robot is at correct location on panel. 2. Confirm that nominal thickness is correct. 3. Confirm that overthickness limit is large enough to accomodate normal panel variation and measurement error.

SVGN-330.cause: Difference between thickness measured before and after weld was smaller than Setdown tolerance min(mm). I.E. thickness decrease was smaller than expected. Note that this alarm is posted as cause code for SVGN-199. SVGN-199 and SVGN-272 are posted after gun opens to SD.
SVGN-330.remedy: 1. Confirm that weld settings are ok. 2. Confirm that Setdown tolerance min(mm) is not too large.

SVGN-331.cause: Difference between thickness measured before and after weld was larger larger than Setdown tolerance max(mm). I.E. thickness decrease was larger than expected. Note that this alarm is posted as cause code for SVGN-199. SVGN-199 and SVGN-273 are posted after gun opens to SD.
SVGN-331.remedy: 1. Confirm that weld settings are ok. 2. Confirm that Setdown tolerance max(mm) is not too small.

SVGN-333.cause: This alarm is posted if [sgprscfg]sho_thr_inf = TRUE. The alarm provides torque command (fcmd_trq) and close threshold(p183) values.
SVGN-333.remedy: None. This alarm is posted to provide feedback on gun control parameters, during close stroke. Set [sgprscfg]sho_thr_inf = FALSE, to disable this alarm.

SVGN-334.cause: This alarm is posted if [sgprscfg]sho_pos_inf = TRUE. The alarm provides feedback on gun open distance, for following events: a. force control command status($fctrl) changes from false to TRUE b. thickness (distance) is reached c. force control enable status ($fcenb) changes from false to TRUE
SVGN-334.remedy: None. This alarm is posted to provide feedback on gun control parameters, during close stroke. Set [sgprscfg]sho_pos_inf = FALSE, to disable this alarm.

SVGN-335.cause: This alarm is posted if [sgprscfg]sho_pos_inf = TRUE. The alarm provides feedback on gun disturbance torque, for following events: a. force control command status($fctrl) changes from false to TRUE b. thickness (distance) is reached c. force control enable status ($fcenb) changes from false to TRUE
SVGN-335.remedy: None. This alarm is posted to provide feedback on gun control parameters, during close stroke. Set [sgprscfg]sho_pos_inf = FALSE, to disable this alarm.

SVGN-336.cause: This alarm is posted if [sgprscfg]sho_thr_lo = TRUE AND [sgprscfg]wt4cls2thk==TRUE AND disturbance torque exceeds thrsh, before gun has closed to panel thickness
SVGN-336.remedy: None. This alarm is posted to provide feedback on gun control parameters, during close stroke. Set [sgprscfg]sho_thr_lo = FALSE, to disable this alarm.

SVGN-337.cause: This alarm is posted if $sggun#.$setup.tc_okmsg=TRUE (thickness check ok). The alarm provides feedback on thickness setpoint for this spot, along with thickness check tolerances.
SVGN-337.remedy: None. This alarm is posted to provide feedback on gun control parameters, during close stroke. Set $sggun#.$setup.tc_okmsg=FALSE, to disable this alarm.

SVGN-338.remedy: Specify thickness value in SPOT (or PRESS_MOTN) instruction.

SVGN-340.cause: Spot program touchup function could not modify program position, because file is write-protected.

SVGN-341.cause: Spot program touchup has been enabled with execution mode = TOUCHUP mode during spot instruction execution, so spot program touchup will not start until next spot. Conditions leading to this message: 1. Start program with spot program touchup disabled 2. Pause program during execution of spot instruction 3. Enable spot program touchup (in TOUCHUP mode) 4. Resume (continue) program
SVGN-341.remedy: Note: purpose of this warning is operator notification, this is not a fault condition. In order to execute program touchup immediately, either execute shift backward (to restart spot) or abort program.

SVGN-342.cause: A tp program started (or resumed) and spot program touchup function is enabled with execution mode = VERIFY. Verify mode means that points will be evaluated but positions will NOT be modified.
SVGN-342.remedy: If touchup (not verify) mode is desired, change execution mode via Touchup setup screen: a. if tp is disabled, set Execution mode for AUTO = TOUCHUP mode, b. if tp is enabled, set Execution mode for TEACH = TOUCHUP mode, If normal spot (not touchup or verify) operation is desired, disable program touchup via: a. DIN, if tp is enabled. b. Touchup mode setup screen, if tp is disabled.

SVGN-343.cause: Spot program touchup has been enabled in VERIFY mode during spot instruction execution, so spot program touchup will not start until next spot. Conditions leading to this case are: 1. Start program with spot program touchup disabled 2. Pause program during execution of spot instruction 3. Enable spot program touchup (in VERIFY mode) 4. Resume (continue) program
SVGN-343.remedy: Note: purpose of this warning is operator notification, this is not a fault condition. In order to execute program touchup immediately, either execute shift backward (to restart spot) or abort program.

SVGN-344.cause: Touchup was requested with torque control type 2, but torque calibration is incomplete.
SVGN-344.remedy: Complete touchup torque calibration or change $sggun#.$tchup.$updt_tq_typ=1 and $sggun#.$tchup.$updt_tq_typ=1

SVGN-345.cause: Group mask could not read from specified program(). Refer to cause code (SVGN-347) for reason.
SVGN-345.remedy: Lookup error code for SVGN-347 and take appropriate action.

SVGN-346.cause: Group mask could not be written to specified program(). Refer to cause code (SVGN-347) for reason.
SVGN-346.remedy: Lookup error code for SVGN-347 and take appropriate action.

SVGN-347.cause: SVGN application alarm has occurred. This message merely reports the status (error) number that caused this problem.
SVGN-347.remedy: Lookup error code and take appropriate action.

SVGN-348.cause: considered to be detection failure (missing panel). However, in case of very soft gun and thin panel, gun position may be past point of closure (0). Increase $sggun#.$teach.$pnldflctdst for this case. However, if panel is not thin/soft and/or gun is rigid, this increase can lead to detection in absence of panel. This message is merely posted to warn of this possibility.
SVGN-348.remedy: Set panel deflect distance to 0, if panel and or gun are rigid. note: defauult setting of $pnldflctdst is 0.

SVGN-349.remedy: Refer to the error cause code.

SVGN-350.cause: Fault occurred or shift key was released while pressure release progress was active.
SVGN-350.remedy: Correct reason for fault and/or do not release shift key during pressure release.

SVGN-351.cause: Norm search input DIN is invalid.
SVGN-351.remedy: Map norm search input to a valid input index via $SGNRMCFG[].$PNLDETDITYP and $SGNRMCFG[].$PNLDETDIIDX.

SVGN-352.cause: Torque limit control is NOT equal to static type2, which provides best performance for normalization function.
SVGN-352.remedy: Go to torque limit control in teach setup screen. Select Static torque control type 2, and perform calibration

SVGN-353.cause: Gun open distance should be identical for vx.midpt and vy.midpt. Present difference exceeds tolerance, so one or more of the testpoints may be incorrect. Refer to manual for graphical explanation of this alarm.
SVGN-353.remedy: Confirm that detection result is correct. Redo tqlimit calibration if misdetection occurred.

SVGN-354.cause: Gun open distance @vx.midpt should be same as pt0. Present difference exceeds tolerance, so one or more of the testpoints may be incorrect. Refer to manual for graphical explanation of this alarm.
SVGN-354.remedy: Confirm that detection result is correct. Redo tqlimit calibration if misdetection occurred.

SVGN-355.cause: Present difference exceeds tolerance, so one or more of the testpoints may be incorrect. Refer to manual for graphical explanation of this alarm.
SVGN-355.remedy: Confirm that detection result is correct. Redo tqlimit calibration if misdetection occurred.

SVGN-356.cause: Panel detection occurred sooner than expected (see orange block in search segment drawing in manual). This means that max rotation error is too small for the rotation error that actually exists in the path. Panel misdetection can also cause this alarm.
SVGN-356.remedy: Confirm that detection result is correct. Redo tqlimit calibration if misdetection occurred.

SVGN-357.cause: Rotation change: org angle to normalized angle.
SVGN-357.remedy: Status message - no corrective action required.

SVGN-358.cause: X,Y coordinate change: org pos to normalized pos.
SVGN-358.remedy: Status message - no corrective action required.

SVGN-359.cause: B4nrmprgenb = TRUE and B4NRMPRGNM does not exist or is invalid.
SVGN-359.remedy: Set B4nrmprgenb = TRUE or create valid program with specified name.

SVGN-360.cause: AFnrmprgenb = TRUE and AFNRMPRGNM does not exist or is invalid.
SVGN-360.remedy: Set AFnrmprgenb = TRUE or create valid program with specified name.

SVGN-361.cause: Popup template files could not be found, and/or could not be displayed, so norm popup feature was disabled. Note that this message is posted at power-up only (one time).

SVGN-362.cause: Normalization process did not not complete. Refer to cause code for reason.
SVGN-362.remedy: Take appropriate action for this cause code.

SVGN-363.cause: Robot close is not set to x,y or z. I.E. it is set to fix or an invalid direction.
SVGN-363.remedy: set robot clos direction to appropriate direction: +/-x, +/-y or +/-Z

SVGN-364.cause: Gun is not set to x,y or z OR it is set to the same direction as robot close direction.
SVGN-364.remedy: set gun out direction to appropriate direction: +/-x, +/-y or +/-Z

SVGN-370.cause: Gun tip contacted panel sooner than expected - either settings are incorrect or wrong panel is present. If correct panel is present, then confirm that following items are correct: 1. Thickness value. 2. Gun Zero Master position. 3. Gear ratio (tip displacement).
SVGN-370.remedy: 1. If thickness is incorrect, set proper thickness value in spot/pres_motn instruction. 2. If gun zero master is incorrect, go to servogun master screen and execute master or automaster. 3. If gear ratio is incorrect, go to gun setup util and set gun specs.

SVGN-371.remedy: Record error and report to hotline.

SVGN-372.cause: This value has not been specified in tp instruction.
SVGN-372.remedy: Use measure thickness value to measure and enter thickness value automatically. Alternatively, enter thickness value directly, via tp editor.

SVGN-373.cause: Gun is pressuring (closed past 0). Auto tune can not start because pressure control is active.
SVGN-373.remedy: Jog gun open, to release pressure, then restart autotuning.

SVGN-374.cause: 1 step measurement was performed with new tip. Wear ratio updating is loacked.
SVGN-374.remedy: To update wear ratio, 2 step measurement must be performed with new tip. This locking is released by 2 step measurment. SVGN-288 is posted as cause code,it needs twice 2 step measurement with currenct tip to update wear ratio SVGN-375 is posted as cause code, next 2 step measurement update wear ratio

SVGN-375.cause: 2 step measurement was performed after 1 step measurement has been performed with new tip.

SVGN-376.remedy: Repower, go to control start, and then back to cold start. This action re-generates the internal servogun program and may correct the problem. Record the error and report to hotline, if the problem persists.

SVGN-377.cause: Number of lines in ~svg is different than expected - program may be corrupt.
SVGN-377.remedy: Cold start and confirm that SVGN-377 is not posted again. If problem persists, contact your FANUC technical representative.

SVGN-378.cause: Thickness measurement process started, but did not complete. Completion may be due to a measurement error or program pause, during measurement.
SVGN-378.remedy: Identify specific cause of measurement failure, correct it, and execute thickness measurement again.

SVGN-379.cause: Shift hardkey was pressed (to change manual pressure) but all values in thickness table are uninitialized.
SVGN-379.remedy: Set one (or more) values into the thickness table.

SVGN-380.cause: Shift+Gun hardkey was pressed (to execute manual pressure operation) but thickness index and/or thickness value are invalid.
SVGN-380.remedy: Set one (or more) values into the thickness table and select a valid thickness by pressing Gun hardkey.

SVGN-381.cause: This message is posted because thickness measurement was performed, and $SGCFG[].$THKMESCFG.$ALM4MESINFO = TRUE. This message merely provides a record of thickness measurment in the alarm log. It is not a fault/abnormal condition. Note: SVGN-176 is provided as cause code for this message to identify origin of thickness measurement request: Editor, Manual weld screen, thickness table screen, or Pressure Calibration screen.
SVGN-381.remedy: Set $SGCFG[].$THKMESCFG.$ALM4MESINFO = FALSE to disable this message.

SVGN-382.message: Tip could not contact with specified speed
SVGN-382.cause: Panel contact speed specified in pressure calibration table was not met. A slight amount of pressure error can occur because of this contact speed error. Root cause of contact speed error is insufficient gun open distance before pressure. The specific conditions that can cause this error are: • Overly low distance in SD value • Incorrect fixed tip position (taught position) • Incorrect mastering position • Incorrect thickness value
SVGN-382.remedy: Confirm gun open distance, before pressure. Also, confirm fixed tip location, gun mastering, and thickness. Note: this warning can be ignored if panel does not vibrate, and weld quality is ok.

SVGN-383.cause: When extra groups are used in a robot+servogun program, motion of an extra group was detected during SPOT motion.

SVGN-384.message: Normalization supports UT frame type only.
SVGN-384.cause: Normalization is NOT supported for UF (pedestal) gun type.
SVGN-384.remedy: Change frame type to UT if possible.

SVGN-385.cause: Spot program touchup mode had become ENABLE immediately before spot instruction is executed.
SVGN-385.remedy: Make the spot program touchup mode ENABLE earlier.

SVGN-386.cause: Requested robot backup distance cannot be provided, due to gun open limit. Actual robot backup provided is noted in the alarm.
SVGN-386.remedy: 1. Increase gun open limit if possible. 2. Reduce robot backup distance.

SVGN-387.message: Increase sglogarr size to log data.
SVGN-387.cause: Tune log and/or press log are enabled, but sglogarr size <= 1. Tune log and press log data files are created only if sglogarr size > 1.

SVGN-388.cause: Variation in speed during observation period (before detection), is larger than speed variation observed during calibration. Number at end of message indicates phase. 1=Upper panel detection, 2=Lower panel detection. Root causes are: 1. Gun mechanical characteristics have changed or calibration is not up to date. 2. Current orientation is different than orientation used during calibration. 3. Open distance for current panel detection is greater than open distance used during calibration.
SVGN-388.remedy: 1. Redo calibration. 2. if problem persists, increase value of $SGSYSTCH.$P0SPDALMMGN.

SVGN-389.cause: Torque required for current search is larger than torque limit that was required to close gun during panel detection calibration. Number at end of message indicates phase: 1=Upper panel detection, 2=Lower panel detection. Root causes are: 1. Gun mechanical characteristics have changed or calibration is not up to date. 2. Current orientation is different than orientation used during calibration. 3. Open distance at panel detection is greater than open distance used during calibration.
SVGN-389.remedy: 1. Redo calibration. 2. if problem persists, increase value of $SGSYSTCH.$P0TRQALMMGN.

SVGN-390.message: Gun mode change detected while welding
SVGN-390.cause: Stroke/No Stroke mode might have been changed while executing spot welding program.
SVGN-390.remedy: To prevent spot welding point being skipped, the robot paused. Confirm Stroke/No Stroke mode.

SVGN-391.cause: Torque conversion factor cannot be calculated because divide-by-zero is occurred.
SVGN-391.remedy: Confirm the gear ratio of servo gun.

SVGN-392.cause: This TWD program is for R-J3iB. R-30iB does not supported this.
SVGN-392.remedy: Replace TW***.TP to TWK***.PC like the following. Refer to servo gun function manual document.

SVGN-393.cause: Panel detection calibration has started. Note that detection calibration occurs during autotuning, and also when user invokes it on detection calibration screen.
SVGN-393.remedy: This message is provided for informational purposes only, it is not a problem.

SVGN-394.remedy: This message is provided for informational purposes only, it is not a problem.

SVGN-395.cause: Automatic zero calibration has started. Note that detection calibration occurs during autotuning, and also when user invokes it on gun master screen.
SVGN-395.remedy: This message is provided for informational purposes only, it is not a problem.

SVGN-396.cause: Automatic zero calibration process has ended.
SVGN-396.remedy: This message is provided for informational purposes only, it is not a problem.

SVGN-397.cause: Thickness check calibration has started. Note that thickness check calibration occurs during autotuning, and also when user invokes it on gun setup util screen.
SVGN-397.remedy: This message is provided for informational purposes only, it is not a problem.

SVGN-398.cause: Thickness check calibration process has ended.
SVGN-398.remedy: This message is provided for informational purposes only, it is not a problem.

SVGN-399.cause: This alarm merely provides additional information for SVGN-274 alarm. Min speed and max speed specify speed range observed during panel detection preparation.

SVGN-400.cause: A tp program started (or resumed) and spot program touchup function is enabled with execution mode = TCHUP + WELD. This means that points will be touched up, and then spot will execute.
SVGN-400.remedy: If touchup (not verify) mode is desired, change execution mode via Touchup setup screen: a. if tp is disabled, set Execution mode for AUTO = TOUCHUP mode, b. if tp is enabled, set Execution mode for TEACH = TOUCHUP mode, If normal spot (not touchup or verify) operation is desired, disable program touchup via: a. DIN, if tp is enabled. b. Touchup mode setup screen, if tp is disabled.

SVGN-401.cause: Spot program touchup has been enabled in TCHUP + WELD mode during spot instruction execution, so touchup process will not begin until next spot. Conditions leading to this case are: 1. Start program with spot program touchup disabled 2. Pause program during execution of spot instruction 3. Enable spot program touchup (in TCHUP + WELD mode) 4. Resume (continue) program
SVGN-401.remedy: Note: purpose of this warning is operator notification, this is not a fault condition. In order to execute touchup immediately, either execute shift backward (to restart spot) or abort program.

SVGN-402.cause: Power-up attach occurred, gun connnect input and/or gunidentify input is mapped, and $SHC_CFG.$ATIO_WT_ALM = TRUE. This message is posted to report time waiting for attach io to become true.
SVGN-402.remedy: This alarm is not a problem. However, set $SHC_CFG.$ATIO_WT_ALM = FALSE, if you wish to disable this alarm.

SVGN-403.cause: A tp program started (or resumed) and spot program touchup function is enabled with execution mode = VERIF + WELD. This means that points will be touched up, and then spot will execute.
SVGN-403.remedy: If touchup (not verify) mode is desired, change execution mode via Touchup setup screen: a. if tp is disabled, set Execution mode for AUTO = TOUCHUP mode, b. if tp is enabled, set Execution mode for TEACH = TOUCHUP mode, If normal spot (not touchup or verify) operation is desired, disable program touchup via: a. DIN, if tp is enabled. b. Touchup mode setup screen, if tp is disabled.

SVGN-404.cause: Spot program touchup has been enabled in VERIF + WELD mode during spot instruction execution, so touchup process will not begin until next spot. Conditions leading to this case are: 1. Start program with spot program touchup disabled 2. Pause program during execution of spot instruction 3. Enable spot program touchup (in VERIF + WELD mode) 4. Resume (continue) program
SVGN-404.remedy: Note: purpose of this warning is operator notification, this is not a fault condition. In order to execute touchup immediately, either execute shift backward (to restart spot) or abort program.

SVGN-405.cause: Program touchup executed with execution mode set to TCHUP+WELD or VERIFY+WELD. This message indicates that weld operation completed, after tchup (or verify) for this line.
SVGN-405.remedy: This is merely a warning for feedback/confirmation. Set $SGBTCHTCH[].$WRN4WLDCMPL = FALSE, if you do not wish to display this message.

SVGN-406.cause: Specified TP program was opened successfully. Note that this message is only posted after a program open failure.
SVGN-406.remedy: No action is needed. This alarm is merely a message to inform you that a corrective action was performed.

SVGN-407.cause: Specified TP program could not be opened - program may have been cleared. Refer to cause code for reason.
SVGN-407.remedy: This program should already exist in memory, so open failure is unexpected. If open failure occurs, system reloads program from FRS, and no action is required. This alarm is reported to inform user that corrective action has been taken. Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative, if problem persists.

SVGN-408.cause: Specified TP program was loaded. Note that this message is only posted after a file load failure.
SVGN-408.remedy: No action is needed. This alarm is merely a message to inform you that a corrective action was performed.

SVGN-409.cause: Specified TP program could NOT be loaded - program may have been deleted. Refer to cause code for reason.
SVGN-409.remedy: This program should always on FRS, so load failure is unexpected. Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

SVGN-410.cause: Specified TP program could NOT be closed. Refer to cause code for reason.
SVGN-410.remedy: Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative.

SVGN-411.cause: TP Line data could not be read, for specified program at line. TP program may be corrupt, so it was automatically cleared. See cause code for more details.
SVGN-411.remedy: Re-execute current process again: program will reload and line data will be read again. Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative if problem persists.

SVGN-412.cause: TP Line data could not be set, for specified program at line. TP program may be corrupt, so it was automatically cleared. See cause code for more details.
SVGN-412.remedy: Re-execute current process again: program will reload and line data will be set again. Contact your FANUC America Corporation technical representative if problem persists.

SVGN-417.cause: Search motion is done, but upper detect condition is not set Non-Adaptive2 mode.
SVGN-417.remedy: For precision stabilization, it is better that Non-Adaptive2 is set.

SVGN-418.message: Det offset for Simple search enabled !
SVGN-418.cause: A tp program started (or resumed) and spot program touchup function is enabled with execution mode = MEAS OFS.
SVGN-418.remedy: If touchup (not measure offset) mode is desired, change execution mode via Touchup setup screen: Set Execution mode for TEACH = TOUCHUP mode,

SVGN-419.message: Det offset for Simple search pending.
SVGN-419.cause: Spot program touchup has been enabled in MEAS OFS mode during spot instruction execution, so spot program touchup will not start until next spot. Conditions leading to this case are: 1. Start program with spot program touchup disabled 2. Pause program during execution of spot instruction 3. Enable spot program touchup (in MEAS OFS mode) 4. Resume (continue) program
SVGN-419.remedy: Note: purpose of this warning is operator notification, this is not a fault condition. In order to execute program touchup immediately, either execute shift backward (to restart spot) or abort program.

SVGN-420.cause: A tp program started (or resumed) and spot program touchup function is enabled with execution mode = PASS CHECK.
SVGN-420.remedy: If touchup (not pass check) mode is desired, change execution mode via Touchup setup screen: Set Execution mode for TEACH = TOUCHUP mode,

SVGN-421.cause: Spot program touchup has been enabled in PASS CHECK mode during spot instruction execution, so spot program touchup will not start until next spot. Conditions leading to this case are: 1. Start program with spot program touchup disabled 2. Pause program during execution of spot instruction 3. Enable spot program touchup (in PASS CHECK mode) 4. Resume (continue) program
SVGN-421.remedy: Note: purpose of this warning is operator notification, this is not a fault condition. In order to execute program touchup immediately, either execute shift backward (to restart spot) or abort program.

SVGN-423.cause: Cap wear value exceeds value specified in $TWGUN. Note: value in %s is a string with the following format: w1mm > w2. Where: w1 = current wear value, w2 = max wear value. For example, if w1=6mm, w2=5mm, the alarm will display as SVGN-423 Fixed tip capwear: 6.0mm > 5.0(limit)
SVGN-423.remedy: Replace cap or increase value in $TWGUN.

SVGN-424.cause: Cap wear value exceeds value specified in $TWGUN. Note: value in %s is a string with the following format: w1mm > w2. Where: w1 = current wear value, w2 = max wear value. For example, if w1=6mm, w2=5mm, the alarm will display as SVGN-424 Fixed tip capwear: 6.0mm > 5.0(limit)
SVGN-424.remedy: Replace cap or increase value in $TWGUN.

SVGN-425.cause: Rate of wear exceeds tolerance specified in $TWGUN.
SVGN-425.remedy: Confirm that wear value is not excessive, for this number of spots.

SVGN-426.cause: Rate of wear exceeds tolerance specified in $TWGUN.
SVGN-426.remedy: Confirm that wear value is not excessive, for this number of spots.

SVGN-427.cause: Wear percentage exceeds tolerance specified in $TWGUN.
SVGN-427.remedy: Confirm that spot process is operating correctly.

SVGN-428.cause: Wear percentage exceeds tolerance specified in $TWGUN.
SVGN-428.remedy: Confirm that spot process is operating correctly.

SVGN-429.cause: Gun tip compression (non-capwear change) exceeds tolerance specified in $TWGUN. Ideally, gun tip compression should be 0. However, compression can become greater than 0 over time, because electrode get pushed into holder (tapered pipe fit).

SVGN-430.cause: Gun tip compression (non-capwear change) exceeds tolerance specified in $TWGUN. Ideally, gun tip compression should be 0. However, compression can become greater than 0 over time, because electrode get pushed into holder (tapered pipe fit).

SVGN-431.cause: Close stroke limit is less than max wear value. Gun tip compression is too large and/or close limit is too small.
SVGN-431.remedy: Increase stroke limit, if possible (if new limit does not exceed extension of leadscrew). Replace electrode / tip holder, if gun tip compression is large.

SVGN-432.cause: Cause message posted with alarms 425-430 for additional info.
SVGN-432.remedy: None - SVGN-432 is merely supplemental info for main alarm.

SVGN-433.cause: $TWGUN#V#[] could not be created due to lack of memory.

SVGN-434.cause: Cause message posted with alarm 431 for additional info.
SVGN-434.remedy: Replace caps if wear is too large. Replace shank/cap adapter if compression is too large.

SVGN-435.cause: Direction of Lower panel search motion was wrong.
SVGN-435.remedy: Open robot tip with following ways and retry. In Spot point touchup, open robot tip by jog. In Spot program touchup, set larger value to SPTCH_RSD instruction, Lower panel detection

SVGN-436.cause: Calibration point 2 torque value ≤= $minimum_trq. Therefore, torque value for calpt2 = calpt1. Torque values must be increasing.
SVGN-436.remedy: Increase torque value for calibration point2.

SVGN-437.cause: Thickness check calibration opens gun to original position after calibration, but original (current) position is unreachable, because it is past open stroke limit. Thickness check calibration could not start because of this error.
SVGN-437.remedy: 1. Jog gun in close direction, until open limit is not exceeded.

SVGN-438.cause: Invalid parameters are used at MP_SPOT#.
SVGN-438.remedy: Refer to a cause code. And correct them.

SVGN-439.remedy: Reset this alarm and restart when this was occurred by pressing HOLD. Reset other alarms and restart when this was occurred at other situations.

SVGN-440.remedy: Confirm Sub-sequence number displayed this message is registered.

SVGN-441.message: Pressure profile by DI time out
SVGN-441.cause: Specified DI is not asserted in time.

SVGN-442.cause: Both forced 1 step signal and forced 2 step signal are input
SVGN-442.remedy: Input either one of forced 1 step signal and forced 2 step signal.

SVGN-443.cause: Forced 1 step signal is asserted for new tip
SVGN-443.remedy: Assert either one of forced 1 step signal and new tip flag.

SVGN-444.cause: Invalid IO configuration for tw meas auto-detection has been found.
SVGN-444.remedy: Confirm IO configuration for tw meas auto-detection.

SVGN-445.cause: Specified variable could not be created, because free CMOS is too low. Free CMOS must be > ($SGSYSCFG.$MINFREECMOS + additional memory for new var). Current value of free CMOS (kbytes) is noted in alarm message.
SVGN-445.remedy: Increase CMOS memory or decrease size of new variable allocation.

SVGN-446.cause: Specified variable could not be created, because free DRAM is too low. Free CMOS must be > ($SGSYSCFG.$MINFREEDRAM + additional memory for new var). Current value of free DRAM (kbytes) is noted in alarm message.
SVGN-446.remedy: Increase DRAM memory or decrease size of new variable allocation.

SVGN-447.cause: Specified variable could not be created, because free FROM is too low. Free FROM must be > ($SGSYSCFG.$MINFREEFROM + additional memory for new var). Current value of free FROM (kbytes) is noted in alarm message.
SVGN-447.remedy: Increase FROM memory or decrease size of new variable allocation.

SVGN-448.cause: Number of guns or log length Variables for specified variable have changed. Message identifies previous old, new gun count and old, new variable dimension.
SVGN-448.remedy: None. This message is posted for memory tracking purposes, NOT problem notification.

SVGN-449.cause: DRAM and FROM Memory have decreased by specified amount (kbytes). Note: positive value means memory decrease, negative value means memory increase.
SVGN-449.remedy: None. This message is posted for memory tracking purposes, NOT problem notification.

SVGN-450.cause: Total time elapsed during step exceeds step wait limit. This can occur, if DIN to start step is unmet, or timeout value is too short. See alarm message for StepId and elapsed time are reported.

SVGN-451.cause: PosLok was requested, but motionless force control switching is disabled.

SVGN-452.message: Gun close required for fctrl change
SVGN-452.cause: FCTRL change was requested, but gun closed flag is not set.
SVGN-452.remedy: Set $sgcfg[].$nomotn_fcsw=TRUE, $sgsyscfg.$fctlmgr_enb=TRUE and execute spot/press_motn instruction, prior to fctrl change request.

SVGN-453.cause: Pressurization time time exceeded due to follow-up.
SVGN-453.remedy: Disabled follow during pressuring motion or increase $info[1].$wait_lim.

SVGN-454.cause: Force control mode change did not change within expected time.
SVGN-454.remedy: Increase $syscfg.$fc.$wtmx. If this does not fix the problem, contact your FANUC technical representative.

SVGN-455.message: Fctrl request cleared due to gun motion
SVGN-455.cause: Motion instruction was called, after force control requet was asserted. Motion control has precedence over force control, so force control was cancelled.
SVGN-455.remedy: Call instruction CTRL_POSITION, prior to motion instruction. Note that this is only necessary if CTRL_PRESSURE[] was called, previously.

SVGN-456.cause: User press instruction was called, but current setting does not match. Setting that was applied at last cold start. Refer to code for specific reason.
SVGN-456.remedy: Change user press request or perform cold start.

SVGN-457.cause: TP program called usr press instruction, but user press function is disabled.

SVGN-458.message: NEED APPLY for user press cfg.
SVGN-458.cause: User press config has changed, and/or ~svg program is stale.
SVGN-458.remedy: Go to user config screen and press apply(F3), then perform cold start.

SVGN-459.cause: Instruction was called, and equipment type == dual gun. Dual gun is not supported with this option / instruction/
SVGN-459.remedy: Use standard spot or press_motn instruction.

SVGN-460.remedy: This message is merely provided for confirmation, it is not a prolem.

SVGN-461.cause: User config specification could not be applied. Apply operation was cancelled. Typically, this is due to program being open (paused) and hot start being performed. Refer to error code in parentheses for reason.
SVGN-461.remedy: Abort program and repower or perform cold start. If problem persists, record error code and contact your FANUC technical representative.

SVGN-462.cause: User subprogram# does not exist. 1: before pressure subprogram 2: after pressure subprogram 3: after open subprogram
SVGN-462.remedy: Create specified program or go to user config screen and specify new program name or disable this program.

SVGN-463.remedy: Refer to screen for specific reason and correct it.

SVGN-464.cause: Linecount of internal program is invalid.
SVGN-464.remedy: Perform a Cold start to recreate the internal program. Contact your FANUC technical representative, if the problem persists.

SVGN-465.cause: Internal program rewrite failed when controller powered up. Typically, this occurs because program was open (paused) when rewrite was attemped at power-up.
SVGN-465.remedy: Press re-apply on user config screen and cold start to recreate the internal program.

SVGN-466.cause: Internal spot program touch-up program error.
SVGN-466.remedy: Repower, go to control start, and then back to cold start. This action re-generates the internal spot program touch-up program and may correct the problem.

SVGN-467.cause: This is additional info for SVGN-450 alarm. Time expected = duration (ms) programmed in pressure schedule. Time observed = duration (ms) observed when timeout occurred. Ct is internal duration info used by FANUC for troubleshooting.

SVGN-468.cause: Pressure profile truncation occurred - full pressure profile did not execute. Number to right of truncated is profile phase where this occurred: 1=before weld, 2=during weld, 3=after weld. SVGN-468 is not necessarily a problem, because pressure sequence that executes after weld complete (in weld phase) may not be required. However, if weld complete should not occur prior to pressure sequence completion, it is a problem and is duly noted.
SVGN-468.remedy: Increase weld duration or reduce duration of steps during weld pressure sequence. Alternatively, set $sgppdcfg.$steptruncer = 0 to disable this alarm. $steptruncer | 0x1: Enable phase 1 check (before weld) $steptruncer | 0x2: Enable phase 2 check (during weld)

SVGN-469.cause: Position data cannot update in Spot Program Touchup Function.
SVGN-469.remedy: If there is differnce in axes configuration between current system and position data before touchup, position data cannot update by Spot program Touchup Function.

SVGN-470.message: Prs incre exceed abnl up lim:G%d
SVGN-470.cause: Pressure increase exceeded abnormal pressure increase upper limit value.

SVGN-471.message: Prs decre below abnl low lim:G%d
SVGN-471.cause: Pressure decrease below abnormal pressure decrease lower limit value.

SVGN-472.remedy: Perform the tip wear setup procedure again.

SVGN-473.cause: Specified pressure value at pressure profile is invalid.

SVGN-474.cause: Specified index at pressure profile is invalid.

SVGN-475.cause: Fixed tip compression rate (change) is overtol. Tip adapter may be mislocated.
SVGN-475.remedy: If there is differnce in axes configuration between current system and position data before touchup, Adjust tip adapter or increase tolerance of tip comprssion rate change.

SVGN-476.cause: Movable tip compression rate (change) is overtol. Tip adapter may be mislocated.
SVGN-476.remedy: If there is differnce in axes configuration between current system and position data before touchup, Adjust tip adapter or increase tolerance of tip comprssion rate change.

SVGN-477.cause: Nomnal poke pressure value specified in pressure schedule is uninit. Poke check cannot be be performed because poke pressure is unspecified.
SVGN-477.remedy: Go to pressure schedule screen and either: 1. perform poke measurement (to measure and enter pressure automatically) 2. manually enter nominal poke presssure.

SVGN-478.cause: Poke speed value specified in pressure schedule is uninit.
SVGN-478.remedy: Go to pressure schedule screen and enter poke speed.

SVGN-479.cause: Poke distance value specified in pressure schedule is uninit.
SVGN-479.remedy: Go to pressure schedule screen and enter poke distance.

SVGN-480.message: Poke press low tol is uninit.
SVGN-480.cause: Poke pressure low tol specified in pressure schedule is uninit.
SVGN-480.remedy: Go to pressure schedule screen and enter poke pressure low tol.

SVGN-481.message: Poke press high tol is uninit.
SVGN-481.cause: Poke pressure high tol specified in pressure schedule is uninit.
SVGN-481.remedy: Go to pressure schedule screen and enter poke pressure high tol.

SVGN-482.cause: Prelod distance value specified in pressure schedule is uninit.
SVGN-482.remedy: Go to pressure schedule screen and enter prelod distance.

SVGN-483.cause: Invalid gun number was specified in $SGLOGINF.GUN_NUM. Value specified must correspond to a valid servogun number.
SVGN-483.remedy: Go to poke schedule screen and reduce preload distance or increase poke distance.

SVGN-484.cause: Equalization is disabled when override is smaller than 100%
SVGN-484.remedy: None. This message is NOT problem notification.

SVGN-485.message: EQZ is disabled when single step
SVGN-485.cause: Equalization is disabled when single step mode is enabled.
SVGN-485.remedy: None. This message is NOT problem notification.

SVGN-486.cause: Pressure shortage has occurred, and $sgsyscfg.$pst_ertyp message flag is enabled.
SVGN-486.remedy: Insert panel with appropriate thickness and/or update thickness value. If thickness is ok, then replace caps if they are worn. To disable this alarm, set $sgsyscfg.$pst_ertype = 0. Note: if this alarm is disabled, then SVGN-020 will be posted. SVGN-486 or SVGN-487 is posted in lieu of SVGN-020 when this alarm is enabled.

SVGN-487.cause: Pressure shortage has occurred, and $sgsyscfg.$pst_ertyp message flag is enabled.
SVGN-487.remedy: Insert panel with appropriate thickness and/or update thickness value. If thickness is ok, then replace caps if they are worn. To disable this alarm, set $sgsyscfg.$pst_ertype = 0. Note: if this alarm is disabled, then SVGN-020 will be posted. SVGN-486 or SVGN-487 is posted in lieu of SVGN-020 when this alarm is enabled.

SVGN-488.cause: The communication port for IRWC-T is not initialized.
SVGN-488.remedy: Initialize the communication port for IRWC-T.

SVGN-489.cause: The connection preparation sequence with IRWC-T failed.

SVGN-490.cause: The connection preparation sequence with IRWC-T succeeded.
SVGN-490.remedy: This is just a message. There is no need to be careful.

SVGN-494.message: GunA must be specified for dual guns.
SVGN-494.cause: GunB (2nd gun of dual gun pair) was specified in the gun attach or detach instuction. GunA (1st gun of dual gun pair) must be specified in the instruction (to ensure that wrong gun is not accidentally specified).
SVGN-494.remedy: Change gun number specified in the instruction to GunA, from GunB. For example, if dual gun pair2 has guns3+4, specify GUN ATTACH[3], not GUN ATTACH[4].

SVGN-495.message: DSP numbers must differ for dual gun.
SVGN-495.cause: DSP number is same for gunA and gunB. Dual guns have separate motors, so dsp_num should not be the same.
SVGN-495.remedy: Go from control start to cold start, to automatically update dsp_num.

SVGN-496.message: Axis pair is invalid for dual gun.
SVGN-496.cause: The axis mapping is invalid for a dual gun. Index of first axis must be odd (1,3,5,7) and 2nd axis must be adjacent to first axis. Examples of valid axisorder settings for a dual gun are shown below. [7, 8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0] [0, 0, 9,10, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0] [0, 0, 0, 0,11,12, 0, 0, 0] [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0,13,14, 0] ^ ^ ^ ^ <—- valid indices for first axis.
SVGN-496.remedy: This alarm is a cause code for SVGN-498 and SVGN-499. Refer to the errror code for more info.

SVGN-497.message: Axis count:%d not equal to gun count:%d
SVGN-497.cause: The axis mapping does not correspond to the gun type (dual/single) selection.
SVGN-497.remedy: This alarm is a cause code for SVGN-498 and SVGN-499. Refer to the error code to determine the next action.

SVGN-498.cause: Repower occurred, and $axisorder was invalid or inconsistent with gun setting. Power-up attach/detach was cancelled so gun group is faulted. Refer to cause code for the reason.
SVGN-498.remedy: Go to control start and Check dual/single gun setting. If dual/single gun setting is correct, go to cold start. If dual/single gun setting is incorrect, change gun setting, then go to cold start. Note that axisorder is automatially corrected at cold start or when gun selection changes or if you go to control start config menu and select this equipment. Attach gun(s) if desired, after cold start completes.

SVGN-499.message: Axis order cleared for gunchange grp.
SVGN-499.cause: $axisorder was invalid or inconsistent with gun setting Axisorder was automatically cleared to correct this isssue; all guns are detached. Refer to cause code for more info.
SVGN-499.remedy: None. An Axisorder error was corrected and guns are detacted. Attach gun(s) if desired.

SVGN-500.message: Battery must be ON for dual gun change.
SVGN-500.cause: The battery type for gun change is set to OFF.Batteryless dual gun change is not supported.

SVGN-501.cause: Teach verification has STARTED for SPOT (or PRESS_MOTN[]) at specified program and line.
SVGN-501.remedy: None. This message is for status info, it is not a problem.

SVGN-502.cause: Teach verification has ENDED for SPOT (or PRESS_MOTN[]) at specified program and line.
SVGN-502.remedy: None. This message is for status info, it is not a problem.

SVGN-503.cause: Teach verification input was asserted and teach verification started.However, verify enable input became false, so verification cannot proceed.
SVGN-503.remedy: 1. Turn input on and resume to continue with verification OR2. Leave input off and resume to cancel verification.Afer cancel, Spot will restart at approach and execute normally.

SVGN-601.cause: Value specified in $SGLOGINF.$GUN_NUM was < 1 or > num guns when STARTLOG macro was called.
SVGN-601.remedy: Set valid gun number, before calling STARTLOG macro.

SVGN-602.cause: $SGLOGINF.$LOG_TYPE was < 1 or > logtype dimension(default=33) at log start trigger.
SVGN-602.remedy: Set valid value log type, before calling STARTLOG macro.

SVGN-603.cause: A valid logstart request was received, but system was not done capturing data for previous request (previous request has precedence).
SVGN-603.remedy: Disable one of the log types, or increase time between log requests.

SVGN-604.cause: Log data was captured and buffer1 was created. However, buffer1 was dropped because buffer2 and buffer3 were full.
SVGN-604.remedy: Decrease log extend time. Disable logging for this logtype, if problem cannot be resolved. Also, see SVGN-605 for info on buffers2, 3. SVGN-604 is posted as a separate alarm (for info) before SVGN-603 is posted.

SVGN-605.cause: This alarm is cause info for SVGN-603. It is provided to better understand why log was busy, when error occurred.

SVGN-606.cause: Log data was captured and file write started, but file write took too long.
SVGN-606.remedy: Increase timeout duration. Decrease log extend time. Disable logging for this logtype, if problem cannot be resolved.

SVGN-607.cause: Spot instruction started to execute, but Poke torque calibration data is invalid: torque data value at point x <= torque data value at point x-1. Pt number and torque values are specified in message.
SVGN-607.remedy: Go to poke schedule screen and perform poke calibration again.

SVGN-608.cause: Spot instruction started to execute, but Poke angle calibration data is invalid: angle data value at point x <= angle data value at point x-1. Pt number and torque values are specified in message.
SVGN-608.remedy: Go to poke schedule screen and perform poke calibration again.

SVGN-609.cause: Spot instruction started to execute, but poke angle calibration was never performed.
SVGN-609.remedy: Go to poke schedule screen and perform poke calibration.

SVGN-610.cause: The Measured part thickness is less than the under-thickness limit(mm). The part may be out-of-tolerance. NOTE: This message displays the nominal (expected/programmed) thickness and the under-thickness (MinAllowable) limit.

SVGN-611.cause: The Measured part thickness is greater than the over-thickness limit(mm). The part may be out-of-tolerance. NOTE: This message displays the nominal (expected/programmed) thickness and the over-thickness (MaxAllowable) limit.
